description:
You will have the opportunity to have a panoramic view of Istanbul in this apartment with a terrace overlooking the magnificent Galata Tower and the Bosphorus.

It's time to enjoy yourself in this apartment with two terraces.

Our apartment is located 10 steps from Galata Tower, 4 minutes from Galataport, and 5 minutes from Istiklal Street, the heart of Istanbul. Thus, you will be able to easily reach the center from anywhere without using a car.

reviews.text:
Stunning apartment in a terrific neighborhood. The apartment itself is clean, spacious and has two incredible terraces with outstanding views of Galata Tower and the Bosphorus. Efkan was extremely helpful and responsive with tips for neighboring restaurants and met us when we arrived to help check us in.
The apartment is on the fifth floor and there isn't an elevator so keep that in mind. Efkan did help with carrying up our suitcases when we arrived. The stairs are absolutely worth the stunning views we had each evening!
And the apartment is VERY centrally located right next to Galata Tower. The terrific location does come with some street noise but ear plugs were an easy solve. Again worth some street noise for the terrific location.
Highly recommend and would book again without hesitation!

the view you have from the 2 (!) rooftops is spectacular. the location is great, right next to Galata tower. Some of the main attractions like Hagia Sofia, Topkapi are in "extended" walking distance (about 40 minutes) or faster with the cable car. The hosts are very responsive and helpful. check-in was quick and easy and they helped us with the luggage. We appreciated as it is 4th floor, no elevator. no problem, but it might be something to consider if you don't like stairs. The apartment was very clean and as described. absolutely recommended.

Had a fabulous stay at Efkans place. Excellent location, superb views and very comfortable beds with clean linen - this flat is spacious and exactly as in the pictures. Efkan himself is helpful and rapid to respond. He communicated by Airbnb to check on our arrival time and met us at the door and carried out suitcases up. As others point out, this flat is top floor and up 85 steps which can feel a bit crushing when you’ve already walked 20k like we were doing, but the view is worth it. It is a bit noisy but you get that with the central location. It’s a nice walk in any direction to see everything. 15 mins down to the ferry, 30 mins over to the Hagia Sophia and we even walked to Balat (50 mins). A quick stop for Turkish coffee or tea makes it all possible. Couldn’t fault Efkan or his flat! Would recommend.

Efkan's apartment is located literally at the Galata tower in Istanbul, so it is a very convenient location to explore the city. The apartment is on the fifth floor of a building which is around 100 years old and there is no elevator, so this should be considered when booking. There are two terraces on two different levels, offering great views. The apartment is very clean and well kept; there are two bedrooms with two full bathrooms, a fairly large living room with adjacent kitchen. AC and WiFi work well. We were very satisfied with everything, and Efkan was very responsive to our needs and inquiries. One other thing to consider is the fact that due to the closeness of the very touristy Galata tower and its surroundings the area can be very crowded and noisy until late at night. We highly recommend this place!

The apartment is exactly as pictured and the two rooftop decks offer stunning views, including the moonrise.
You’ll be at the center of all the action. Make two rights and you’re at the base of Galata Tower. Here you’ll have easy access to the supermarket, ATM, shops, restaurants, and a short walk to the metro. Turn left and you’ll find a more peaceful scene with boutiques and local haunts.
The home is equipped with a modest kitchen (no oven or toaster), but you’ll be able to prepare basic meals and enjoy them on the deck.
Efkan was a gracious and responsive host. He’s easy to communicate with and helped us access the apartment within 10 minutes after we accidentally locked ourselves out. As others mentioned, it’s 8 flights of stairs up, but the view makes the effort worth it.

description:
Conveniently set in Istanbul, Homelike Hotel provides air-conditioned rooms, a restaurant and free WiFi. The property is located 2 km from Istiklal Street. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk.

All units at the hotel are equipped with a TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. At Hotel each room include towels

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Istanbul Taksim Square.

reviews.text: I had a great 2-day stay at this Airbnb! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The host was responsive and made check-in really easy. The location was convenient for everything I needed, and I appreciated the little touches that made the stay feel more welcoming. Would definitely stay here again!

Kesinlikle gönül rahatlığıyla konaklayabilirsiniz. Gökhan bey özellikle çok kibar ve ilgiliydi, oda yine aynı şekilde temiz ve sorunsuzdu fotoğraflarda gördüğünüz gibi. Tek eksiği belki çift kişilik yatak birer tek kişilik yatağın birleşimiydi ama bu rahatsız etmiyor sizi gayet rahat her şey. Kahvaltısı lezzetliydi ve kolay ulaşılabilir bir şekilde kendiniz seçerek alıyorsunuz her şey temiz ve ürünleri kaliteli. Son olarak konumu vesaire de gayet iyi bir yerde sorunlu değil ve bir yerlere ulaşmak istediğiniz zaman bu da yorucu değil hızlı bir şekilde ulaşabilirsiniz.

Very nice stay, everything was so good. The room was very clean, and I felt comfortable the whole time. The location is great, a really nice neighborhood with easy access around the city. The host was available anytime, which made things smooth. I’d definitely recommend this place.

Otelin konumu Nişantaşı metroya sadece yürüyerek 3 dakika mesafede bu nedenle Avrupa yakası seyahat planımmıza çok rahat bir seçenek oldu. Otelin dizaynı kahvaltı hizmeti ve personellerin ilgisi ile alakalı son derece memnunuz. Sadece çarşaftı ufak bir leke ve yastıkların rahatsızlığı konusunda değinebilirim ama söylenebildiği zaman telafi edilmeyecek bir problem değil genel olarak fiyat performans olarak çok verimliydi.

Eşimle beraber 5 gece konakladık. Check-in saatinden önce gelmemize rağmen Gökhan bey bagajlar konusunda bize yardımcı oldu. Konumu oldukça güzel. Yakın çevresindeki popüler mekanlara ve ulaşım ağına çoğunlukla yürüme mesafesinde. Oda temizdi. Büyüklüğü de bizim için yeterliydi. Fiyat performans olarak beklentimizi karşıladı.

description:
Located in Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museums, theaters, concert halls and cinemas, this residence is waiting to welcome its new guests. It is within walking distance to places such as Taksim, Nişantaşı and Şişli.

High speed Wi-Fi available.
Elevator, parking, 24/7 security, reception.
New & High quality furniture.
You can enjoy the city view from your balcony and terrace.
Please kindly check all photos for details.

Wish you experience a wonderful stay HERE.

reviews.text: The building was excellent—spotless, secure with 24/7 reception/security, and a good gym/pool. Nihan was outstanding: always responsive, extra towels arrived immediately, and the dishwasher was fixed quickly. Unfortunately, the apartment itself was terrible. It was clean but extremely run down, with damp, leaks and mould in the upstairs bathrooms and main bedroom. The ensuite door had swollen and wouldn’t close, and the mouldy smell never disappeared. I have a severe mould allergy and even developed a skin reaction. We left for 2 days expecting the leak to be fixed, but nothing changed. The mattresses and pillows were extremely uncomfortable, and the furniture was very cheap. Only 2 rooms had AC—the second bedroom only had a fan, which was unacceptable in 32°C and not disclosed. For the price, this was by far the worst Airbnb I’ve stayed in after 10+ trips to Istanbul. The stars are only for the amazing staff and service. I would not recommend this apartment.
Great location and very helpful host. The apartment is as described.
Very nice apartment and quick and friendly communication. Everything was as described. Building amenities with pool and gym are tip top and definitely worth it after a day exploring Istanbul.

The apartment was very clean and well maintained. The location in Beyoğlu, Istanbul was great and convenient for getting around. The beds were not the most comfortable, but overall we had pleasant stay and a good experience.
I really enjoyed my stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed. It was definitely worth the price. Thank you for a great experience!

description:
Hey there people
The home is at the Istanbul historic centre peninsula, in Beyoglu a few steps away from Galata Tower. Also just 2 munite for go to Galata port. İstiklal street - şişhane metro station just 4 munite on the walk . Also tophane metro station is just 1 munite. There are well known restaurants and cafes,art galleries and boutique shops and Markets in a min away.All touristic attractions are in walkable distance.You will have more than what traveler needs.

reviews.text: The location was hard to get to with cat and public transport. It’s a very noisy and busy neighbourhood that’s not very clean. The apartment was in second floor with very steep and uncomfortable stairs. The place looked very smaller than photos and it was not as clean as expected. There were stains all over the place. There were many details that needed attention and affected the experience: sink was tilted so dirty water would fill underneath microwave, there were no proper cooking equipment, shower dis not have curtains so water fill out the bathroom floor, balcony was dirty, common area looked like an old storage, carpets were not clean, we did not have even enough cutlery. That being said, Jevat and Ozgur were very friendly and responsive and accommodated what we asked with some delay but the place had so many problems that was not fixable with few requests. I think the apartment is adequate for maximum four person, no kids or elderly at all and need a thorough attention to details

Excellent spot - the flat itself and the immediate environment are really quiet but you are really close to great restaurants, bars and either a short walk down to the sea/tram or a steeper walk up to the tower. The bedrooms are comfortable and decent enough sized, the kitchen has what you’d need and the living space/sofa is lovely - as is the entrance way to the flats. Didn’t use the Jacuzzi tub but the shower was great. Hosts were very responsive and given the location and size I thought it was great value. You have to log in to your own account for the TV, the stairways to the flat are narrow and the front door is very heavy but they feel very minor issues against all the positives - overall very happy to recommend after what was a lovely stay.

We had a great stay! The hosts were very attentive and helpful throughout our stay. We had a few small things come up, and they always responded quickly and helped us solve everything.
The apartment was clean and spacious, the kitchen was very clean, and the beds were very comfortable. The location was also great.
My only recommendation would be to equip the kitchen a little better. Also, just as a note, some water comes out of the shower while you’re using it. Other than that, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!

when booking a ABNB, the first thing is location. only 2minutes away to all major transportation including bus and tram (Tophane) station. it is on the third floor, it is totally manageable. The host is very responsive to any questions. he can assist to arrange transportation between airport and ABNB. the day I arrived, host arranged for us, and I pay EuRO50 to the driver as recommended tips. On the day when I return since it is early in the morning 7:15am flight, you must leave the airport by no later than 4am. the shuttle arrived late instead we took the taxi and only cost us 1400TL that's less than the tips LOL. I suggested asking the host to arrange on your arrival and you can manage your departure transportation on your own. a lot of taxi in the neighborhood. overall, the unit is clean and efficient, but lacking on basic cooking ingredients such as cooking oil. we prepare our breakfast every morning, there are many small groceries around for ur water, fruits, eggs, etc

The whole stay was peaceful and great Me and my family really enjoyed our time. The apartment was clean and had all the amenities we needed from sanitized towels to detergent also the heating system was great because my stay then had a cold weather.I want to thank the hosts for being friendly and helpful thus I had an emergency and they did not hesitate to help !! The location was really good we had a 3 min walk to the nearest transportation station. Overall I had a great experience within the Airbnb would come back for sure !!☺️

description:
Spend quality time with your whole family in this stylish place.
A comfortable and clean apartment!

Brief features:
*Luxury furniture, practical items, clean linens & towels.
*24/7 Reception, late check-in possible,
*Security cameras (in common areas),
*Daily garbage collection from the door,
*1 elevator and also a service elevator,
*Wifi - Fiber optic internet infrastructure, 100Mbps speed. *Very central location, very close to Şişli Osmanbey Cevahir Shopping Mall
*Very close to the metro

reviews.text:
Çok temiz ve konforlu bir konaklama oldu. odalar çok ferah ve kullanışlı.
mutfak bölümünde tabak ve bardaklar çok özenli ve temizdi.
banyo tuvalet çok özenle temizlenmişti.
yatak oldukça konforlu ve rahattı
ayrıca resepsiyon görevlileri son derece kibar ve ilgiliddavrandılar.
Çok teşekkür ediyorum.
konumu da oldukça merkezi
tekrar tercih edeceğim
Very good hotel, personal was very helpful, place is near the center, nearby are many cafes and restaurants, highly reccomended!

Bir otel değil bi ev konforunda olduğunu belirtmek isterim. Çok sıcak ve samimi bir ortam Recep bey oldukça ilgiliydi ve hızlı cevaplar verdi. Konumu harika tam karşısında otopark olmasıda araba sorunu çözüyor. Tertemiz mis gibi kokuyordu tavsiye ederim ve sıklıkla da tercih edeceğim bir mekan.

Aslında çok yardımcı oldular. İşitme engelli olduğum için iletişim kurmakta zorlanıyorum, ama bu kez kendimi rahat hissettim. Ne desem anlayışla karşıladılar ve hassas davrandılar. Gösterdiğiniz ilgi için teşekkür etmek istedim. Bu yüzden tekrar gelebilirim, size de tavsiye ederim.”

Oda resimlerle uyuşmuyor geniş oturma alanı ve masa yoktu. İnanılmaz havasızdı çok kötü kokuyordu ve cam sadece üstten açılıyordu. Cam merdiven boşluğuna bakıyor yani ne hava ne ışık asla gelmiyor. Odanın kokusu gitsin ve hava girsin diye dış kapıyı açmak zorunda kaldık. Rezervasyon yaparken özellikle sordum oda resimdeki gibi mi ve ön cephe mi diye (çünkü Google yorumları kötüydü) Recep beyde bana ön cephe vereceğini belirtti. Fakat giriş yaparken ısrarla rica etmemize rağmen ön cephe vermediler (elektrik sıkıntısı dedi daha sonra ama resepsiyondaki çalışan oda yok demişti). Ve verilen oda çok kötüydü havasızlıktan durulmuyordu. Yazık günah gerçekten işinizi dürüst yapmayacaksanız hiç yapmayın. Güzel yorumları görünce güvenmiştim büyük hayal kırıklığına uğradım maalesefki. Belki başkaları memnun kalmış olabilir ama ben hiç güzel vaat edildiği gibi bir deneyim yaşamadım üzgünüm. Çıkarken odayı temiz ve düzenli bıraktım, karşılık olarak söyleyeceğiniz kötü bir şey olduğunu düşünmüyorum.

description:
Legal Airbnb Apartment,
Floor 2 and no elevator.
We offer an excellent accommodation experience in our fully equipped Full A/C apartment with 3x Bedrooms, 1x Living room, 1x Dining area and 2x Bathrooms/WC, located in the center of all public transportation in Taksim Square.
Our beautiful and unique house is the 2nd floor of a building without an elevator it is located on the floor.

""Please message me so I can offer you a special deal for stays longer than a month.""

reviews.text:
I booked Enes’ apartment when there were no reviews - it looked very nice, was in the right location, and was also well-priced for the offering - I did take time to read reviews from his other listings, which made me comfortable to pull the trigger- - I am so glad I did.
The apartment is just as pictured. cozy, clean, well serviced, well located - few mins to Taksim square and the famous Istiklal street -There are grocery options mins away -Migros Jet where we got out IstanbulKart
Things we appreciated
1)Prompt response- we arrived and had wifi issues -this was resolved very quickly
2)check-in- we were not able to utilize the app/blue tooth checking due to app country restrictions -Enes had a quick workaround
3) it was so great to be welcomed with chocolate, soft drinks, and bottled water -which my children enjoyed well
4) Flat screen TV in every room -again another amenity my children especially enjoyed
5) A full separate dryer- Yes
6) A bidet in each bathroom -Yes
Happy Customer!

Just as described in listing and in photos. My family was very happy with the amenities and location. Walkable distance to Taksim Square and plenty of restaurants.
Clean rooms and bathrooms. Cosy space for families.
Suggest to provide some manual/guide for some of the electrical appliances - though we kinda figured via trial and error.
Enes is very responsive and helpful! Thanks for the thoughtful goodies you have prepared for us. It has been a pleasure staying in the Airbnb. 10/10 would recommend.
The only downside is that there are no lifts, so you have to carry your heavy luggages up/down.

apartment was just as the photos showed. it was clean and tidy. host was very responsive. we were aware there was no lift and apartment is on 2nd floor but for us it was ok but it is something to keep in mind. location wise was handy being a short walk from Taksim square.

Enes is a great host. We had a wonderful stay at his Airbnb in Taksim Square. The location was excellent right in the heart of Istanbul, with restaurants, cafés, shops, and transportation all within easy walking distance.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It was especially convenient for our family, and the host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay.
Overall, we had a great experience and would happily stay here again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Istanbul!

Great stay in the apartment. 2 flights of stairs was easy for us but something to consider for those with mobility issues. The rooms were a good size with comfortable beds. 2 bathrooms with showers made things easy for our group of 5. The kitchen is well-equipped and there is a nice living room and dining room area that makes congregating a nice possibility after a day of exploring. Location is fantastic - near Taksim Meydan and Istiklal Caddesi ( restaurants, shops, etc) with easy access to the metro, Taksim- Kabatas funicular, and many bus lines to get you out and about. Lots to do in the area, very walkable with many markets in the neighborhood if you are looking for fruits, snacks, etc. Very responsive with easy check-in instructions. Would stay here again.

description:
Enjoy your vacation with our comfortable 1+0 apartment located within walking distance to Istanbul's lively Istiklal Avenue! Spend time as if you were at home thanks to the fully equipped kitchen (with all the food and beverage preparation materials). Basic necessities such as hand-face-foot towels, slippers and shampoo are provided.
Since Istiklal Avenue is a music and entertainment center, there may be liveliness and noise in the evenings; this is perfect for our guests who are ready for the atmosphere! NOTE: There is no elevator in the building.

reviews.text: I recently stayed at an apartment near Istiklal Street and Taksim Square and had a wonderful experience. The location is perfect, offering easy access to some of the best spots in Istanbul. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the photos. The host was very responsive and made the entire stay even more pleasant. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to explore Istanbul from a central and convenient location.
Overall a perfect place and has everything needed. The A/C works great, clean shower, comfortable bed and pillows. Very responsive host as well.

Bir hafta konakladık, ev konum açısından meydana çok yakın her an her saatte her hizmeti bulabiliyorsunuz taksimde, metro ve otobüs olanağı da vardı, mutfak çok kısıtlı olduğu için sürekli dışardan yemek zorunda kaldık bu da bütçeyi biraz etkiledi tabii. Adresi bulmak oldukça kolaydı ev sahibi yeterli açıklamayı yaptı. Bir otel odasını andırıyor gibi fakat iki kişi için gayet yeterliydi. Ev konsepti gibi bir şey arıyorsanız beklentilerinizi karşılamaz ama dışarıda yaşayıp eve sadece uyumak için geliyorsanız gayet yeterliydi. Ev sahibi ilgiliydi yardımcı oldu. Bina sakinleri gece geç saatlerde çok fazla ses yapıyor ve aşağısındaki mekan gürültülüydü müzik sesi bizi rahatsız etmedi ama binadakiler korkutuyordu. Biz memnun kaldık, kısa süreli konaklamanız için fiyat performans yeri tavsiye ediyoruz.

Muhammed beye ilgisi ve alakasından dolayı çok teşekkür ederiz. Ev konumu itibariyle gayet güzeldi sadece temizlik konusunda daha iyi olabilirdi özellikle yatak çarşafları oda da saç kılları vardı duşa kabin temizliği iyi değildi tıkanıklık vardı. Bunların dışında hersey guzeldi 😊

Öncelikle Kamuran Bey'e yardım etmeye çalıştığı için teşekkür ederiz. Saat 14e doğru yeri tuttuk ve girişimiz ancak 15:30a doğru yapılabildi çünkü odanın temizliği bitmemişti. Kamuran Bey jest olarak bize yemek ısmarladı sağolsun. Sonrasında odaya giriş yaptık, yastık kılıfları nevresim ve yatak örtüsünde kıllar olduğunu farkettik. Uyuyup dinlenmemiz gerekiyordu fakat bu durum yüzünden 1 saat kadar daha bekledik sonrasında örtüler değişti ve tam olarak odaya yerleşmemiz 16:30u buldu diyebilirim. Fakat biz içimiz rahat etmediği için kendi nevresim takımımızı serdik. Diğer konularda fiyat performans diyebilirim. Binanın altında bir Türkü Bar var ve her gece oranın gürültülü sesine maruz kalmaktan uyku problemi yaşadık özellikle bu konuya dikkat edilirse sorun olmaz. Onun dışında konumu güzel merkezi yerde. description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: Great location and very responsive. Breakfast was great and the room was as described. I stayed on a Saturday night and could hear the music outside all night and had a hard time falling asleep though. Would find a quieter area to stay next time but location is great for those looking to party and stay out.

I was welcomed warmly by the friendly staff. It was a very late checked in but the staff was already know me immediately soon I arrived thr lobby. So, that was pretty fast check in.
The breakfast was awesome. Plenty of options though the variety of the food was sort of similar every day. But I like the vibe of the restaurant though it was small but i felt like at home. The location was perfect. You can find any cafes restaurants and if you like to shopping just by minutes walking, the location is heaven for the shoppers! Overall, I was really satisfied staying at the hotel

Esnek giriş ve çıkış imkanı sağlandı. sürekli güler yüz ve kibar bir iletişim kurdular. fön makinesi ve ütü konusunda yardımcı oldular. oda temiz ve düzenliydi. istediğimde hemen odam temizlendi. otelin etrafı canlı mekanlarla çevrili. konum olarak çok iyi . tekrar kalmak isterim . ilgileri için Rıdvan bey ve Emrullah beye teşekkür ederim.
I had a pleasant stay , its cozy 3star hotel, clean room, at a nice neighborhood.
Great location, staff was friendly and room was clean. Not the most calm area, but it works well if you have earplugs during the night. Overall a good experience, thanks for hosting me!

description: Located in the center of the city, our hotel offers an ideal accommodation experience for families and couples with its modern studio rooms. With its spacious and comfortable rooms, it will be as comfortable as your home, and thanks to the central location of our hotel, popular restaurants, shopping spots and cultural riches are just a few steps away. We are waiting for you to have a pleasant stay with your family or loved ones and to have the opportunity to relax while exploring the city life.

reviews.text:
It is a great place to stay for a little vacation. The room was clean, the bed was comfortable, they provide a few towels and the room cleaning is done every 2 days (or by a request if you don't need it that often). AC/heater is present. While it's still a hotel room, there is a small kitchen with all the necessary utensil. There is a laundry in the basement and a building has a lift. The only con is that the building is old, let's just say that and the bathroom could be renovated a little. But nothing serious, it's still a great place and the room is nice and cozy. You won't get a nice city view though but the location is very very good - it's close to everything: Taksim square is 5 minutes away by walking; a grocery store is literally around the block. They have a 24 hour helpdesk and the man there is friendly, always willing to help.
Overall, I had a good stay. For the price this place is good and I will surely come back again. Thank you!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Stay Near Taksim Square!
I recently stayed at Atakan's studio and had an absolutely wonderful experience. The location is perfect—just a short walk from Taksim Square, where you can easily catch buses, trams, or taxis, and even transfer to the airport without any hassle. The area is vibrant, with a mix of local and luxury restaurants nearby, offering plenty of dining options.
The studio itself was cozy, clean, and well-equipped with all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. The surroundings were surprisingly quiet, which made it a great place to relax after a busy day exploring the city.
Atakan, the owner, is truly a gem! He was incredibly kind, welcoming, and always ready to help. He made check-in a breeze by waiting for me and even helped with my luggage. Our conversations were delightful, and his hospitality made me feel right at home. The 24/7 service available at his place is a huge plus, ensuring that any needs are promptly addressed.
Recommend ✅

The suíte is of good size and well equipped with many amenities, but there are structural problems with the building, you hear everytime guests upstairs flush their toilet, some maintenance urgently needed and it wasn't well cleaned. Location is only 5 minutes walk from Taksim Square, but in a decadent area, the street is very steep, with a noisy neighborhood. Staff is friendly and helpful, but has limitations to speak English. Just a reasonable place for spending a couple of days in Istanbul, if you are not too demanding ..

We didn't have hot water for the last 2-3 days, and the bathroom drain was clogged and needed to be cleaned. The bedding was not clean, and there was hair on it. It was two separate single beds put together rather than a king-size bed, and they were constantly moving, leaving a gap between them that was uncomfortable.

Great location, nice room for a great price.
The host was a bit unresponsive or forgot things we requested. However it wasn’t major and we overall had a great stay!

description: Stay in the heart of Istanbul’s Old City, within walking distance to Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque and tram. Ideal for families or small groups up to 5 guests. The apartment has 2 bedrooms, a living room with open kitchen and 1 bathroom. Air conditioning is available in the living room and master bedroom. The second bedroom has 3 single beds and a fan is provided. Airport transfer and flexible check-in available.

reviews.text: Good location, corner shop, bakery and restaurants very nearby. Convenient to walk to Sultanahmet and easy to get to tram stop to explore Istanbul. Unfortunately the apartment was not clean, the bedding had not been changed and there were hairs and stains on the duvet cover. We raised this with the host who sorted it out the following day. Apartment is smaller than it looks on the pictures. The bathroom was very rundown, needs updating, shower was mouldy and unclean. Sadly very unpleasant to use. The apartment in general needed a thorough clean, dust underneath the beds and sofas.

The location of the apartment was ideal. 150 meters away from Kadirga Park and 70 meters away from the main street where there are restaurants, bakeries and Turkish delight shops. 700 m walking distance to Sultanahmet Square along above mentioned street.
The apartment owner Emir was very kind and helpful. He helped with his valuable recommendations.
Although the shower needed a renovation, the apartment was generally clean.
Overall, the apartment is worth staying in due to its perfect location and price as well.
Next time when I travel to Istanbul, I will definitely choose this apartment.

Kubra’s place was perfect for our Istanbul trip, it was clean spacious and exactly as described. It is located on a quieter street in the old town, just a walk away to the main transport systems, restaurants and lots of shops nearby. The flat had everything we needed for our trip and Kubra was lovely and very helpful whenever we needed him.

we enjoyed 8 nights staying in this place. The kitchen has everything you need for cooking,the beds were comfortable, cozy dining room, possibility to dry clothes on the balcony. it was enough space for 4 people .The host provided us everything we need. We love the place.just need to walk up to Sultanahmet that was a great exercise! And you need to get used to some street noise,but ear plugs were very helpful

Pros - attentive host, comfortable beds, close to everything you want to see in Old Town. The AC worked great also.
Cons - bathroom needs serious maintenance, dust under the beds.

description: Our facility is centrally located and within walking distance to many tourist attractions (Sultanahmet, Grand Bazaar, Galata Bridge, Taksim, etc.). Our facility has been completely renovated and is at the service of our valued guests. We have 24/7 reception and cleaning services. The comfort and health of our guests is of utmost importance to us. Therefore, we would like to point out that alcohol and smoking are not allowed in our facility.

reviews.text: The place was excellent as you can walk around to visit most tourist sites, the only thing disturbed was the three rooms were not for one family who can move freely in between because the camera was set in between rooms. Yes as a family I’m not going to hire it again but I advise people who want to hire only one room it is perfect, clean, comfortable, very nice staff in reception, helpful and respectful… rooms are very clean 5 stars .. I like it

Halil Is an amazing receptionist very responsive and helpful, the best hotel I've stayed in, in Istanbul, the rooms were absolutely perfect as seen on images, very large snd i was satisfied 100%
Very clean prestine condition hotel

Gerçekten güzel biryer odalar gayet temiz duş/tuvalet olanakları oldukça yeterli ve temiz görevli çok dost canlısı güleryüzlü bir kişi burayı düşünürseniz kesinlikle tercih edebilirsiniz 6 kişi çok memnun kaldık

The place was booked for 7 people to share the house. the receptionist said we were not allowed in as the place is only for 6 people and we had to book another room at the last minute. the communications were clear on 7 people staying the night as it was advertised but the receptionist who didnt speak English asked us to pay for an extra room which was cheaper that Airbnb. next day i requested a refund and the that did not happen.
very kind hosts, great location

description:
Cozy Taksim Apartment: Your Urban Oasis
Located on the 5th floor of a historic building with no elevator, the stairs offer a healthy workout leading to a spacious, charming retreat.
Despite being just a 5-minute walk from Taksim Square, Istiklal Street, Asmali Mescit, and the historic Fish Market, offering effortless access to the very best of the city. The apartment remains a remarkably quiet and serene escape, offering effortless access to the best of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
First of all, I'd like to appreciate Nurten as host for the spot-on and kind proactive assistance.
Nurten's house is located on the little street within walking distance to Taksim square and Istiklal street. Also, it was a vibrant pleasure to discover old city locations such as Galata Tower, Aya-Sofia, Constantinople Walls, etc.
After walking, I felt like I was coming home cause we hadn't got any issues with any kind of noise, electricity, or water pressure.
Wonderful staircase may see a little bit challenging, but I fall in love with atmospheric vintage entrance.
Only one thing could be fixed: the base of the shower door is leaking, causing a puddle to form on the bathroom floor during long showers. Overall, it's not so critical and doesn't change anything in my review.
Summarising, this apartment will stay in my heart as most vibe, friendly, and good located home in Istanbul. Honestly, I'd like to stay live on this flat forever.
A good acomodation, not exactly in Taksim Square, but good price, very clean, and cheap paid parking nearby. I recomend for those who look a bargain in Istanbul.

Excellent accodomation and such a lovely space. Great location and amazing host. Nurten responded to our messages and our questions very quickly and was so kind. The space was very clean and we really enjoyed our stay. We will be back! Thank you, Nurten! 🌸
Lovely, clean, and furnished with taste flat in a great location. The host was very welcoming and easy to communicate with. Would definitely come back!

We had a great stay at Nurten's place. The apartment is charming, quiet and comfortable. The location is wonderful - within 5 minutes walk of Istiklal and many restaurants, grocery stores and shops. My favorite part was how well I slept there - the place is very quiet despite being in the middle of a large city. I would absolutely stay here again.

description:
An Exclusive and Central Accommodation Experience at Imperium No1 Residence
Our secure apartment, which is only 5 minutes away from Şişli, offers quick and easy access to historical places, shopping areas, luxury restaurants and vibrant city life. Our residence, which has modern architecture and 24/7 security service, is meticulously designed for guests seeking comfort and prestige in a central location.
Whether it's a business trip or a family vacation, we'd love to welcome you to our apartment 💕

reviews.text: This place was absolutely amazing. Description and photos just like the listing. It was clean, spacious and comfortable. There are 3 good sized bedrooms, one with en-suite and another bathroom for the other two bedrooms. The kitchen was clean and fully equipped. Bathrooms were also spotless and smelt lovely. The apartment is in a secure building block with a lift and manned reception area. The area is around 15-20mins from the centre by car and easily accessible to most areas. There are lots of small shops/cafes and supermarkets within walking distance. I can’t recommend this apartment enough and would definitely stay again. Yasin was also a wonderful host, very responsive and helped with any questions we had during our stay.

We had an amazing stay at this apartment! The location is perfect—close to everything you need in Istanbul—and the place was spotless, with all the necessary amenities provided. We don’t usually trust listings based solely on pictures, but this flat was exactly as described.
We especially appreciated the option for in-between stay cleaning (available at a small extra cost), which we took advantage of. Our host was fantastic—very responsive, helpful, and regularly checked in to make sure we were comfortable.
We will definitely aim to stay here every time we visit Istanbul. Thank you for everything! Highly recommended.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything we needed. The location was excellent and convenient for getting around. Yasin was a fantastic host: friendly, responsive, and always ready to help. Check-in and check-out were smooth, making the whole experience stress-free. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay. Thank you for the amazing hospitality!

Yasin was very responsive and helpful. House was very clean and exactly as described. Place was close to market, pharmacy, taxi station, hospital. 2 minutes walking distance
It was 20 minutes drive to Taksim.
All in all I was pleased and I recommend this place.

Yasin's place was great. Very clean and well-equipped. He was extremely responsive and addressed every request we had. The place is on the 7th floor and very spacious and bright. Every room has its own AC which is awesome. It's very close to a lot of grocery stores and bakeries. The bus station is 5-6 mins away. The gym and parking are very convenient. We absolutely enjoyed our stay.
Thank you very much Yasin for this well-kept place. I hope it stays like this for our next visit :)

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: If you can get through the stairs this home layout is quite nice the couch in the living room is full size sectional and the bed is separate. The shower the first day did have a hose issue but the host send to fix it same day. Shower and bath are in one space so interesting first time doing a shower bath in one reminded me of a camper shower. Overall good the only last thing I thought could be more considered is the check out, communication with the host seemed fine but the cleaning lady that arrived to get us out was quite rude in her way of delivering information about the late check out communication. But to top it off she complaint about how we left the dishes in the sink which seemed kind of ironic as I belive she was paid for that in the cleaning fee.

Very accommodating and helpful host, 5 min from tram T1 with the closest station Beyazit Cesmesi (close to Grand bazaar). From here, it is easy to get to and from tourist attractions and connecting stations that enable visiting the Asian side, as well as to and from Sabiha Gökcen Airport. It is also possible to walk from here to and from tourist attractions on the European side, following the main road where the tram goes, but the terrain is often steep and narrow, with people and traffic.
The apartment, Celine 4 is clean and spacious enough for two. The apartment is located in a street where there are many workshops and locals, so it's private and more authentic that way. However, there is no elevator, and the stairs to the apartment are narrow and steep, making it difficult for people with large and heavy luggage and/or a stroller to carry them up and down. The bathroom is small but functional and in need of improvement: it drips from the pipe above. Overall, great place to stay!

Great place! Very good location! Very close to the Grand Bazaar and The Blue Mosque, 10-10 minutes of walking. Also the tram is very close, just about 5 minutes away. The airport shuttle bus dropped us fairly close to the apartment too, although we didn’t have big luggages, but if anyone has, that could be a huge plus. The host was very friendly, very helpful and responsive, and we could check in earlier too. The apartment itself was clean, we didn’t use the kitchen, but there were all sorts of cooking equipments in there too if you need anything. It is perfect for a few nights stay.

The host was extremely responsive, very helpful for airport transfer and all other information. The location was close to restaurants towards attractions and less than a five minute walk to the grand bazar. The room itself was perfect for two people, the kitchen was full, the hot water was perfect. Overall, I would definitely stay here again. Thank you very very much for everything :)

For the price you pay, Aydın's place is great and is as described and shown in the photos—close to the main sites in Sultanahmet, and everything works fine. Aydın is easy to communicate with, and very responsive to any questions you have!

description: This special place is close to everything and makes it easy to plan your trip. You will have a great accommodation experience for large families and groups of friends. Everything has been carefully prepared to make you feel at home, you can watch all of Istanbul from the balcony.

reviews.text:
We had an excellent stay at G.A Delüx Dublex. The apartment was exactly as described — clean, tidy, and very comfortable. Everything was well prepared, and we truly felt at home during our stay.
Gökhan was an outstanding host: extremely responsive and always ready to help at any time. Every time he contacted us, he was kind, welcoming, and made sure everything was alright, asking if we needed anything. Communication was smooth and effortless, and both check-in and check-out instructions were clear and easy to follow.
He also helped us arrange a private luxury van to the airport at a discounted price using his name, which was very convenient and much appreciated.
We really enjoyed our stay and made sure to leave the place clean and tidy as well. Highly recommended — we would definitely stay here again!

The place is nice, clean, and well-maintained, exactly as shown in the photos. We had a very comfortable stay throughout our visit. Gokhan, the host was kind and very accommodating, checking in with us almost every day to ensure everything was fine and to see if we needed anything.
The house is located about a 600-metre (around 8-minute) walk from Taksim, which is very convenient. However, the route is quite hilly, and you will need to walk up a steep road when going to and returning from Taksim. The unit we stayed in is on the third floor, which may be slightly challenging if you are travelling with large or heavy luggage.
Overall, this place is highly recommended and offers a pleasant stay.

Konaklamamız boyunca her şey beklentilerimizin de ötesindeydi. Ev son derece temiz, düzenli ve konforluydu. İlan fotoğraflarında gördüğümüz her şey birebir aynıydı, hatta gerçekte çok daha güzel olduğunu söyleyebiliriz. Evde ihtiyaç duyabileceğimiz her şey düşünülmüş, bu da kendimizi rahat ve evimizde hissetmemizi sağladı.
Ev sahibimiz baştan sona çok ilgili, nazik ve yardımseverdi. İletişim konusunda son derece hızlı dönüş yaptı ve tüm sorularımızı içtenlikle yanıtladı. Giriş ve çıkış süreçleri oldukça kolay ve sorunsuz geçti. Misafirlerine değer verdiği her detaydan belli oluyordu.
Konumu, temizliği, konforu ve ev sahibinin misafirperverliği sayesinde unutulmaz bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. Bu bölgeyi ziyaret edecek herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz. Bize bu kadar güzel bir deneyim yaşattığı için ev sahibimize tekrar teşekkür ediyor, gelecekte tekrar konaklama fırsatı bulmayı umuyoruz.

7 kişi olmamıza rağmen apartta çok rahat bir şekilde kaldık. Ev çok rahat, temiz ve konforluydu. İhtiyacımız olan her şey mevcuttu. Televizyon vardı ve Wi-Fi de çok iyi çalışıyordu.
Konumu da oldukça merkezi ve ulaşımı kolaydı. Yakınlarda marketler vardı ve çevrede ihtiyacımız olan her şeye kolayca ulaşabildik.
Ev sahibi de çok ilgili ve nazikti. Her gün bize her şeyin yolunda ve bir şeye ihtiyacımız olup olmadığını soruyordu. Kendimizi gerçekten çok rahat ve iyi hissettik. KESINLIKLE tavsiye ederiz!!!

Gokhan is a wonderful host, always checking on us to ensure everything was OK. He also arranged for airport pickup and drop off. He was very flexible.
The apartment is neat and clean and as described. The location is very very close to Taksim Square which served us very well. I really recommend this apartment.

description: Custom-renovated house in the historic area of Fener/Balat, within the walls of the Old City of Constantinople. Four separate flats, each with bedroom, bathroom, kitchen plus living room with sofa bed. Internet. 150 m2. Easy access to all Istanbul's most important sites. 15 minutes to Taksim and Sultanahmet by taxi. Tram, bus and ferry to all the other popular areas and it takes only 5-10 minutes walk to get to those stations from my house.

reviews.text:
We traveled as a big group with seniors and kids in Istanbul and stayed at Lindsay’s place in April. I don’t know where to begin to say how wonderful our host was. To name a few outstanding service moments are below:
1. Turkish airlines made an error about our arrival date which derailed the start of our holiday, she was understanding and gave us a partial refund of the first night, after meeting our group she gave us a tour of the charming neighborhood of Fener Balat. She even wrote to the airline about our complaint.
2. She responds super fast to questions we have about the house, neighborhood, and places to visit. It really is like having a personal concierge
3. She asked her cleaner to accompany us to nearby restaurants so we could buy rice meals for the kids! Since we are Filipino, kids are not used to eating bread or pasta
4. We lost a stroller near the house and thru her CCTV she found it for us
5. She was so accomodating to our requests, really easy to talk to. A big advantage for those traveling with small kids.
I must say that our host made all the difference of our stay, in this day and age there are so many choices of hotels and BNB’s out there but having a host that is so sympathetic, professional, and genuinely caring makes a world of difference. Thank you Isil for making our family holiday stress- free and memorable.
The space is perfect for several families with kids. Each space has an en suite toilet and kitchen. There is a washer, dishwasher. Seniors can stay the the ground floor and the younger ones can climb up the stairs to the higher apartments.
I loved the neighborhood. Will come back here again when it is just me and my husband. There are many cool bars, restauarnts, coffee shops. It’s an artsy district really nice design and antique places!
We were a group of 12 Isil hooked us up with a minibus that drover around for us everywhere so we just get picked up and dropped off.

Oh my goodness!!! Where do I begin with this review? This was our first trip to Turkey, first booking with Airbnb, and first international family reunion. Four families, fifteen people with 70 years age difference between the oldest and the youngest family members. Seven of us traveling from America and eight from Iran, arriving and departing at different times and I was the one planning it all. You can imagine what kind of concerns I had regarding accommodation, transportation, and coordination of activities for all of us. This trip was my dream trip to bring my family from East and West together and what city is better than Istanbul to do that?It was the first time that my parents, brother and his family, and my sister were meeting my 21 year son, and seeing the rest of the family after 6 years. This was the first time we were meeting my youngest nephew and my sister's fiance, our newest family members. Too many first time experiences for all of us and too special for me. I wanted everything to be perfect. Not having any experience with Turkey and Airbnb, I relied on reviews to pick this place that could fit all of us and have a trustworthy and helpful host. Thank God I did...You can see in all the reviews how others have described their experience with the lovely and helpful host, Lindsay. Let me tell you that with all the nice things you read about her, you still can't imagine how wonderful she is until you meet her!! I must have done something right that God connected me with her on my first trip to Turkey and first booking with Airbnb. From the very first text message that we exchanged before I book her place until we returned from the vacation to America, every single interaction with Lindsay was simply fantastic! She helped me in every step and in every possible way, from finding a minibus and negotiation a very reasonable rate with the driver (definitely look into it if you are more than 4 people) to calling the airport and check on our delayed baggage, finding best activities for my family to do, recommending places to see/eat/shop, checking ferry schedules and routes, giving us a tour of the neighborhood and market place, and even making us turkish coffee at home for us to have homemade authentic Turkish coffee...the list of her help goes on. We all were just in awe of her! I honestly do not know how I would have managed this trip without her help. She is just amazing!
The house has everything you need, I mean everything. We all loved the location which is in the older neighborhood so you get the authentic experience of Turkey's culture and its beautiful people. It is close to all the sights in Istanbul and you have access to all kinds of transportation to go around. It is also 5 minutes walk to local shops and restaurants. The neighborhood is very very safe and people are just lovely and very friendly. My young daughters and sister would go to the near coffee shop, Nest Cafe, at midnight and walk around the neighborhood without any issue. If you are traveling to have a cultural experience and the local life, this place will give you that. We totally loved it!
Istanbul....uuuffff I am in love with this city!! Beautiful! Beautiful!! Beautiful!!! Unbelievable history and culture, breathtaking landscapes and sceneries, delicious food, gorgeous weather, fantastic shopping bazars and malls, friendly and kind people...this city is simply amazing! We can't wait to go back!
Our first largr family trip to Turkey was amazing and unforgettable! I can't tell you how grateful I am that God connected us with Lindsay. I thought I was renting an apartment but God connected me with my soul sister. I highly recommend her and her place.
My dear Lindsay, Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart for everything you did for us. We all love you and greatly appreciate you. I can't wait to come back and see more of your beautiful city and sweet people. Next time you and I need to spend more. We are already planning our next visit 😇🙏 God bless you my dear sister, friend and Angel in Istanbul ❤😘🤗🙏

Stayed at the apartment for 4 nights in March 2019. It’s located in the Fatih district - inside the historical city of Constantinople.
The neighborhood is quite local - read not very touristy. Still there are a number of shops and good value local restaurants within an easy walk.
The Chora Church is about a 15 walk north, while Sultanahmet is perhaps a 45 minutes, with cabs being easy to get on the main road.
The house itself is several renovated flats combined to form one unit, spread across 4 levels. So if your traveling with a group it’s a good option to have both common spaces and some privacy. Just be prepared for many sets of stairs.
Our host went above and beyond to help us during this stay. She met us at the house on arrival, was extremely friendly and gave us a lot of good local tips. At the end of the stay she was very helpful in setting up return transportation to the airport. I would highly recommend her property, especially if you’re interested in visiting/staying in the most historic areas of Istanbul.

A comfort and secure place to stay. There are 2 small grocery shops nearby if you want to buy foods or other supplies. The place is also nearby some coffee shops and restaurants so there is no worries of where to have breakfast, lunch or dinner. It is located at a friendly neighborhood so there are kids playing soccer on the street at night. You will feel the friendly community. You also can get a lot of guidance or tips from the host, she is very friendly and helpful. She always take our comfort as her first priority. The place is also very clean.

The apartment was clean,the host was helpful and kind, and the location is wonderful for your trip to Balat! The apartment had what we needed such as hair dryer, washing machine, refrigerator , AC wall units, tea pot, coffee pot for brewing a delicious cup of Turkish coffee which we had the pleasure of enjoying with the host who was a lovely ambassador for the people of Türkiye. There are lovely tea/pastry shops around, fresh juice, small convenience stores as well as some restaurants in the area. Do yourself a favor and ask the host for a little tour of the area. She’ll take you to the best tea shop with the best pastries. I definitely would come back and stay here.

description: ou'll have a great time at this comfortable place to stay.

reviews.text: Cozy little apartment. Very close to a metro station and close to Nişantaşı which is great to walk around in. The Receptionist spoke fluent english and was very friendly. Apartment was clean, and comfortable bed. Would recommend for the price and great location!

The place looks like the photos, in a very good location, very close to the metro station, and lots of cafes are nearby, walkable distance (only few minutes )from Nișantași which is a lively lovely area.
There is a reception 24 hr so you can check in at any time easily. And the receptionists are nice and friendly.
The room is spacious for 1 person (or 2) and located in the ground floor.
Good place for few nights.

Çok teşekkür ederiz , metroya çok yakın merkezi konumda olan dairede kendi evimizde gibi hissettik, banyo duş harikaydı sıcacık su ve mini dolap çalıştırılmış bir şekilde bekliyordu , içeceklerimizi rahatça buzdolabına koyabildik , şehir dışından gelen misafirlerim için ideal bir ev ortamı , Yusuf beye teşekkür ederiz , sadece ricam su bardağı ve kadeh de olur ise çok seviniriz :) Bir de sehpa olursa , tv karşısında otururken bardaklarımızı koyabiliriz :) sanırım çok ev gibi hissettik ve teşekkürler herşey için 🙏

This location is in the center of everything. The flat has been remodeled. The staff of hosts are polite and always accommodating. This Airbnb is professionally run as a business/Hotel. It’s top class.
Yusuf Bey çok yardımcı oldu, ev fotoğraflarda tam gösterildiği gibiydi. Metroya da çok yakın olması büyük artı.

description: Enjoy easy access to everything from this place in a perfect location.

reviews.text:
Yatak odasındaki sürgülü kapı direkt olarak yangın merdivenine çıkıyordu, burada bir sıkıntı yok tabii ki. Fakat kapı kilitlenmiyordu. Herhangi bir odadaki birisi yangın merdiveninden çok rahat bir şekilde sürgülü cam kapıyı çekerek odaya girebilirdi.

Bunların dışında yatak kenarındaki sehpalar çok tozuydu.
Bunlar dışında bir sıkıntı yok oda aynı gösterildiği gibi, pencere kilitlenmeme olayı olmasa fiyatına göre uygundu ve genişti.

yusuf was very friendly and helpful he was available 24/7 and answers all messages promptly.
house was very clean
there is no smell in the hotel room which was very important to me(i had experience from previous hotels where restaurants cooking smell was always in the room).
all amenities available
highly reccomended
Temiz, düzenli, iyi iletişim. 10 üzerinden 10.
It was decent place but very affordable priced well
evi temizliği harika dediğimi bi sıkıntı yok

description:
Your suite with balcony is located in Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, one of the liveliest areas of Istanbul

With 24/7 transportation, you can easily reach every corner of the city and discover shopping, entertainment, coastal walks and places with Bosphorus views in minutes

I provide comfort and 24/7 reception support where my guests can feel at home

There is also a terrace with a view of the Bosphorus in the common area within the facility

reviews.text:
We loved our stay in Istanbul and at this Airbnb! The location is awesome, walkable with public transport nearby. Just five minutes away there is a huge shopping street as well as many bars and cute shops. We felt comfortable and safe, even at night. It’s quiet and peaceful, everyone sharing the place with us was decent and nice. Faith and his coworkers communicated well and responded fast, they welcomed us with homemade coffee and were extremely friendly. Would also recommend for vegans, we ate amazing Turkish food. Our favorite part was the terrance for sure. Amazing views and just cool!
Our main problem was the AC. It was broken and dripping water, someone came to repair it and they left the bed and floor covered in dust and dirt. We had to ask a few times for it to get cleaned, which was quite frustrating. The Airbnb was also missing a few amenities, like a hairdryer and shampoo. Wasn’t horrible, we would’ve liked transparency though.
Overall, we definitely recommend to all!

I had a wonderful stay! The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect — close to shops, restaurants, and main attractions. The host was kind, responsive, and made check-in very easy. I really appreciated the small touches that made the stay feel welcoming. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others. Thank you for the great hospitality!

Konaklamam boyunca her şey beklediğimden çok daha iyiydi. Oda tertemiz, düzenli ve oldukça konforluydu. Konumu ulaşım açısından çok avantajlıydı ve ihtiyaç duyduğum her şey mevcuttu. Ev sahibi son derece nazik, ilgili ve iletişimi güçlüydü. Kendimi evimde gibi hissettim. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye edebileceğim harika bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadım. Tekrar aynı bölgeye gelirsem kesinlikle burada kalmayı tercih ederim. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederim.

I had an amazing stay at Galata Room’s place in Istanbul! The apartment was spotless and exactly as described. The location in Taksim was perfect—central enough to walk to major sites but situated on a surprisingly quiet street. Yussef and the other guys were incredibly helpful. The Bosporus views from the terrace were the highlight of my trip. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a cozy, authentic base in the city!

The room was exactly like the pictures and the location was a 5 min downhill walk from istiklal. Everything was clean and tidy. The host was very responsive and kind. I especially loved the private balcony of the room. Thank you!

description:
A spacious and elegant 3-bedroom apartment on the 2nd floor of a historic building in the heart of Galata.
With its high ceilings, fully equipped kitchen, and air-conditioned rooms, it offers both comfort and character.
Only 2 minutes from Galata Tower and 5 minutes from Istiklal Street, with easy access to metro, tram, and ferry lines.
Perfect for exploring the city — whether it’s your first visit or your favorite return.
You’ll feel at home in the most authentic part of Istanbul.

reviews.text: The host is very friendly, proactive and helpful. The spacious apartment was clean and well-prepared. There are AC in each bedroom and living room. The location is convenient to get to the port, red tram of the 16th century, grand bazaar and other places. Also there are a lot of nice and cozy places for breakfast.

First of all the host is really helpful and cooperative, always responsive and was kind enough to help us with the luggage during check-in and check-out. Location is great though it’s located on a downhill so if going to istiklal street you will have to walk up a kind of steep hill. The apartment is the same as described and the photos.

Sergie was very responsive from day one and he helped us with everything that we needed. The location of the apartment is a couple minutes walk from the Galata Tower with lots of restaurants and shops around. For those that difficulties going up the stairs, they have to keep in mind that the apartment is on the second floor, however, the views are very nice and the apartment is extremely clean.

We had a great time at Sergei's, it is right in the heart of all the fun. The apartment is peaceful and not noisy despite being on one of the busiest streets in Beyoğlu. Public transport is easily accessible.
The apartment was as described/ shown, clean and spacious. Would recommend to anyone wanting to experience Istanbul as a tourist!

The place is absolutely great! Perfect location, right in the heart of all tourist streets, a supermarket in 2 min walk. We didn’t hear any noise from the streets though. Sergei is also very helpful and responsive. Thank you

description: Welcome to our stylish and comfortable 2-room apartment in the center of Istanbul, which offers access to historical places such as Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Topkapı Palace and the Grand Bazaar in 10 minutes, only 1 minute to the tram, 5 minutes to the metro. Ideal for families, travelers and business travelers. Air-conditioned, fast Wi-Fi, fully equipped kitchen, baby crib, professional cleaning service await you. 5 minutes to the Eurasia Tunnel, very close to the metro and Marmaray.

reviews.text:
This apartment was truly ideal and exactly as described.
From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the fantastic location—just a relaxing walk to the Hagia Sophia and Grand Bazaar or other mosques.
Tram stop and metro station conveniently nearby, making it easy to get around Istanbul.
There’s also a minimarket right at the entrance, making shopping for essentials incredibly easy (water, even diapers for little ones!) and several bakeries within walking distance (check Set Elsam wihin 5-7 min walk).

The apartment itself is beautifully furnished and very well equipped. The host went above and beyond by providing thoughtful extras like dishwasher tablets, toilet paper, laundry detergent, and fabric softener + of course a bay bed/cot. We stayed in a lot of places but this one was really impressive.
The kitchen was stocked with tea, sugar, and salt, which made our stay even more comfortable. Each of the three rooms had air conditioning, which was a real blessing.
Internet .

A spacious and clean apartment, tastefully decorated. It is located in an old building but has been well renovated. There is a cozy seating area and a TV with Netflix, which the kids really enjoyed. The apartment is fully equipped with everything you need. The washing machine was very useful for us. It’s a 3–5 minute walk to the Yusufpaşa tram station, making it easy to reach many central places like the Grand Bazar, Sultanahmet, Sirkeci, and Eminönü.
The host was very kind and responsive, answering every question quickly. Check-in and check-out were smooth and convenient.
The only downside is that the curtains in the kitchen and living room are transparent, which doesn’t allow for much privacy. Also the balcony doors didn't have locks which is not safe for children.
Highly recommended. Thank you Esra.

We had a wonderful stay in this apartment in Istanbul. The flat is very spacious, stylish, and tastefully designed. It’s clean, comfortable, and fully equipped with everything you might need.
The location is great and convenient for exploring the city.
The host is amazing — very kind, responsive, and always ready to help. She made sure everything was perfect during our stay.
Even my children loved the place — they felt right at home.
I highly recommend this apartment and would definitely love to stay here again!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Israa’s apartment!
The apartment is beautifully maintained, very clean, and perfectly equipped for a comfortable stay. Israa herself was incredibly kind, helpful, and attentive — she made sure our stay was smooth and enjoyable.
We stayed with my family for about a week, and it truly felt like home. The location is perfect, close to everything we needed — shops, restaurants, and public transport — making it easy to explore the city.
We highly recommend staying at Israa’s place and would love to come back again in the future!

description:
In the centre of Istanbul, located within a short distance of Taksim Square and Taksim Metro Station, fully-furnished Historical Flat in Galata offers free WiFi. With garden views, this accommodation provides a terrace.

The spacious non-smoking flat is equipped with 2 bedrooms, 1 fully equipped kitchen and 1,5 bathroom. Towels and bed linen are provided.

reviews.text: Sevim was a great host, responsive and helpful. The apartment its just as described clean and cozy in a historical building less than 1 block from galata tower with lots to see and do around and nearby. I would want to stay here again in a future trip!!

The apartment was clean and comfortable and had everything we needed. The location is excellent - very close to the Galata Tower area, but on a less busy side street, and only 10 minutes walk to Galata Bridge and the trams. Be aware there is a little bit of noise from the street in one of the bedrooms, but it wasn’t a problem for us. The host was extremely friendly and helpful and we would definitely recommend this apartment for a stay in Istanbul.

We had a fabulous time in this beautiful apartment. We received the warmest of welcomes from Sevim, including a birthday gift for me! - so kind and thoughtful, thank you :) The location is fabulous, with great cafes and restaurants nearby and it's easy walking distance to the historic Fatih district and for taking the ferry to explore the Asian side of Istanbul. In other words, it's the perfect location. and a super comfortable and cosy base to explore the city.

The location was fantastic.
Sevim’s niece came to meet us to hand the keys. She was very friendly and helpful.
The apartment is exactly as the pictures in the web.
The street is quiet and next to Galata Tower.
I will definitely stay there again in my next visit to Istanbul.

Hemos estado genial en la casa de Sevim. Está en Gálata,zona bulliciosa pero en la que tienes todos los servicios. La calle es muy tranquila y te olvidas del ruido. Your architecturally designed apartment is located in one of the world's coolest neighborhoods, one of Istanbul's most popular locations, in the center of Kadıköy, within walking distance to the beach

reviews.text:
A clean and comfortable apartment with a nice bed and desk for working. The host is communicative and helpful.
The apartment is located above a bar and it is loud at night, making it difficult to sleep.
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very helpful and responsive. I really enjoyed my stay and will definitely come back again. Thank you!

You get what you pay for given the price and location. Unfortunately the bed and pillows were really uncomfortable for both me and my friend. If you’re planning on staying for more than a few days, definitely keep that in mind because our sleep was suffering more with every passing day. The windows don’t have screens which wasn’t a problem in November because the weather is pretty much perfect, but there were so many mosquitos biting us in our sleep. We are both covered in bites — I have at least 10 bites on my legs alone, several big ones on my back, and 2 on my face. If you really just need somewhere to sleep and shower and aren’t picky about those things, then it’s worth it.

Fatih Bey’e misafirperverliği için teşekkür ederiz. Ev oldukça temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Konumu gerçekten mükemmel; ulaşım, restoranlar ve gezilecek yerlere çok yakın olduğu için İstanbul gezimizi çok rahat geçirdik. Evde ihtiyacımız olan her şey mevcuttu ve giriş-çıkış süreci de sorunsuzdu. İstanbul’a tekrar gelirsek gönül rahatlığıyla tekrar tercih edebileceğimiz bir konaklama oldu. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederiz.

Fatih Bey son derece kibar, ilgili ve misafirperver bir ev sahibiydi. Daha ilk günden itibaren tüm iletişimimiz çok net ve açıklayıcıydı. Otopark gibi küçük ama önemli detaylarda bile yardımcı olması bizi ayrıca memnun etti. Konakladığımız ev hem yepyeni hem de tertemizdi; kendimizi adeta kendi evimizde gibi hissettik. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz, içimiz rahat bir şekilde tekrar tercih ederiz. 🙏✨

description: Experience peace and joy among the historical Greek houses, only 20 steps from the beach, in the heart of Arnavutköy's most popular cafes, restaurants and bars.”

The bathroom was small, it looked bigger in the photo.The dishes and pots in the kitchen were dusty, they hadn't been used in a while. I stayed for one night and it was ok.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. Passport or ID notification is required for guests.

reviews.text: Evin konumu cok iyi her yere kolaylikla ulasim saglayabiliyorsunuz, temizlik olarak da hic bir sorun yasanmadi gayet guzel temizlenmisti. Fiyatinin karsiligini veren bir yer cok memnun kaldik.

Very close to everything in Istanbul and very central area. 5 mins walk to Transportation, Sahil and Galataport. Would recommend it and Ferhat was very responsive and helpful.

Good location, close to Taksim and Kabatas.
Kitchen is small, washing machine located at basement (not in apartment).

Ferhat and his partner were incredibly warm and hospitable. I stayed for about 45 days, and they helped me a great deal, always responding to messages very promptly. The room was cleaned thoroughly. Furthermore, if you needed it during your stay, you could also request additional cleaning services. The room was very spacious and had two air conditioning units. There was a washing machine and a dryer on the basement floor.
Overall, I think this place is very suitable for a long-term stay. Right across the street, there is a café where the staff are also very friendly! In short, I highly recommend staying here.

reviews.text: yaz donemi için kalabalık gruplarla keyifli olabilir ancak kış donemi ve aile ortamı için pek rahat değildi. iletişim ve konumda problem yaşamadık ancak kapıların kilitlenmediğini gece fark ederek rahatsız olduk. Çocuklu bir grup olarak mutfak aletlerinin/ tabakların oldukça eksik olması ve salonda oturma alanı azlığı bizi zorladı. ev daha iyi temizlenebilir ozellikle yatak odasındaki koltuklarındaki lekeler rahatsızlık vericiydi, kimi yerlerde saçlar duruyordu. çarşafların utulu olmaması da ozensiz gösteriyordu. sauna vb kısmına bakmadığımız için yorum yazmıyorum. ev oldukca iyi ısınıyordu soguktan hiç etkilenmedik, dısarıda da keyifli oturduk. kısaca biz zorlanmamıza ragmen sıkıntı yaşamadan ayrıldık.

Maalesef konaklama deneyimimiz beklentimizin oldukça altında kaldı. Gecelik bu seviyede bir ücret ödenen bir evde en azından havlu, şampuan ve duş jeli gibi temel ihtiyaçların bulunmasını beklerdim. Bunların hiçbiri yoktu, el havlusu bile yoktu. Evin temizliği de yetersizdi. Çarşaflar, yastık kılıfları ve yorganlar temiz hissi vermiyordu. Yatak odalarındaki eşyalar eski ve yıpranmıştı, duvarda rutubet benzeri izler vardı. Salon dışında ev genel olarak bakımsızdı. Olumlu tarafları ise evin 12 kişilik kapasitesi, geniş ve güzel bahçesi, yeterli büyüklükte havuzu, orman manzarası ve çevreden tamamen izole olmasıydı. Ancak bu eksikler giderilmediği sürece tekrar tercih etmem.
Yatak ve carsaflar oldukca temizdi, havuzdan ve evin konumundan oldukca keyif aldik

Ne yazık ki konaklama deneyimimiz beklentilerimizin oldukça altında kaldı. Evdeki temizlik seviyesi kabul edilebilir standartların çok altındaydı; eve girişten kısa bir süre sonra çoraplarımızın simsiyah hale gelmesi + rutubet kokusu + BÖCEKLER genel hijyen durumunu açıkça göstermektedir.
Bunun yanı sıra evde ciddi bir güvenlik zafiyeti bulunmaktaydı. Evin içinde alt kata açılan bir kapı vardı ve bu kapı yalnızca dışarıdan kilitlenebiliyordu. Misafirlerin kendi alanlarını içeriden güvence altına alamaması, özellikle kadın misafirler açısından kendimizi güvende hissetmememize neden oldu. Bu kritik bilginin konaklama öncesinde tarafımıza hiç bildirilmemiş olması ayrıca ciddi bir sorundur.
Gece boyunca üst kattan gelen sürekli gürültü nedeniyle sabah 05.00’e kadar uyuyamadık. Bu durumu host’a iletmemize rağmen herhangi bir çözüm ya da iyileştirme sağlanmadı.
Temizlik, güvenlik ve konfor açısından temel beklentilerin karşılanmadığı, bizim için büyük bir hayal kırıklığı yaratan bir yerdi

Genel olarak beklentimizin üzerinde, çok memnun kaldığımız bir konaklama oldu; gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz.

description: There is Air conditioning all rooms. Our house is in the heart of Cihangir and has a parking lot a market underneath. It is the newest building in Cihangir. There is elevator and built according to earthquake rules :)

reviews.text: The host let me check in early, which I really appreciated. The house cleaner was cheerful and did excellent work...the apartment was spotless. The hosts felt more like older brothers looking out for me. As a female solo traveler, I especially appreciated how proactive they were about solving problems and making sure I was comfortable. They are on site daily in the office where you check in, but they also respond very quickly through the app at any hour. One night they came over immediately to help when my hot water ran out. They even took me shopping next door so I could buy the proper glass dishes for olives and cheese after I decided to make a Turkish breakfast. They also helped me get a French press and the pots and pans I needed for cooking.If you need help with anything, they are nearby, responsive, and ready to assist. That level of support was a real blessing. It felt like staying in a hotel with a front desk, except I also had the comfort and space of a full apartment.

The host was very welcoming. The check-in process was easy and smooth.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I definitely recommend it.
Having an elevator was a big plus.

We loved this new apartment! The building was really nice inside, with an elevator. The apartment was clean and comfortable. We really liked that there were nice coffee shops and a grocery store as soon as you stepped out. The host waited for us to arrive and helped us with our luggage. He’s very friendly and responsive. We would love to stay here again and will be recommending the place to our friends and family. The apartment is really close to everything and just a few minutes to Taksim square. Great location and great place!

Great location in Cihangir neighborhood. Apartment was clean but sparsely decorated (different from photos) and missing a few details. The main living room area had one floor lamp but no light bulb. There was no body wash nor shampoo in the bathroom, no extra pillows and no coffee maker. Miray was quick to response to any request and offer to buy us coffee at the coffee shop next door. Overall we loved the location and elevator.

Cihangirde harika konumda bir daire. Ev sahibi çok kibar ve ilgiliydi hızlı yanıt veriyordu. Evin tam karşısında otopark olması araçla seyahat açısından büyük rahatlıktı. Ev temiz ve düzenliydi teşekkürler
