reviews.text:
The house was exactly as described in the photos and description. Of course, hairdryer and iron were not mentined in the description, but they were there.
The kitchen utensils were sufficient, only the dishes and cutting board were missing, which we asked Emir and he kindly brought us quickly.
The rooms were completely clean and there was no hair on the beds. The toilet and bathroom were clean and there were toiletpaper. Overall, he responded quickly and helpfuly. The dining table could be enlarged and had an extra chair. The stairs to the apartment were smooth and not tiring. The location of the apartment was also excellent, with easy access to tourist areas.

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul. The surroundings are absolutely beautiful, it’s located very close to Galata, with a lovely port nearby and plenty of cute shops and great restaurants to explore.
The apartment itself is spacious, clean, and truly feels like home. It has everything you need for a comfortable stay, including all essentials for cooking and cleaning. The internet is reliable, and everything is well set up for a longer stay.
I stayed here for two weeks and honestly didn’t want to leave. I would definitely come back again if I visit Istanbul in the future.
Şaban was a fantastic host, very responsive, helpful, and always available to answer any questions.

Excellent 2+1 apartment in a perfect location, just a short walk from Galata Tower and many of the city’s main attractions. The neighborhood is beautiful, lively, and very convenient for exploring the city. The stairs are comfortable and easy to use, which is a big advantage in this area. The apartment owners were friendly, helpful, and always available when needed. We had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend this place.

The apartment is in a perfect location, just a 10-minute walk from Karaköy port and very close to the metro and tram. It was easy to reach from IST airport in about an hour.
Even though it’s in the city center, the street is quiet, so the stay was very peaceful. The apartment was very clean, nicely decorated, and well-equipped with everything we needed. The living room is spacious, and two people comfortably slept there, so there was plenty of space for all 6 of us during our 8-day stay. There is also access to a rooftop balcony with a beautiful view of the Bosphorus.
Our host, Şaban, was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. He also allowed us a late checkout since our flight was in the evening, which we really appreciated.
Overall, a great place to stay and we would definitely come back!

Location is excellent, with plenty of restaurants, cafes, and bars just around the corner, as well as great access to public transport.
I stayed during the summer, and the air conditioning in the living room was a lifesaver.
The unit was in level 4 with no lift.
The internet was decent for general use, though not ideal for heavy data transfers.
The equipment was basic but sufficient for a short stay in a lovely area.
The main downside was communication with the host, who was not very responsive. I had to send multiple messages about a broken fan and a TV power issue, neither of which were fixed before I checked out, despite that he promised to fix them in an hour.
To be safe regarding the promised airport transfer, I messaged at 11 pm the night before. Twelve hours later, when I followed up, he said we should have contacted him at least three hours in advance and that he was asleep when I messaged!! However, he had not checked or responded to the message in the morning either.

description: The apartment is located in the lively, historical and touristic Kadıköy Bazaar area. It is close to Kadıköy Coast, Fenerbahçe Stadium and many entertainment venues, bars, restaurants, Kadıköy fishermen's bazaar, performance stages and theater show centers. Since our apartment is located in the center of Kadıköy, it is within walking distance to all public transportation. I recommend that you make a reservation knowing that it is a 35-40 year old building and that there may be noise from the bars around and below it.

reviews.text: Considering great location and price, very reasonable place to stay. Just note that smoking is part of their culture so the place is not free of the smell. Area itself is very walkable to lots of restaurants, cafes and ferry station. Great for people who would like to enjoy drinking till late. Note the noise considering the surrounding. Great host.

Kadıköyde konakladığımız evden çok memnun kaldık. Ev hem çok temiz hem de bakımlıydı. İçeride kesinlikle sigara kokusu yoktu, bu bizim için büyük artı oldu. Konaklama açısından hem tek kişi hem de çiftler için oldukça uygun ve rahat bir yer. Konumu da çok avantajlı Kadıköy Barlar Sokağı’na yürüme mesafesinde, ulaşım ve sosyal olanaklar açısından çok pratik.
İletişim ve organizasyon süreci de gerçekten çok başarılıydı. Giriş çıkış işlemleri oldukça rahat ve sorunsuzdu. Anahtarı alırken ya da teslim ederken bire bir yetkiliyle iletişim kurmak zorunda kalmadık, her şey neredeyse kusursuz şekilde planlanmıştı. Ev sahibi hızlı ve ilgiliydi. Tekrar Kadıköyde ev kiralayacak olursam kesinlikle burayı tercih ederim.
Binanın altında pub da var orada da vakit geçirmenizi tavsiye ederim. Çalışanlar çok kibar ve anlayışlıydı. Her şey için teşekkürler

Gerek çok hızlı bir şekilde dönüş yapması, gerek esnek giriş çıkış imkanı sağlayıp yardımcı olması Biret Beyi tercih etmek için başlıca sebeplerden birkaç tanesi. Görsellerde sunulan fotoğraflarla, konum doğruluğuyla, daire içi temizliğiyle gerçekten çok rahat çok güzel bir konaklama geçirdim. Biret Beye sunduğu imkanlar ve ihtiyaçlarımızla en hızlı şekilde ilgilenmesinden dolayı teşekkürlerimi sunuyorum. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edip konaklayabilirsiniz.

Fiyatı makul, alternatif ilanlar arasında en geniş daireydi. Evin konumu çok iyi, Kadıköy'ün merkezinde. Görevli çok iyi ilgilendi. Girişimiz öncesi daire çok temiz şekilde hazırlanmıştı. Bina sahibi ve görevli kişi genel olarak ihtiyaçlarımızı karşılamaya yönelik çok yardımcı oldu.
Ev ile ilgili fotoğraflar gayet açıklayıcı. İlan bilgilendirmesinde de bahsedildiği gibi evin baktığı sokak sabah saatlerine kadar açık bazı mekanların bulunduğu ve gürültülü olabilen bir sokak.
Daire 8'de altı gece kaldım, dairenin duvarları nem almış idi genel olarak; havalandırmayı pencere açarak yapmak durumunda kalıyorduk, camlarda sineklik olmadığı için her zaman yapamadık. Bunun dışında bir eksiği yoktu. Açıkçası daire değişikliği de önerildi fakat yerleştikten sonra hareket etmek istemedim.
Muhit güzel, lezzet anlamında keşfedilecek çok çeşitli mutfaklar mevcut. Alışveriş, kültür turizm, gezi, yeme içme ve eğlence anlamında seçenekleri çok olan bir yer.

Güzel bir konumda, ilgili bir ev sahibi.
Fiyat performans olarak uygun. Temizdi.

description: Welcome to your modern city retreat! This bright and thoughtfully designed 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of comfort and creativity in the heart of Ortakoy. Set on a charming hillside in a vibrant neighborhood, you're just minutes away from local cafes, shops, and public transport. The area offers an authentic taste of local life while staying close to city highlights. Ideal for couples, solo travelers, or remote workers looking for a fresh and functional stay in Istanbul.

reviews.text: Through staying at VNG properties we had a extremely comfortable and relaxing experience. The apartment was modern, clean and spacious with all the necessary amenities to make our stay as homely as possible. In addition to the quality condition of the apartment, the location and the rooftop garden were an amazing extra in which we could get incredible views of Istanbul in the morning and afternoon. If you are looking for a place to stay on the European side, I would highly recommend VNG properties.

Having worked and holidayed in Istanbul many times, Ortaköy is by far my favourite area to stay. This listing sits up in the hills, and while my 83-year-old father managed beautifully, here's the system that worked perfectly for us: a slow 10-minute walk down the winding hills each morning, then the ferry from Ortaköy Mosque into town for sightseeing, trams to get around without sitting in traffic, and an Uber back up the hill each evening. The four of us loved this place, especially the communal rooftop, where we shared olives, cheese, bread and local wine while watching the Bosphorus - unbeatable views thanks to the height. The apartment has everything you need and is spotlessly clean, tucked away from the chaos of the city in a genuinely quiet pocket, which is exactly what we needed. There's even a little corner shop for essentials. And at the bottom of the hill, right by Ortaköy Mosque, you'll find all the shops, restaurants, supermarkets and cafés you could want. I will return.

Great tidy apartment very close to central area of Ortaköy, but on a small and quite street. Clean and comfortable, everything was great and the communication with the host went smooth and without any problems. Keep in mind that the building is uphill.
We are extremely happy ! Clean apartment, highly responsive host and a perfect location and view! Very recommended!

The studio was spacious and modern, no elevator but building is very quiet and nicely renovated, right across from other hotels and 5 min walk to Taksim/Istiklal. Its safe area

​Eve girdiğimizde yemek masası korkunç derecede lekeliydi, kullanamadık bile. Mutfakta tencere dahil hiçbir temel eşya yoktu, 2 küçücük tavayla rezil olduk. Rezervasyonda 1 büyük yatak istememize rağmen dalga geçer gibi 2 küçük yataklı oda verdiler, zar zor değiştirttik.

description: Clean, comfortable and safe. Central location, everything is at your fingertips. Guest satisfaction is my priority

reviews.text:
The pictures DOESN'T MATCH in terms of condition of the room.
The bathroom tiles are MOULDY on many parts and causes VERY BAD ODOUR. It was so bad that we had to keep all the windows open almost all the time we were there during the cold weather in March.
The hot water tap doesn't work. its tight and leaks. Even after addressing the issue, there was no proper response. we were told to use the main valve underneath the sink which is not OK!
Host gurbaan admits the mould is from long time and doesn't come off. We were asked to understand and adjust.
We were there for 5 days and couldn't use the toilet or shower. We asked for an alternate room and did change to different one downstairs. However its just a little better room with same bad smell in toilet.
only good thing about the place was location.
10 to 15 mins walk to major attractions and metros, ferries and trams.
the stairs to upstairs room was impractical, risky without railing and crooked which is not shown in the listing.

Kiraladığımız fiyat fena değildi. Islak havlu bırakılmıştı ama kullanmamız için temi havlu yoktu. Duşakabin kapısız, yani banyo duş alınırken malesef ıslanıyor. Yer havlusu da temiz hidsettirmedi. The only downside was that the shower cabin didn’t have a door, which made showering not very convenient. Other than that, everything went smoothly and I enjoyed my stay.

it was super nice! perfect location, in the center, but in a bit more quiet street. very accessible. our host was very kind and quick responses when we sent a message. only the bathroom was a little bit moldy, but for the rest everything was super clean!! I would recommend

reviews.text: Ev çok temizdi ve tarkan beyle iletişim kısmında hiçbir sorun yaşamadık. Sadece mahalledeki diğer sakinler geceleri biraz ses yapabiliyor. Great stay overall — the apartment was spotless, comfortable, and just like in the photos. Tarkan was very kind and responsive.
Only thing to note: there’s quite a bit of construction nearby and it can get really noisy, also some sounds carry through the hallway. Not a big issue, but if you’re looking for total quiet, just keep that in mind.

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Ev oldukça temiz, düzenli ve rahattı. Konumu merkezi olduğu için ulaşım açısından büyük kolaylık sağladı. Tarkan Bey ise son derece ilgili, yardımsever ve misafirperverdi. İhtiyaç duyduğumuz her konuda hızlıca yardımcı oldu ve iletişimi çok iyiydi. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye edebileceğimiz bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. Her şey için Tarkan Bey’e teşekkür ederiz.

I stayed at this Airbnb in Istanbul for eight days and had a great experience. The host was excellent with communication and always responded as quickly as possible whenever I had a question or needed assistance. The apartment was comfortable, well-maintained, and exactly as described. The host’s responsiveness and helpfulness made my stay smooth and enjoyable. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would be happy to stay here again.

Odadaki her şey beklentilerimizi karşıladı. Oda temiz, düzenli ve rahattı. Adresi kolayca bulduk ve Taksim Metro İstasyonu’ndan yaklaşık 15 dakikada ulaştık. İstiklal Caddesi’ne yürüyerek sadece 10 dakika mesafede. Yakınlarda birçok kafe, restoran ve market bulunuyor.

description:
Welcome to our modern and comfortable 1+1 apartment in the center of Istanbul.
You can prepare your meals in the fully equipped kitchen and enjoy the comfort of your home with a smart TV and high-speed fiber Wi-Fi.
You can always find a parking space in our apartment located in a building with 24/7 security.
You are a few minutes away from public transportation, shopping and restaurants.
If you need anything during your stay, there is an attendant who can take care of you 24/7.

reviews.text: İlk defa bu uygulamayı kullandım ve ilk seçeneğinde iyi bir tecrübe yaşadığım için kendimi çok şanslı hissediyorum korkmuştum açıkçası ve benim gibi bir çok insanın da bu kaygıya sahip olduğunu tahmin ediyorum benim isteğim biraz daha huzurlu ve iyi bir alandı ve bina sessizdi rahatça ders çalışabildim evin atmosferi çok huzurlu bir eve girdiğinizde onun enerjisini hissedersiniz tam olarak öyle ev sahibinin enerjisi eve yansımış. Konum olarak migros’a A1 101’e BİM’e yürüme mesafesinde yakında parkta var yürüyüş yapmak için çok güzel tatlı bir park. Evin önünden zaten metrobüs geçiyor aynı şekilde dolmuşlar da kullanışlı. Starbucks Burger King biraz yürüyüş yapmayı seviyorsunuz rahatlıkla gidebileceğiniz bir konumda ayrıca ev çok temizdi eve girdiğinizde hani o temizlik kokusu olur ya direk o kokuyordu. Bir şey danışacağım zaman ev sahibine kolaylıkla ulaşabildim ve yardımcı oldu o konuda içiniz çok rahat olsun ben bir kız olarak tek başıma rahatlıkla kalabildim.

Kız arkadaşımla birlikte çok güzel bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. Ev, kapıdan girdiğimiz andan itibaren beklentimizin çok üzerindeydi. Sadece fotoğraflardaki gibi değil, canlı haliyle çok daha etkileyici, ferah ve zevkle döşenmişti. Özellikle temizlik konusunda ev kelimenin tam anlamıyla pırıl pırıldı, her köşe özenle hazırlanmıştı. Konumu ise mükemmel,bu kadar huzurlu olması bizi çok mutlu etti. Esad Enishan Bey ise harika bir ev sahibi; iletişim konusunda çok hızlı, nazik ve her konuda yardımcıydı. Bize kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettirdiği için teşekkür ederiz. Hiç düşünmeden tekrar gelmek isteyeceğimiz, gözümüz kapalı tavsiye edebileceğimiz nadir yerlerden. 10/10!

I just happened to be in Istanbul during a bout of nasty winter weather, but the flat had excellent central heating, for which I was extremely grateful. It felt like a blessing to be inside. The bed was very comfortable, and the shower pressure was great. Mr. Esad, the host, was very nice and easy to communicate with. He even wrote halfway through my stay to ask how I was.
Enishan Bey her zaman kolay ulaşılabilen bir ev sahibi. Evin konumu oldukça merkezi... Ataşehir'e, çevreyolu ve metro bağlantılarına çok yakın. Güvenlik olması da ayrıca önemli bir artı.

Very beautiful and private residence, has a beautiful view of the district. Highly recommend staying here if you prefer privacy and a safe environment. The home was remarkably clean, a huge improvement of my other stays. Very very quiet home, can’t hear anything outside when the large windows are closed. And the host was extremely helpful and attentive

description: Enjoy easy access to everything from this place in a perfect location.

reviews.text:
Small cute hotel located off one of the main streets in Besiktas with many restaurants and bars. So you are near everything but on a quiet space, which is difficult to find in a bustling city like Istanbul an I really appreciated.
Host always responsive and helpful.
The room has everything you need, even a small kitchenette.

Best communication with the host I ever had. They were attentive since the very first moment, even before I booked. Top experience!

reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay! The room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The location was convenient, and the host was friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout my stay. Check-in was smooth, and all the amenities worked perfectly. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area and would happily stay here again.

This is a great place to stay! The employees were friendly and helpful, and the neighborhood was great. My room was in a quiet area, so it was peaceful and not noisy at all. The room had everything I needed for a comfortable stay.
And I absolutely loved the cat downstairs, it definitely made my stay even better

Consiglio a tutti di soggiornare qui, l'hotel è moderno, la stanza è molto pulita e la posizione della struttura è perfetta. Vale ogni singolo euro speso! Mi sono sentito come a casa. Omar è una persona speciale e lo ringrazio tantissimo. É stato gentile, accogliente, molto amichevole. Se dovessi tornare in turchia, riverrei sicuramente! Grazie mille 🙏
I recommend everyone to stay here. The hotel is modern, the room is very clean, and the location is perfect. It's worth every penny! I felt right at home. Omar is a special person, and I thank him so much. He was kind, welcoming, and very friendly. If I were to return to Turkey, I would definitely stay here again! Thank you so much 🙏

Un séjour globalement agréable. L'emplacement de l'hôtel est vraiment très bien, et le personnel est tout simplement top : accueillant, très gentil, avec un check-in et un check-out extrêmement simples et rapides.
Le ménage était bien fait et la chambre était propre, mais on regrette des traces d'usure (au sol, sur les portes et dans la salle de bain) qui ne correspondent pas tout à fait à l'impression de neuf laissée par les photos. À cela s'ajoute une légère odeur persistante en entrant dans la chambre qui est un peu dérangeante.
Heureusement, tout le reste était parfait : j'ai très bien dormi sans aucun bruit, et les équipements (Wi-Fi et climatisation) fonctionnent très bien.
Good place as described! Close to all attractions and train/ferry stations. Nice stuff, communication was on point!

description:
Experience Istanbul from this elegant and spacious boutique studio, ideally located just moments from the iconic Istiklal Avenue.
The sophisticated cafés and art-filled streets of Cihangir are within an easy 5–6 minute stroll. A rare blend of space, comfort, and prime location, perfect for guests seeking a boutique stay in the heart of Istanbul. The apartment is situated on the third floor of a five-story building.
There is an elevator available, ensuring easy and comfortable access for guests.

reviews.text:
My wife and I had a wonderful stay at Tolga’s place in Taksim. The apartment was surprisingly spacious and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit.
Tolga truly stood out as a host, he was attentive and caring, helping us with local recommendations, sorting out a minor internet issue, and even arranging our airport transfer.
The location is easy to find and ideally situated, not right on top of the noisy nightlife, but close enough to walk to the fun and food when we wanted.
The only small suggestion for improvement would be a slightly softer mattress. Otherwise, everything was excellent. Highly recommend!
It was really clean and flexible check in and close to Istiklal street as described, I really recommended

The apartment was extremely clean and brand new. The location is very central, just 1 minute walking distance to Istiklal Street. The host was very attentive, helpful, and knowledgeable. Everything was perfect. I would definitely recommend this place
It was really very good place clean and quiet and in city center as described and was my second time, I really recommend it.
Harika bir konaklamaydı! Ev tertemiz, çok konforlu ve tam olarak fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Ev sahibi başından sonuna kadar çok ilgili ve yardımseverdi. Tekrardsn teşekkürler ilgileri için.

description:
Welcome to Nobel Suites, a luxury 1+1 flat in a prime location.

Modern and stylishly furnished, it offers a bright living area, a cozy bedroom, and quality amenities for a comfortable stay.

Enjoy your private wellness room featuring a jacuzzi and sauna — perfect for relaxing in total privacy.

Located on the main avenue next to the 5-star Peninsula Hotel, steps from cafés, restaurants, shops, and tram access.

reviews.text:
We spent three wonderful days there. The accommodation and the host were fantastic. Everything was exactly as shown in the photos, if not even better.
The location is excellent, with easy access to the main attractions and a truly unique atmosphere. It is an amazing feeling to enjoy your jacuzzi while looking out over the Bosphorus and the Blue Mosque. The view is absolutely unforgettable.
As for Omar, what can I say? He was extremely helpful, an excellent host, and always available whenever we needed anything. He made our stay even more enjoyable.
Highly recommended.

1. Great location with lot of eatery. I recommend to buy Turkish sweets from the shop in the groundfloor.
2. Comfortable amenities in a very nice apartment.
3. Very friendly and helpful host.
If we return to Istanbul, we will stay here again.

Ömer's place is amazing! He is great host either, makes you feel like home. Really well located and super comfy. He also owns a shop downstairs where you can buy spices, teas, coffee, turkish delights, essential oils... it's really good. Also, next door, there is a great fish sandwich shop. You will have an amazing place staying here. Also, the sauna and the jacuzzi are a bonus track. 100% recommended
Hello, the location is perfect, accessible for all activities. The apartment is clean and the jacuzzi is a nice touch. Thank you for everything, see you next time.

Really enjoyed my stay at Omar’s place! He’s a very kind person, as are all the gentlemen downstairs working at the shop. They truly went above and beyond to help me, and I’m very grateful. The listing is exactly as described, and the sauna is a fantastic touch. Be sure to support their shop when you’re in Turkey! 🇹🇷
بارك الله لكم ودامت عليكم نعمه وبركاته.

description: A comfortable and cozy apartment in one of Istanbul's trendiest neighborhoods. The flat is situated on Siraselviler street overlooking the street and feels very spacious. The building, unlike many others in the area, has an elevator which provides easy access to the apartment. The flat is on the 5th floor.

reviews.text:
The apartment is very nice and has everything you need. It is on 5th floor of a 6 floor building. There are little steps before the elevator. The elevator is very nice and new, but also small. It says that 4 persons could fit, but I don't think more than 2 would be comfortable inside.
Suay is very responsive and communicative. She left the keys on a lock with a code so our late check in went smoothly. Place is very easy to find and it is close to the main street. You can walk from Taksim square to the apartment, it takes less than 10 minutes.
Inside of the apartment is cozy and light. Maybe the images should be updated. The couch in new and better now, and bed and couch from two bedrooms are swapped, which is better in my opinion. What you maybe cannot see from photos is that smaller bedroom has no window. It wasn't a problem for me but it is worth noting. Also the flooring in living room has many discolorations which you cannot see in photos. The floor is still clean and flat.

I had a great stay at this apartment in the Taksim area. The location is definitely one of its biggest advantages — it’s within walking distance to Istiklal Street, public transport, restaurants, and cafes, which made exploring Istanbul very convenient.
The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything needed for a short or even longer stay. The bed was cozy, the Wi-Fi worked well, and the overall space felt safe and welcoming. Despite being in a lively area, the apartment was relatively quiet, which made it easy to rest after a long day.
The host was friendly, responsive, and helpful with check-in and any questions I had during my stay. Communication was smooth and professional.
Overall, I would recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in a central and vibrant part of Istanbul. It offers great value for the location and comfort provided.

The place was very clean, the bed sheets and towels smelled very nice,
The kitchen was also very clean with all the necessary appliances.
The elevator at the building was a big plus.
The location is perfect, walking distance to Taksim and Galata.
You could hear the prayer call every morning, but we were fine with it.
The place is warm, no issue with the heating system and water pressure was also good.
The only thing that could improved was the bathroom which could be renovated and mold free. But we didn’t have any problems with it since it is already the same as the pictures.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay here.

If you’re lucky enough to stay at Suay’s place you won’t regret it. The apartment has a great view plus an elevator for ease of daily living. It’s big and spacious with every single item you will need to be relaxed and comfortable after a fun day in the city. Short or long term, this apartment is an amazing place to call “home” while in Istanbul. The kitchen is stocked with all you need to cook at home, too. The neighborhood has every kind of cuisine you would like. Steps away from the apartment are shops with fresh juice, grocery, pharmacy, beauty care, a salon and only 10-12 minute walk to İstiklal for the best shopping. Suay is extremely helpful and will make sure you have what you need to be comfortable. The doorman is helpful, too. I like it so much I’m moving back in for a second stay myself. This city is incredible even during the virus time- it’s still been wonderful. Enjoy.

I had a great stay at Suay’s place. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect and communication with Suay was smooth and friendly throughout. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul!

description: Stay in a luxurious place close to everywhere you want to visit.

reviews.text:
It’s very clean and located near Taksim Square, only about a 10–12 minute walk away. The road to the property is also convenient for luggage since there are no stairs, which was a big plus.
The place also has a lift, so even if you stay on one of the higher floors, it’s easy to access. It’s small, but definitely helpful.
The host kindly allowed me to check in early and also helped open the gate when I checked out early in the morning. The room included air conditioning, a fridge, and a private bathroom as well.
Considering all these features and the location near Taksim, it was definitely worth the stay.

The bar located right next to the hotel is part of the hotel itself, and we had to wait there while our rooms were being prepared. The check-in time was 2:00 PM, and I arrived at 2:15 PM. Despite this, I had to wait more than three hours before I cancled. Another guest also had to wait for approximately two hours.
We repeatedly explained the situation to the staff at the bar. Their response was simply that it was not their responsibility and that the rooms had not yet been cleaned by the housekeeping staff.
What was particularly unacceptable was that there was not even an apology or any attempt to contact a manager or find a solution. Instead, we were treated in an extremely rude, condescending, dismissive, and disrespectful manner.
Of course, delays in housekeeping can sometimes happen. However, even if the bar staff were not directly responsible for the room cleaning, I would expect them, as part of the same hotel, to at least take the situation seriously. Disgusting behavior.

This is a really good accommodation as the location is great and the room is clean. Also, the price is very reasonable.
As some reviews have mentioned the noise, I have prepared my own ear plugs for sleep and can sleep well. However, as there is almost like no sound proofing at the room, I would strongly advise people who cannot endure noises to think twice before booking it.
Overall, I enjoyed my stay :)

RUN. This was my worst Airbnb experience ever. First, their map location is inaccurate and I'd to spend an hour of back and forth to get there. Second, the whole place reeks of staunchy smell of a mix of wet sheets left with closed windows for a month and pure sweat. Third, the sheets were actually WET and awful. Fourth, the room is on top of an insanely loud bar, like nightclub level loud, and the noise and partying never stopped until 4 AM on a Tuesday night, insane! Terrible experience. Never again.

My experience at Beer Station was very disappointing. The noise level was extremely high because of the bar located on the first and second floors, which made it very difficult to rest or sleep comfortably.
Also, the elevator clearly needs maintenance. Many times it was being used to transport items for the bar, and as a guest I could not even leave my room because the elevator was unavailable for long periods. Overall, the stay was uncomfortable and not suitable for anyone looking for a quiet place.

description:
From our building, located in the center of the SULTANAHMET area, you can easily access many historical buildings (SULTANAHMET MOSQUE, HAGIA SOPHIA, TOPKAPI PALACE, BASILICA CISTERN, etc.).
etc.) You can easily get to tram stops, restaurants, and shopping stores, which are just a short walk away.
In the area where our building is located, there are a park, grocery stores, a taxi stand, restaurants, and cafes.
We will be delighted to have you as our guest.

reviews.text: The sofas and bed reeked of cigarettes. The dishes were dirty. There was a lot of damaged furniture and the doors creaked. The shower didn't work (though it was fixed after we asked), and the kitchen sink was leaking. The hosts were kind and responsive, but the apartment itself is in need of major renovation and professional deep cleaning

Konum olarak iyi bi yerde lakin ücretsiz otopark konusunda pek müsait bir alan mevcut değildi. Ev son katta olduğu için hafif bir basıktı. Tuvalet kapısı bozuk ve internet routerı düzgün çalışmadığı için son katta sinyal problemi vardı.
Evi bir sonraki misafire devretmeden önce kendisinin son kontrolleri yapması gerektiğinin umarım farkına varmıştır. Problemleri çözmek için ben yokken saat vermeden kafasına göre gelmesi ayrı bir iş bilmezlikti.

It was a very cozy stay, and the location is truly perfect. The area is quiet, which made it even more enjoyable. The host was really supportive and responsive throughout.
One small note: we wouldn’t recommend the bakery across the street, as it didn’t quite meet our expectations in terms of taste.

Harika bir deneyimdi.
Hemen 5 dakikada Sultanahmet meydanına ulaşıyorsun.Geceleri gezmeye uygun bir yer.Bütün gezilecek yerler yürüyüş mesafesinde.Bir daha gitsem yine aynı evde kalırım.

Kesinlikle ailece gönül rahatlığıyla kalınabilicek bir yer binanın olduğu cadde de aradığınız herşeye kolaylıkla ulaşabilirsiniz. Giriş çıkışlar gayet esnek hiç problem olmuyo gayet sakin beklentilerinizi karşılaya bilecek bir işletme kendilerine teşekkür ederim 👏🏻

description: Perched above the Bosphorus in Ortaköy, with the bridge framed directly in your window. A place designed not just for sleeping, but for waking up to Istanbul at its most cinematic and not wanting to leave.

reviews.text:
The view is just perfect, and the house looks exactly like the photos. Mert was very kind by leaving us some snacks and water as well.
Spacious and comfortable. One thing is that there is no elevator and the area needs a ride mostly cause its in a steep area in ortakoy which is expected.

First of all the property is at 3 floor with very small stairs.Strictly not recommended for Indians you cannot take your heavy luggage upstairs. Secondly,the host was very rude he didn't even helped with the luggage or the location one cannot find any restaurants nearby not the good food your whole energy would be drained just by walk .

Amazing location excellent furniture good kitchen with one issue (Walking up the hill) always make sure taxi comes from the top. Maybe host can add a complementary bottle of water for new arrivals. All you need is near.

So just checked out today from Mert’s place in Ortakoy. One of the places like pictures on web really matches reality. Beautify view from the balcony. The place is walkable to restaurants, cafes and water around. Taxi is always available near by to go to different areas such as Taksim or Bayoglu.
I recommend this place %100 ❤️

Mert Bey ilk rezervasyon günümden, çıkış yaptığım son güne kadar son derece ilgili ve samimiydi.
Eşsiz manzarası ile huzur veren, çok güzel dekore edilmiş, kaliteli ürünler kullanılmış konforlu, keyifli bir ev. İhtiyacımız olan herşey düşünülmüştü.
Aynı zamanda çok merkezi, Ortaköy-Ulus arasında Portakal yokuşunun inmeden sağ kolda kalıyor. Avm’ler, restorantlar, marketler hepsi çok yakın mesafede.
Ben ve ailem çok rahat ettik ve mutlu olduk.Sonraki seyahatlerimde mutlaka ilk bakacağım yer yine burası olacak.

description: It is a private small cottage in a lovely lush green garden which nowadays is also the site of our cafe and pizzeria. The part of the garden that belongs to the cottage is completely private. Suitable for home-office. The feeling of a country home right in the middle of the city.

reviews.text: Gosh. I don't even know where to start. this was, by far, the best vacation EVER and honestly our wonderful host Tuna and her beautiful and warm family play a monumental role! from responding promptly my emails before we visited to the entire tenure of our stay of two weeks, she was an absolutely splendid host. I know I've made a friend for life. We intended to get a place on the Asian side, where we could be far off from the insanity of the tourism commotion but also be able to access it for sight seeing the usual popular sites and that's exactly what tuna's place is. the house was spotless, comfy and very relaxing and warm after a cold day out. The beds were clean, clean towels laid out, it was a lovely little home away from home for me, my husband and my 5 year old daughter. We even enjoyed the garden on sunny days, had tea outside, laid in the hammock and just unwind. the nearby bulgurlu market which is a downhill walk was also a pleasant surprise, the restaurants there were amazing and we got so comfortable with their excellent service ( and much more food for value) compared to the European side that we would have all our meals there. Tuna even took me to the local thursday market where i bought the cheapest and most amazing salmon and nuts and died fruit and she also showed me how best to cook the salmon! the second day tuna even showed us the Cagri departmental stoire which has all the groceries you might need and a lovely bakery where I shopped plenty of times! Right across the street is a wonderful spice shop with all kinds of exotic spices and teas. There is also a dizzying number of amazing bakeries, baklava and sweet houses, even clothes stores, all in the very easy vicinity of Tunas house. also a bus or mini van ride to Uskudar or Kadikoy and you can do all your souvenier and other shopping with much more variety and much cheaper than the European side. There's a 5 lira shop in Kadikoy that I went berserk in! Tuna very kindly explained the whole metro, bus and ferry ride system to us and we barely ever needed a taxi. She helped guide me with the entire itinerary. she was also amazingly helpful when we needed guidance of any kind when we were lost or confused about something, Tuna was just a phone call away! i know words can never suffice but if you want to experience the local warmth and feel of the turkish culture along with all the tourist attractions, this is the absolute best place. This was our first air bnb experience and tuna has set the bar extremely high for any successive air bnb bookings we make! We are definitely returning and this was, at the cost of sounding repetitive, the absolute best vacation ever! Love you Tuna!

The Lovely Garden proved indeed to be a lovely garden and home to stay. The property was very clean and cozy with a feel of a real home. The house facilities and the garden turned out exactly how they have been depicted on the photos and even more so.....Most importantly, it was the warmth and hospitality of Tuna and her family, that made our short stay so special. Tuna is a very special, kind and caring host. She helped us with every need, providing guidance and utmost hospitality, including freshly made Turkish pastry and chocolate cake as a surprise. This place is made even more special by the presence of a gorgeous adopted dog Tamal. He is always kind, hospitable and open for a lively play and a nice piece of bread with cheese :).

The Lovely Garden is located in a very green, clean and safe neighbourhood in Anatolia (the Asian part of Istanbul), away from the everyday buzz and hectic lifepace. It is immersed in a residential area, very close to a beautiful Camlica public park. The area is nice for comfortable walks, if one is interested to observe local life in a residential part of Istanbul, away from the myriad of tourists, shops, industries and business centers. A number of local restaurants, bakeries and grocery shops are located at a walking distance.

We would highly recommend the Lovely Garden to someone, who is seeking to stay more in a family atmosphere in a quiet green area, rejuvenating oneself with the energy of trees and the magical sound of the call for prayer, which can be heard from the minarets of the nearby mosque. It is worth mentioning that Tuna's family also runs a cozy lodge in a green area in the vicinity of Istanbul. We would highly recommend this place as well to someone interested in a quiet retreat surrounded by nature.

We loved everything about the Lovely Garden and we have had a very lovely experience staying there! Above all, we would like to extend our hearty greetings to Tuna's family and thank her, her mother, her sister, her lovely daughter and son, the dog Tamal and her entire family for the warmth, hospitality and kind smiles. Sending you love and smiles from our hearts and wishing you all the best.
We do hope and look forward to stay in the Lovely Garden again!!!
Tashekullar, Tuna.
With warm reegards,
Allan and Nigora

Beyond perfect!
The best!
Everything about it is just amazing...! the place, the price, and the host.
The place is really nice, very confortable, and very clean, it is located in a lovely garden, in a very nice neighborhood. Transportation is very easy, and the lovely host helped us to buy transportation cards, which made our trip less and less expensive..The house is located on top of a hill, with a stunning view. The price is unbelievable for what you get, and we were ready to pay even much more to have such a perfect combination of place and host!
Tuna (the host), well, I am absolutely speechless about her! She is the most adorable, thoughtful, generous, and engaging person you might come across!
The first day she came with us (even to the European side) and told us ALL the necessary information we may need..and with her help we were so comfortable, we could feel like a local! We had an amazing time...
Also ask them to take you-if possible for them, and for you- to the place they have in the countryside, where is a heaven! In weekends they serve the best food, in a lovely wooden restaurant.. amazing!
Well, apparently I can not never describe this place and the host, in words! We were so lucky to find it.
We left the house, as we were all so sad to leave..BUT, we are thankful to have the chance to meet this lovely family!
(Also I have to mention that it was our first time booking a place via airbnb and I wasn't sure about anything, but it turned out to be THE BEST! )

Мы с женой и двумя детьми провели в этом доме все новогодние каникулы. В доме всё так, как описано Tune. Нам очень понравилось постельное белье оно очень хорошего качества. Дома было тепло, хотя в некоторые дни выпадал снег и температура на улице была около 0 градусов, газовое отопление работало хорошо. Дом расположен на холме, если немного спустится, то можно попасть в магазины, где продают вкусный хлеб и ограниченный набор продуктов. Tune и Antonio отвезли нас на машине в супермаркет, где они покупают продукты, потом мы сами ходили в него, порядка 20 ходу мимо станции метро. До ближайшей станции метро M5 10 минут ходьбы с ребенком 3 лет, чтобы добраться до основных достопримечательностей, расположенных в старом городе вам нужно ехать на станцию Uskudar и пересесть на метро Marmaray , чтобы добраться до станции Sirkeci, время поездки на метро около 30 минут. Tune и Antonio пригласили нас отпраздновать Новый год в кругу своей семьи, это было очень интересно и необычно. Они очень хорошие и доброжелательные люди. Если мы будем в Стамбуле, то обязательно остановимся у них снова, так как там очень тихо и чистая природа вокруг.
My wife and two children spent all the new Year's holidays in this House. In the house everything is as described Tune. We loved the linens, it is of very good quality. The house was warm, although some days the snow fell and the temperature on the street was about 0 degrees, gas heating worked well. The house is located on a hill, if a little down, you can get to the shops, where they sell delicious bread and a limited list of products. Tune and Antonio drove us by car to the supermarket where they buy products, then we walked in it, about 20 minutes walk through the metro station. The nearest Metro station M5 10 minutes walk with a child 3 years to get to the main attractions located in the old town you need to drive to the station Uskudar and take the Metro Marmaray to reach the station SIRKECI, the time of the subway trip About 30 minutes. Tune and Antonio invited us to celebrate the new Year in the circle of their family, it was very interesting and unusual. They are very nice and friendly people. If we are in Istanbul we will definitely stay at them again as there is very quiet and clean nature around.

We had a wonderful stay at Tuna’s home. She is a fantastic host, and her home is very clean and comfortable. Her family is lovely, too. They were all very kind and helpful during our stay.
The location of the home is great, and it is easy to walk to nearby stores and restaurants. Tuna also runs a restaurant cafe on her property and the food is delicious!
If you want to visit the sights on the European side of Istanbul, it takes about twenty to thirty minutes to drive there.
Tuna’s home has private, off-street parking if needed, and the big yard is very beautiful and relaxing.
You will definitely enjoy your stay here. We hope to return one day.
Thank you, Tuna, Antonio, and Luca!

description: A stylish and compact studio at the intersection of the heart of the city, history and energy. A location close to cultural wealth, entertainment, shopping and public transportation and in the center of Istanbul's iconic Beyoğlu district. The opportunity to explore the most beautiful spots of the city on foot; colorful streets, art-filled cafes, live music venues, boutiques, antique shops, independent stores and world cuisines. Galata Tower, Istiklal Street, Taksim Square, Karakoy, Galataport, Tersane Istanbul... all within walking distance.

reviews.text: Fiyat olarak tam performans o fiyat bandında hijyensiz yerlerde kalmak yerine bu güzel yeri tercih etmenizi şiddetle tavsiye ederim çok temiz ve çok düzenliydi
Her zaman Tercih ettiğim temiz ve güvenilir bir konaklama giriş çıkış sorunsuz bir şekilde ilerlemekte teşekkürler ev sahibine
evin konumu icerisinin düzeni ve temizliği çok iyiydi evimizdeymis gibi hissettik çok teşekkür ederiz
Evin konumu iyi yakınlarında marketler de var tek sıkıntı arabanız varsa eve yakın bir yerde park yeri yok caddeye park edip yürümeniz gerek o da çat patlasın 3-4 dk sürüyor
Beyoğlu’nda gayet rahat ve ferah bir tecrübe. Teşekkür ederiz.

description: Apartment has a double bedding at bedroom and a sofa in living room which turns to a double bed. So 3 person can stay. This apartment is a private flat in a Historical building in Historical part of Beyoğlu - Taksim. Apartment was modified according fidelity of History. Location is perfect as its only 1 min walk to the Metro Station and famous İstiklal Street.

reviews.text: My mom and sister enjoyed staying here, location is great, everything nearby. Kursad provided a private transfer from the airport for extra price and it was really comfortable and safe! Overall the apartment is great for two people, smaller than in the pictures but we enjoyed staying here. One con is that laundry is downstairs. We didn’t have any cleaning service during our stay (which we needed) but I think Kursad will fix this part as a very responsible host. Thank you so much!

Host was accommodating and responsive. We were allowed to check-in a few hours earlier and had all other requests quickly fulfilled.
We were impressed by the cleanliness of the room, especially bathroom. It seems to be newly renovated and is smartly designed when it comes to using all the available living space.
The kitchen was good with new appliances, however there were no freezer compartment in the fridge. The bathroom was perfect, very clean and comfortable.
The bed was comfortable with a new mattress and orthopedic memory foam pillows. There were also rolling blinds on the windows.
Laundry room downstairs is fully equipped with several good washers and dryers.
The only downside is that the room was noisy due to poor soundproofing of windows and walls. To be fair, in the listing it is mentioned that there is a school nearby and due to this it is noisy in-between 08:00-16:00. It can be difficult to rest or work at that time. However, evenings and nights are very quiet.

pros: the aparment is exactly how it looks on the pictures , clean and located in centre , checking in was super easy as well . so a lot of positives. the bed was super comfy .
cons : there is a school
right next to the window whch is active at 8 am already so if you want to sleep in you can't do that because its too loud . The building has thin walls , when our neighbours from upstairs where coming back at 3 am and walking around the apartment I could hear all lf that in our aparment 3 even with ear plugs .was waking up. not a fault of host and some people have no problems sleeping through that but if you are light sleeper than be advised .

We stayed at Kursad's place for almost two weeks and had a very pleasant experience. The apartment is located in a quiet, peaceful neighborhood with convenient access to both the metro and tram stations. It is also just a 20-minute walk from Galataport and the Kabataş ferry terminal, making it easy to explore the city.
As described in the listing, the apartment is in an older building, but it is well maintained and in good condition. It was clean and comfortable throughout our stay. Whenever we needed assistance or had any requests, the housekeeper was responsive and very helpful.

The apartment is in a nice location, very close to shops, restaurants, tram station and metro station. It is clean, well decorated and equipped with everything to cook. We didn't met Kürşad as the check-in was automatic with a code to enter the main door: however Kürşad was very responsive and helpful. The only small negative point is the absence of hot water (only lukewarm water available from the shower): we went there in the summertime so it was not a problem for us.

description:
INFO: “Disinfection before each check-in”
Spend your time like a local right near to downtown!
1+1 flat in Balat(10-15 minute bus ride to Taksim,Eminonu and Sultanahmet)comforts your Istanbul trip with bathroom,kitchen,living room and bedroom.Have a rest in silence and peace in the entire apartment.Explore Istanbul from Balat - the richest in history, fascinating and characteristic district - where included in the UNESCO World Heritage List.Public transportation is just 4 minutes away from home.

reviews.text:
Tugba and Aytac are wonderful hosts. There place can be wonderful depending on the needs of you the guest. I rented the place for myself and my son because it was close to Istanbul University. Hence this was our main goal behind picking the location. However, the space may not be accommodating to your needs if you occupy the space along with more than one person. The bedroom is small and has one closet that is closely adjacent to the bed because of the size of the bedroom. There are no corner cabinets in the bedroom. The kitchen and living space only has kitchen cabinets. There is a small dining table that can serve two people. There is not coffee table . There are no other cabinets outside of the bedroom closet. The bathroom sink is very tiny and washing up your face can easily result in water dropping on the floor because of its tiny size. So be gentle and careful when you use the sink.
Water, electricity and WiFi are reliable in the apartment. We only experienced WiFi issues twice and water disruption Twice.
The neighborhood itself does not boast anything touristic. Only coffee shops and local restaurants.
The Balat area is known as a low socioeconomic area which is why it can be cheap. Nonetheless, it is not an area that displays sophistication or environmental decorum. Trashed streets and littering is common sight.
The building itself is clean and well maintained.
So keep this context in mind when you plan your trip to Istanbul when and if you consider this flat.
Again, if you are looking for good value for the dollar, it is fair. If you are looking for etiquette, decorum, cleanliness, and sophistication, you will not find it in this area.
People are kind and very sweet though. People are generous and helpful as well. We did experience locals who took advantage of our ignorance of the language and currency. So be careful especially with local taxis.
This is my most objective and accurate assessment of our experience. Again, our assessment is subjective and relative to our own preconceived perceptions and biases. You do not have to take anything we say seriously, but you can do your own investigation online and arrive at your own conclusions.

We had a wonderful stay at Home in Fatih hosted by Tugba and Aytac. The apartment was clean, comfortable, welcoming, and had everything we needed and as described. The self check-in process was easy, with clear instructions, a lockbox, and code access making arrival and departure seamless.
The location was perfect. We walked almost everywhere, including the bazaars, mosques, and waterfront areas. Public transport was close by, but we especially loved exploring the streets on foot. Balat quickly became our favourite neighbourhood, and this stay placed us right in the heart of it all.
We also appreciated the local guide provided by the hosts. Their recommendations for food, coffee, and local attractions were fantastic, and every place we tried was excellent. Having a washing machine was another great bonus while travelling.
We highly recommend this stay to anyone wanting a clean, comfortable, and perfectly located base to explore Istanbul.

Great location close to many restaurants and bus station. Place is suitable and comfortable for one person or for two if you only have a carry on. It’s quite small (looks bigger on the pictures) but you can work your way around it. Apartment was super clean and organized. Narrowed spiral staircase (for those who carry big luggage and have back problems). Host was very responsive at all times and help me coordinate the transfer from and to the airport.

I stayed there with my family (wife and kids). Tugba and Aytac very friendly and helpfull. All were done as planned and described in the site. The flat was clean and cozy and placed in historical place. The building is secured by door lock system, neighboors are quite. The bus can take you to Eminonu (tram metro) from Balat station.A lot of restraunts around. I recommend this flat.
Thank you Tugba and Aytac for all of these!

I stayed here for about five months to work remotely and could connect very easily to calls, meetings, and video conferences. There is everything available in the apartment for a lomg-term stay, weekly cleaning is great service. The bed is very comfortable and there are extra hangers for your clothes. The place is on a quiet area, it was comfortable to work and have a rest. Ideal for those seeking a home in Istanbul to work remotely, such as myself.
What is amazing about this place and the neighborhood is that you are at a walking distance, only a few minutes, to local shops and produce stores, not to mention all the vintage / antique shops, restaurants, and cafes (try Mitis Manti restaurant for Turkish ravioli!). Touristic spots can be reached very easily either on foot or by public transportation.
This is my second stay at Tugba and Aytac`s Boutique Aparts in Balat. They are very kind, helpful and accommodating. Both Tugba and Aytac are very accommodating and helpful if you need anything.

description: Just a mere 200m from Taksim Square, the cozy unit is located in the hip Cihangir district. The tramway station is 400m down the road which is another advantage for those exploring the city without having to get stuck in heavy traffic. The apartment is very comfy with two separate bedrooms and large living space. (it's on the first floor with just 12 steps up the entrance) Guests can order in food and market demands 24/7. These days there is a streets renovation durining one month. Till 13 july

reviews.text:
Mr. Mustafa was a great host. He was very helpful and replied immediately to all our questions. He was also flexible with check in and check out times and he kindly accepted to give us the house a couple more hours since our flight was at midnight.
The location was perfect. About 4 minutes walk to the lively taksim square but at the same time it was a quiet street with no noise and few cars passing by. The cats in the street were a plus, i loved them :D
One thing I have to be honest about is that the apartment was not as good and new as I expected. The apartment was not so clean but Mustafa arranged cleaning on the second day of our stay.
Even though he was not in Istanbul during our stay, Mustafa was available all the time and his friend was also so kind and visited the apartment when needed.
In general, it was a pleasant stay. We enjoyed the comfortable and cozy apartment and it was good value for money.
Thanks Mustafa!

A good flat on a quiet street not far from Taksim. All clean, spacious living room, two bedrooms, washing machine and a dishwasher. An individual water heater both for bathroom water and for heating. The owner even bought a microwave oven at my request! There are some disadvantages though: the apartment need a but of renovation, the fridge and the stove are very small, the shower cabin leaks everywhere, the noises from the stairs and from outside can be very well heard inside (although this is not a problem for nights, as the neighbourhood is very quiet). Also the exhaust pipe from the water heater is too short so that exhaust fumes can enter the bedrooms if windows are open; I had to sleep with closed windows for safety. However, this seems to be a standard way of installing the heater in Istanbul.

I liked to stay at Mustafa's place. He and his friend were very helpful. They explained how to get on the bus from the airport, they picked me up and took me to the place. Communication was great. Location for me was excellent. Very close to Taxim square, tram and metro. Taxi is available. Istanbul is like a fairy tale. It locates on the hills. There is some steep hiking if you like to walk. I liked some exercise. There was everything in the apartments what a tourist need. The bed was very comfortable, air conditioning. I would definitely stay there again.

I had a super stay in this apartment! It is very centrally located with an immense variety of shops and restaurants nearby yet tucked away in a quiet neighborhood. Also close to all sorts of public transportation if you want to visit the sights in Istanbul.
The apartment is very clean and comfortable with everything we could've needed.
Mustafa and Azat were very kind and welcoming and the communication was excellent. They responded quickly and were very accommodating with both my check in and check out.
I wouldn't think twice about booking this place :)

Spent with family Christmas/ New Year holidays 2022-2023. Our stay was very nice and comfortable. Apartment corresponds to photos and description in a profile. It’s quite big and cozy, good choice for a family or group of friends. Location is pretty close to Taksim square and other historical and authentic surroundings. Mustafa and his associate Azad were super friendly, proactive and gracious in communication. Thanks them a lot, we had memorable vacation!

description:
You will love our newly reconstracted apartment because of:
• It's perfect location - on the border of Old Town and Little Hagia Sophia & Local Supermarkets
•Beautiful neighbourhod with Authentic Ottoman Houses
•Brand new equipment and furniture - spacious bathroom
•Brand new electronic equipments
•Powerful shower unit
•Unlimited free Wi-Fi

reviews.text:
excellent location and very friendly and helpful staff.
some of the pictures don't reveal the work needed. there is no stove in the kitchen and water kettle didn't work. shower was broken ( which was fixed promptly after we pointed out).
beds and bed rooms were comfortable and clean. overall a good place

I really enjoyed my stay at Mehmet's place. The location is just perfect; walking distance to Sultanahmet, close to tram, and lots of good foods nearby. The area is also peaceful and beautiful.
Mehmet's place was exactly as what he described on the listing. I stayed there with my family, and it was a perfect place for 4 people. The place was neat & clean, however I believe that the kitchen area could have some nice improvements. Also, the kettle was not working at all. I told Mehmet already, but I guess he forgot so until the last day I couldn't use it.
Overall, it was a lovely stay. Mehmet & the receptionist team were also very friendly and helpful. Would definitely recommend it to anyone who's coming to visit Istanbul.

I stayed at this place in Sultanahmet, conveniently close to Hagia Sophia and Eminonu. The rooms were clean with daily cleaning service. However, the one-bedroom flat setup posed an inconvenience, especially with the bathroom accessible only through the bedroom, making it awkward for couples sharing the space. A clearer description in the correspondence about this layout would have been appreciated. Despite this, the host was responsive on texts. We encountered issues with the WiFi at night, requiring daily follow-ups. Overall, the stay offered an amazing view, but I wouldn't recommend it for group of 4 (2 couples).
Additionally, we appreciated the accommodation's gesture of storing our luggage in the waiting room, considering our check-out was at noon while our taxi wasn't until 6 pm. This thoughtful service was a helpful touch to our overall experience.
Host was very friendly when checking in and the arrangement of transportation was helpful and reasonably priced. Hotel room was clean but the weak wifi connection was the only downside.

We had a great stay at this apartment. It was clean, comfortable, and in a very convenient location, within walking distance of the main attractions such as the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and other historic sites. Check-in was smooth, and communication with the host was excellent throughout our stay. We also received a discount to eat at a nearby restaurant, which was a nice extra. Everything went perfectly, and we would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!

description: The building is located in Istanbul’s arts, entertaiment, history and cultural district, in other words right in the middle of the city center, in Taksim / Beyoglu.

reviews.text:
It was a last-minute trip to Istanbul, but I'm happy that I found this place.
Positives:
1) Great communication from the hosts.
2) Location is superb—just 5 minutes walking distance to the heart of Taksim, Istiklal Street. However, newcomers find it strange because of the narrow streets.
3) Reasonable price compared to other options.
Negatives:
1) Although it's a renovated building, the walls are thin. The intermittent sound from the bread cutting machine at the bakery downstairs was disturbing. (stayed on the second floor)
2) They should invest in a new bed and sheets for sure.
3) Cleaning, especially the towels, should be improved.

This place looks better on the pictures. It's rather dirty (lot's of dust, especially on the walls and dirty kitchen cabinets).
The bed is really old and squeaky. One side of the bed is lower than the other and it's uncomfortable to slip.
However, the place is really quiet which is very rare for this part of Istanbul. There's also an elevator.

First of all I cannot recommend this Appartement even though the host was quite friendly in the beginning and tried to convince us about the safety of the location. The area is not safe, especially after 9 pm you really have to be careful. Also not every taxi driver wanted to take us home, because the streets are already known for the high Crime Rate. Besides that the apartment was dirty, you just can’t feel good there. The streets at night are loud and filled with men standing around. Police is driving through, which makes you even feel more uncomfortable when they’re leaving.
If you are a girls like we were i would Not recommend this Place. It’s not safe, it’s dirty, it’s just not a pleasant stay in Istanbul living there. There are also lots of erotic shops on the closest Main Street.
Don’t trust the appealing pictures of the apartment; it’s way smaller than it appears.
We were four people and didn’t get enough towels and bedding the first night, That is why we have to ask for More. Also the host wasn’t reachable the last night before we left. Taxis to the airport are not easy to pre-order. We were lucky, but you’d expect the host to at least pick up the phone the night you’re leaving.

location: close to metro station and easy bus connections. Nearby there are supermarkets, bakery and groceries.
The room was clean, with a comfortable bed, good wifi connection.
Check-in and out was hassle free and the host was really helpful and guiding, thank you once again!

Taner is a very nice host. Apartment looked bit smaller than pictures. Location was great. Walkable from all good locations.
But there was a weird smell in washroom when you turn on geyser. Also bed was too low i.e. low lying mattress.
Cleanliness was okay.

description: B Guest Apartment is located in the hearth of Istanbul’s historic centre.We provide clean and comfortable rooms within walking distance of such notable sites as the Hagia Sofia, the Blue Mosque, the Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace. Our inclusive fresh buffet breakfast will send you off in the mornings ready to explore and immerse yourself in the rich and diverse culture. We are more than happy to go the extra mile to ensure your stay is comfortable and satisfactory in every way.

reviews.text:
This location is close to city attractions and was really clean. The hotel staff was incredibly kind, and the host even allowed me to check in before the scheduled check-in time.
I highly recommend the place :)
Great value for the place , very clean and confortable beds, the Uganda guys are the best!! Very friendly and super helpful.

Great value for the price. Breakfast buffet included and had some hot items - eggs, veggies. Small basic room if you are just needing a place to sleep and private bathroom , grocery store and shops across the street. Walkable (20 min ) to Blue Mosque and bazaars.
It’s a small hotel in the historic district of the city, very modern with an elevator, very clean room and bathroom. Buffet breakfast served every day and offerings varied. Thank you.
It was clean and the owner was super helpful! The location is very good too!

description: The house is located on the Büyükdere/Sariyer coast, very close to the Hacıosman metro and public transportation. It is on a quiet street. There are double and single beds. The kitchen is equipped with everything you need in a clean and comfortable atmosphere. It is a 3-minute walk to the Sadberk Hanım Museum and Fuat Pasha Mansion.

reviews.text: The flat is as described and very clean. The metrostation is only 10 minutes away by minibus.

This house is located in one of the best parts of Istanbul, a couple of minutes walk from an amazing marina, everything is available around the house, public transportation to metro is very close, house is fully equipped and is very cosy and in a very quite area, we really felt like we are in an amazing place, because it's close to everything, yet you feel you are in a very local area but with an amazing history touch, it was certainly a 5 start Turkish cultural stay. I can keep on writing about the place, the area and the host, but seriously, we did not expect to feel so comfortable, but really is a unique stay. Thank you Nurcan for an amazing stay and we look forward to come back to Istanbul and to Sariyer, and to Sariyer people.
We lirtaly did not need to buy anything once we check-in in the house.

When I first arrived to the apartment a d layed down on the bed, I realized the tshirt that I just wore was covered in animal hair which they told me after I complained them that a street cat wondered imto the apartment and they somehow missed the bed covered with animal fur. Being shocked with negligence in the house, my experience gotten worse with an attack of ants into the bedroom(approximately 50 ants per day).It reached a point at the end of the day in which I was not able to step inside into the room without killing or stepping on an already dead ant. The solution from hosts was to poison inside the room which resulted in just more dead ants on the floor. If you enjoy having a forest-like experience, this house is at very good location and hosts at least seemed kind.

great place as described.
you experience the local life in this area
plus the sea nearby
Ev sahibi cok iyi, her aradigimizda rahatlikla ulasabildik ve cok yardimci oldu. Ev cok merkezi ve cok temiz

description: A very nice and cosy flat in a very center of Kadıköy. Bars street, cafes, art galleries, antique shopping centers, full of fun is around. You won't need any transportation to experience a great night in this center of Anatolian part of Istanbul. Together we can have breakfasts and take city tours. Me and my wife are tango teachers and our school is very close to us and here. We invite our guests to the tango classes;) You will love this neighbourhood and never want to leave here.

reviews.text:
I enjoyed meeting Abdullah and Delanna. Both were nice and easy to speak to.
The room was clean and actually bigger than I expected from the pictures. It was very quiet at night and one of the best night's sleep I've had in Istanbul. Child Park is a short walk away with an amazing sunset. Lots of grocery stores and restaurants close by.
I was a long term stay and unfortunately I had to leave within a couple days because I could see this stay was not going to work out for me.
Abdullah was understanding and I had no issue through Airbnb to update my booking and get a refund. I put my experience down largely to timing
As I said, I really liked hosts and I think if you're not trying to work remotely (rely on good wifi) and spending a lot of time out and about (and not in the kitchen) this might be right for you. I will not list my issues here out of respect but I have communicated them to hosts to hopefully be remedied.
Their son is just over year old, adorable and very friendly.
The communal areas were a lot more untidy than the pictures which was unfortunate as it was the only place I could get stable wifi. Cat food on the dinning table (not in pictures) made it hard to work from here too.
I didn't want to write a review but felt I should for other long stayers like me given the inconvenience it cause me.

Had a very lovely time; hosts are very warm and welcoming and I felt right at home. Communication is very quick and dependable. Can use common areas and kitchen, washing machine etc. freely. Location is amazing, room is cozy and bed comfortable. Be ready to deal with three - sometimes lovely, sometimes feisty - cats. I had a great time, thank you very much. :)

The stay was great! The room was neat and simple, the bathroom was clean and always vacant — just what we needed after long walks. The hosts are nice and friendly, their son Güneş is really cute, and the cats are fun to have around. The location is also really good — the room overlooks the quiet side, so there was no noise.

Wonderful young couple, very nice and friendly. More than welcome to come back. It is a beautiful apartment with lovely area right in center of Moda. Spacious and cozy, with a comfortable bed, nice little kitchen, and cozy sitting area.. As other reviewers have mentioned. I loved their cats, they are so playful and friendly, but Zuzu is a bit sneaky, be careful not to bother her :) Aside from the apartment, I now have my hosts as my close friends! Dilara and Abdullah are really cool and friendly couple, with their Little cutie pie Günes.. the baby is calm and you‘ll LOVE HIS CUTE VIBES everytime you look at him! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLACE.

Awesome place hosted by an amazing couple who made us feel like home. They helped us further more than expected during our stay, the space is big, clean and full of good energies. Also, this is probably the best neighborhood in Istanbul, with everything close and within a walkable distance. Hope we can come back someday to enjoy even more! Thank you!! ❤️

description:
With this exceptional House, it is impossible not to fall in love with Istanbul!
Enjoy staying at your historical house with private backyard and balcony with a city view
Live in one of the centric streets of Cihangir
Explore art galleries, antique shops, creative stores, hip cafes and restaurants of the neighbourhood
10 mins walk to Taksim Square metro station
10 mins walk to Galata
5 mins walk to Tram Station to get to the old town.(Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace).

reviews.text: Ömer was a wonderful host! He was very responsive and helpful when we needed assistance. He checked in throughout our stay but was not intrusive. The home was comfortable, fit our needs, and was a ~8-10 minute walk to areas with great food options and about ~15-20 minutes away from Istiklal, taksim square and karakoy. I would be careful to book if you have younger children because the stairs do not have a protective railing between the first and second floors and the spacing of the stairs can be a fall risk. We were very proactive with my 2 year old to make sure they were not running near the stairs and always walking up and down with them. We spent a lot of time on the second floor which was nice. Having a second bathroom was helpful for my family. There was an odd smell on the first floor/kitchen area, but since we spent most of our time upstairs it was not much of an issue. We enjoyed our stay!

Omer helped us out from start to finish. Helped us organise taxi transfers with a carseat. Gave us lots of tips of different places to visit; a great host - thanks Omer!
The house is perfect. Very nicely decorated and if you are an art lover some interesting material to read. The rooms are all big and comfortable, clean and cozy. Kitchen has everything you need.
Great location close to the tram direct to Grand Bazaar via Aya Sophia and the ferry to Kadikoy. Takes about 30 or so minutes to walk to the spice market on the other side of the Galata Bridge and is a nice walk through Karakoy for a touch of breakfast.
Highly recommend with family or group of friends.

The place is wonderful - close to the subway station and you can walk to the park.
It is comfortable for 2 people to stay - you have everything you need. And it is clean.
The host sent informations to you before check in.
It is in the first floor, there are stairs you need to walk.
I will recommend the place.

It's been an amazing stay, beautiful apartment, very cozy and feels like home. We had everything we need, kitchen has everything you need to cook, there are many places in the apartment you can spend time enjoying small moments, balcony, big table in the living room in front of the kitchen and so on. There was even slippers for everyone to walk on the first floor as there is a stone floor in the kitchen.
Ömer was very kind and responsive, answering very quickly. He even allowed us to keep our bags in the apartment until evening (we had a late flight), so that we can walk around lightly. The cleaning service was also very kind and positive, 2 cheerful ladies being very friendly. The place is very quiet, we had no issues with noise from outside at all. Thank you so much Ömer for this apartment, this is a great way to stay in Turkey!

Overall, we enjoyed the stay.
The place is just like on the photos. It has 3 bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms. It also has a couch for 2 people in the living room, but we do not recommend sleeping on it.
Cleanliness was ok.
WiFi worked fast, we had no problems.
The best part of the booking was the host - he was super responsive and helpful. I would book this place again only because of him :)

description: Located in Şişli and with Taksim Square reachable within a 19-minute walk, our apartment has concierge services, rooms, a shared lounge, free WiFi throughout the property. The property provides a 24-hour front desk, room service, free daily housekeeping and currency exchange for guests.

reviews.text:
This place is a duplex that fits a large family or group of friends of 6/7 people perfectly
It contains of 2 levels where 2 bedrooms are downstairs and a bathroom,
The upper floor has the kitchen, 3rd bedroom and a bathroom
Both bathrooms have showers inside,
Its looks exactly like the photos or even better,
Its as if you’re staying at a hotel with all its facilities and services while it feels home,
The place is super clean, everything is available, working and as new, utensils, table ware, oven , fridge, hair dryer etc..
Everything is literally around the corner, stores, restaurants, pharmacies, supermarkets, fruit market etc..
A 2 min walk to metro station,
8 min walk to the famous “Nisantasi” street, where you can find all lavish stores and diners
Also Cevahir shopping mall (largest mall in the city center) is 1 station away,
The street is quite yet has lively surroundings..
All hosts are available and responsive during their shifts and after, very professional yet friendly
They helped us in every way possible
Muhammed one of the 3 hosts was extra helpful and did a great job helping us out
He made everything look easy and effortless
He would fulfill any service/ service gladly with the best he could
The overall experience was amazing and Beddington is definitely our choice on the next trip.

Весьма неплохая квартирка: три отдельных спальни + терраса дали нам возможность с комфортом разместиться вчетвером. На фото размеры кухни "слегка" преувеличены, но это мелочь. По запросу убирают и меняют полотенца, тапочки, стандартные мыло/гель/шампуньку. Очень приветливые и отзывчивые администраторы на ресепшене. Локейшн просто на пять с плюсом из-за близости метро, кафешек и магазинчиков. Поверьте, если вы в Стамбуле впервые (как были мы) - это просто спасение. В общем и целом - рекомендую!
Quite a good apartment: three separate bedrooms + terrace gave us the opportunity to comfortably accommodate the four. On the photo the size of the kitchen is "slightly" exaggerated, but it is a trifle. By request staff cleaned and changed towels, slippers, standard soap/gel/shampoo. Very friendly and responsive receptionists.
Very good location because of the proximity of subway, cafes and stores. Believe me, if you are in Istanbul for the first time (as we were) is just a rescue. In general, I recommend it!

The apartment was excellent very clean with great location and everything was very comfortable
The reception was very warm and welcoming especially Iman at the front desk who was very kind and helpful
we had a great experience the only thing that would make the stay even more convenient would be having a washing machine in the apartment

This apartment is beautiful! The balcony alone is amazing and has such a great view of the city. It is definitely on the small side but it would work very well for a group of 5 or 6. It comes with everything you need except water. If you need to do laundry then you do have to pay extra. The Beddington staff are very helpful and available whenever. The location is ideal and it is incredibly easy to get around the city from the apartment.

This place is the best choice that you can have . First of all Location is great Communication is pretty easy . Near to metro station . Short walk to the center of town .
Staff are so helpful, polite and friendly. The cleaning staff were incredibly organized , we had daily cleaning and they were awesome.
Overall all if you are looking for a safe and nice place to stay in this magical city , this is your place. Thanks for having us , we will come back for sure .

description:
OUR PLACE IS ONLY 5 MINUTES WALKING DISTANCE TO SULTANAHMET, HAGIA SOPHIA MUSEUM, GRAND BAZAAR, SPICE BAZAAR AND MANY TOURISTIC AREAS THAT I CANNOT NAME
200 METERS FROM THE TRAM, METRO, BUS AND TAXI STOP
WE OFFER DRINKS SUCH AS TEA, COFFEE AND WATER
THERE IS A CAMERA SYSTEM
OUR PLACE HAS A MINI KITCHEN AND A MINI CABINET, AND KITCHEN UTENSILS ARE AVAILABLE

reviews.text:
Our stay was convenient and enjoyable. Host was responsive, flexible and accommodating.
The amenities were good, the shower worked well and the freebies were much appreciated. Lots of towels, iron, and spare toilet roll provided. The wifi was very good.
I corroborate other recent reviews about the flat’s cleanliness and facilities. The bed linen was clean but stained. The bathroom has black mould and smells of it. There is not much room for bags. However the flat is well-located near transport links and you can walk to restaurants and attractions from the flat. The area is hilly so not ideal for lesser abled visitors.
The main issue that affected our stay was the air conditioning. It is worth noting that there is only one unit in the main space, not in the separate double bedroom. Even with this unit on its lowest setting, the flat was very hot and humid, which meant we slept poorly every night. We had very little control over the temperature of the room.
