We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul's Fatih district. The host went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable and stress-free. He kindly helped us carry our luggage and even arranged free parking right in front of his office, which was a huge convenience in such a bustling city.
The location was perfect for exploring the city, with easy access to local attractions and amenities. The apartment was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. We truly appreciated the warm hospitality and thoughtful gestures throughout our stay. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul!

Good location, very close to the main tourist attractions. The apartment was clean and the Wi-Fi worked very well. We also booked the airport transfer with the host and everything went smoothly — they were very kind and helped us with the luggage.
Unfortunately, the listing did not mention that the apartment is on the 3rd floor and that the building has no elevator. The hot water also stopped intermittently during showers.

My stay here was as uncomfortable as it gets, the host was very nice but otherwise this is as much as you'll get!
I rented it because it's supposedly close to the tram, but it's located at the bottom of such a steep hill, it would really take an effort getting up there everyday, it's also located in a rather poor neighborhood and it can be scary and maybe unsafe at night.
The apartment itself was super small, there is no place to even open your four bags, its basically 4 beds and a bathroom with a small corner where there is a small "kitchen"
I wasn't comfortable at all, and for the money I paid it really isn't worth it.

I stayed with my sister for 3 nights. As we were busy sightseeing we only used here to sleep. Don’t expect anywhere massive, but for just showering and sleeping it is enough.
The close walking distance to all the great touristic sites and tram station makes it worth all the money we paid.
We had a problem with very noisy guests above us. Of course these things are out of control of the host but we messaged Yakup who was very helpful and sorted the problem for us. Our neighbours were quiet for the remainder of our stay.
There was a small issue with a bathroom tap but I messaged Yakup and before we returned to the apartment in the evening it was fixed.
He also organised a great private airport transfer for us which was a luxury and comfortable vehicle. Definitely recommend him as a host.

description: Our place, located right in the middle of Nişantaşı and Taksim shopping areas in the Osmanbey region of Şişli, not only provides a unique privilege for you shopping enthusiasts, but also provides very easy access for guests who want to visit historical places as it is located in the center of all of them. Our apartment has a refrigerator, an electric stove, plates, cutlery, a safe, and a clothes hanger.

reviews.text:
This is the second worst place I have ever been.
The host just launched his studio flat on the market looking to ear money and that's it. I wonder why did I paid admin fees and service fees in addition of the flat cost. Basically the flat os poorly equipped. I've been there 2 weeks and I had 2 towels and 1 set of bedding which was already used for the bed. I contacted the host to let him know that I need to change my bedding and towels and he just didn't care. There are no plugs in the flat, if you want to charge your phone you have to do it in the bathroom or in the kitchen.Not even toilet roll. No washing liquids to wash my bloody cutleries, no wine or beer opener, no anything. I don't understand what this host was expecting, to equip his flat with everything? The flat is dark , there is no light coming in, no air. The washing machine probably is very old because I washed my clothes a few times, but I took them out still dirty and more than that stinky, even if I put alot of detergent. Also there is no cleaning service , no broom ,no anything, so how am I supposed to clean the place if I have no products? No toilet liquid, no toilet roll, no broom, no additional towels.
Every single night with no exception has been very noisy, music until 4-5 o'clock in the morning.
I paid alot for the conditions I have been offered. This is one star service. The only good thing is that he have wifi and is well located. There are lots od bars and shops around.

I had a great time here! The host is very helpful for various needs.
The house is like in the photographs, the main room is very spacious and the bed is very large. The entry door has multiple latches (thumbs up for safety). The house was clean.
The thing is very equipped, perfect for both a short and long stay. In the kitchen there are pans, teapots and coffee pot as well as detergent for cleaning and for the washing machine.
We found towels, slippers, soaps and shampoos. The only thing the sheets are a bit old.
The location of the house is excellent, in a beautiful neighborhood a stone's throw from the metro. A little noisy in the evening due to the bars.
Highly recommend, it will be my first choice if I return to Istanbul!

we stayed at Emrah's for two weeks and it was perfect! the location is great, apartment is only a few metres away from the metro stop that takes you everywhere in Istanbul. the apartment has everything you need, from pottery to towels and everything is just as you see in the pictures.
We didn't get the chance to meet Emrah,but he was always available via text for whatever we needed.
If you're a light sleeper then this might not be the place for you, since there is a bar downstairs that plays music til late hours, for us it wasnt a problem at all tho! would definitely stay here again!

Ev sahibi güvenilir, çok ilgili ve yardımsever.
Tekrar teşekkürlerimi sunuyorum.
Kızım 4 ay kaldı burada ve bir sorun yaşamadı.Hiç rahatsız edilmedi.
Metro istasyonuna çok yakın, o kadar yakın ki 1 dakika yürüme mesafesinde.
Ve her tarafa ulaşım kolay.
Functional and well located apartment, the host is at your disposal. Everything was almost perfect, even for a 4 month stay. However, a lot of noise in the evening until late (neighbours, bar)

description:
I have 11 apartments where I can host my guests. If this apartment is not available on the dates you want, please check the other apartments in my profile. You can find all the reviews about me on my profile.

My apartment is within walking distance to Istiklal Street. Thus, bus, subway etc. located in Taksim Square. you can easily reach public transportation vehicles. It is also very close to Karaköy and Beşiktaş. You can shop from stores in the street and eat and drink in cafes and restaurants

reviews.text:
Plus points about the apartment was definitely the location and good communication from the host. Also the size of the apartment is as described & the photos are certainly genuine. However, most likely very old. Everything was in need of some renovation. The bathroom was disgusting in parts. Water was constantly dripping because of some broken pipe and the bathroom floor was always wet. There was also mold on the wall behind the sink and the toilet is almost falling apart. The shower also needs to be renovated. The tiles in the wall are almost falling out and everything is a bit broken in the bathroom.
For a short stay this apartment is okay. However, after 6 days we were getting very annoyed with the dilapidated bathroom.
The towels were also dirty and made of the cheapest material. As was the bed linen.
The apartment is recommended because of its location! The area is really great and there is a lot to experience and discover.

I stayed two weeks here and I would consider staying again. The place was clean, spacious enough for me and close to shops, cafes, restaurants, Taksim Square, Istiklal... I would like to emphasize that even though its in a very lively location, you can barely hear noise from outside.
The only time I was slightly bothered by the noise was due to other people in the building moving around in the corridor and speaking loudly in the night or very early in the morning - nothing major though.
The airconditioning saved me in the 30+ degree heat and having the washing machine was also helpful during a longer trip like mine.
This was my 5th time in Istanbul so I didn't need much advice or recommendations from the host, but whenever I had questions, I always got answers quickly! I think I got value for my money during my stay. Thanks!

This Airbnb was just as described. It was walking distance many restaurants bars shops. Important things was there was elevator, AC, washing machine. It was spacious. Host was very responsive. Could not hear noise from outdoors. Thank you!!

I cannot begin to explain how incredible Oguz was! He accepted my request last minute. Within minutes of accepting the request that I submitted same day, he allowed me to check in immediately! I had initially gone to a different Airbnb that didn’t have AC and I was dying! He was so quick to accept and allow me in, he saved the day and made my experience in Istanbul so much better. His large studio apartment was amazing! It’s a solid space for 1 or 2 people. Very modern and clean. No noise from outside at night. I slept like a baby every night. I fell in love with the street the home was located on. It was like a 7-10 minute walk to Taksim yet tucked away from the craziness. I can’t wait to return!

I was here for business and the apartment is located a few hundred meters from our office so that was great for me. It is also very near the famous Istiklal street and Taksim square.
The room was clean and the bed was quite comfortable so I could sleep well. Communication with the host was without problems.

description: Your apartment in Taksim square, entertainment venues, transport to a safe place and a 3-minute walk from Istiklal Street. Grocery stores and cafes open 7/24 and there are many hotels around around. Offering a comfortable stay in the heart of the city with mixed modern and traditional Turkish décor just 150 meters from Taksim Square.Also the famous Cihangir cafe streets are only 800 meters away.

reviews.text:
First, I must say Hasan truly makes the stay hospitable and welcoming. He provided me with suggestions and tips on restaurants, transportation, site-seeing and even booked a dinner cruise for me at a cheaper price than advertised on the flyer. Always available to assist as necessary. Very grateful to him.
I felt the room was of smaller size, and on rushing to book, I did not pay much attention to the pictures which do not really give an idea of the room dimensions. Traveling with 3 large luggage and 2 carry-on left little space in the room. I think this space is ideal for single luggage, single carry-on travelers. It is more of a room with a queen bed, a sofa, with kitchen amenities than a suite in my opinion. The bathroom is a little dated but the entire unit is clean. Just providing some clarity here, and not being critical or dismissive of the property.
The location is generally quiet at night and accessible to restaurants and public transportation. It is very much a touristy area, with businesses in the area geared at tourists. There is quite some cultural diversity in the area which is welcoming.
Cok durust, guleryuzlu ve yardımcı ev sahibi. Temiz ve rahat odalar. WiFi iyi calısiyor. Konum guzel. Tavsiye ederm. Ev sahibine 5 yıldız.

Great host from Mr. Hasan. The place was clean and has all the needed faccilities. The location was perfect. 2 min walk from Taksim Square, where you can access to metro or bus stations to all over Istanbul. When I come back to Istanbul, don't need to worry about staying. 🖐

It is highly accessible to Hasan, the owner, who reply to our messages in minutes 99% of the time. Originally We had some confusion and misunderstanding on the type of apartments we intend to stay. But within a day the confusion was solved and we could stay in the expected apartment. Also, Hasan took care of customers’ needs and helped out to make the stay more convenient- mother cannot walk so Hasan arranged the apt on the G/F. Thank you Hasan. You’ve been a great host.

Great place to stay. Hasan and his father are very friendly and helpful!! Location is perfectly close to the center. Place is big enough for 1-2 people. Outstanding hospitality.
WiFi speed was ~16 / 10 Mbps. Morning prayer is audible.

description:
Sultanahmet area
Grand Bazaar - 7 minutes walking distance
Sultanahmet Mosque - 11 minutes walking distance
Sultanahmet Square - 11 minutes walking distance
Ground cistern - 12 minutes walking distance
Hagia Sophia - 13 minutes walking distance
Egypt Bazaar - 17 minutes walking distance
Topkapı Palace - 19 minutes walking distance
Çemberlitaş Historical Bath-8 minutes walking distance

reviews.text: Clean and spacious room. Walking distance from tourist attractions and shops. A looot of restaurants around the hotel and what was most important for us - private parking right in front of the hotel. The host responded fast and answered all of our questions. Will definitely visit again.
The host was a great, the hotel room is absolutely clean. It is the same as shown in the pictures and in a great location.

Great host, the hotel is located at an ideal location, walkable distance to Grand Bazar, Hagia Sofia, also close to tram station. Can be a bit noisy at times at night as people keep walking by the street and make noise. Also, the room could do with better curtains, this could be just me as I like to sleep in a pitch dark room. Other than that a great place.

I stayed there with my wife and daughter from 13th to 17th july, and then 19th to 24th july again.
There were three host Mr manor, Mr fazool and 3rd guy i don't remember his name but all three host were extremely helpful, always guiding about the routes and always available.
Rooms very neat and clean, shops and resturant on walking distance, grandbazaar very near 7 to 8 mins walk only.
Good value for money. A helpful staff and somewhat clean room.

description:
Welcome to the magnificent atmosphere next to the Galata Tower

Would you like to be inspired as you sip your morning coffee against the Galata tower?

While watching the Galata Tower on one side of the window, you will see Müeyyetzade Mosque with a mystical atmosphere on the other hand.

Our apartment has a completely private, fast Wi-Fi, Smart TV, a comfortable bed, a high-performance air conditioning, a mini kitchen.

Come and create unforgettable memories in this fascinating corner of Galata

reviews.text: I only stayed one night but I will return without hesitation. Location is very good as expected but the bedroom is off the street so it was a surprisingly quiet night. The flat was well taken care of, clean and much larger than I expected. Tight flight of stairs as usual in Istanbul, but manageable. Water in the fridge was much appreciated. Easy to find and great Comms. Self check in and privacy are a USP in the city, so also good.

Mehmet's apartment is in a great location right in the centre and accessible to all public transport. It is as described however the bedroom windows are facing a wall. It needs a little upgrading in terms of bathroom / kitchen and the towels we got were the size of a flannel. However overall it is a great stay and Mehmet is a really helpful host who helped with everything we asked. Would recommend !

The apartment's location was perfect. It was very clean and well-equipped. The owner, Mehmet Bey, answered all our questions in great detail. He was very attentive to guest satisfaction. The apartment has a well-functioning, high-performance air conditioner, which was a real plus. The double bed in the bedroom was very comfortable. The bathroom had pressurized hot water. There's also a Smart TV in the living room for your enjoyment.
The apartment has a stunning view of the Galata Tower from the window, just like in the photos. It's located in the heart of the area, surrounded by all the restaurants and shopping malls. You can reach all the historical sites by tram in just a few minutes. Taksim is a few minutes' walk away.
We will definitely be back and stay longer.

We stayed at Senem's apartment for a little over a week and loved it!
The location is AWESOME because it is literally a few steps away from the Galata Tower. Why is this such an advantage? Well, the tower can be seen from almost all over the city, so if you're ever lost, just follow the tower ;) The location was on the intersection of bustling streets and was pretty touristic, but one street over there is a super quiet street with small cafes and coffee shops. North of the apartment is a pedestrian shopping street and the side streets off of that have allll the best Turkish food! Quick walk to the ferries and to a trendy part of town, and even only 30 minutes walk to the mosques across the river.
The apartment itself was exceptionally clean! It was very spacious which was sooo nice. After traveling for a few weeks, we were very happy to have plenty of room to spread out and even have some privacy within the apartment. I loved the decor and sitting in the little window nook where you can see the Galata tower. While it is bustling during the day, the nights were very quiet and the bedroom is an easy escape from any street noise.
The only downside was not having air conditioning. I don't think this is a huge problem as the temperature is easy to regulate with the windows (the window in the bedroom let in really nice cool air at night), but my partner gets hot easily and would have liked AC. Also, we visited during one of the hottest weeks of the year so I think you wouldn't have a problem literally any other month!
Overall, we loved our stay and loved our little neighborhood. Everybody was so kind and welcoming, including our hosts. 10/10 would stay again!

The apartment was exactly as described clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Communication was smooth, and the check-in process was easy. The location was also great, close to everything we needed. I highly recommend staying here and would definitely come back!

description:
Discover the perfect blend of convenience and comfort at our centrally located flat. With just a few steps to the famous Istiklal Caddesi (Taksim street) and a short 10-minute walk to Taksim Square, you'll find yourself at the heart of Istanbul's vibrant atmosphere. The strategic location ensures easy access to all public transportation options, making it a breeze to explore the city's attractions.
We look forward to hosting you and providing a delightful experience in the heart of Istanbul!

reviews.text:
Appartament it's central with walkable distance to most Istanbul attractions.
Very clean, was cleaned daily and any ask for towels, etc were done immediately.
It's located in busy area, so it's watch out if you want peace and quiet place - we didn't mind Istanbul buzzing atmosphere but for some it could be an issue.
Appartament it's very comfortable with good size bathroom and leaving room. 2 bedrooms were small but as on pictures.
We didn't use kitchen as breakfast was included and restaurant on same street was great and open long enough to get food if needed.

I was a little skeptical about booking this stay because there weren’t any other reviews but I’m glad I did! The host was so helpful & made sure our stay was as comfortable as possible. The apartment is just as beautiful as the pictures but try not to bring a lot of luggage because the room isn’t spacious. It’s in a great location but that comes at a price. There is a club right next to the building so if you’re a light sleeper be advised because it definitely gets loud sometimes. Just walking distance from all the shops and restaurants. If you’re a night owl this is the place for you. It was also very easy to catch a taxi from there since the station is a few meters away. Overall, it’s a beautiful place & I really enjoyed my stay here. Definitely recommend to anyone else.

Very good location, but a little difficult to find initially. Instructions to find reception could be clearer, but the attached Hotel and amenities are excellent, especially the Spa and pool. Very nice. A bit noisy at night, but that is the price you pay if you want to be central, and we wouldn't have been more central. This was pointed out on the advert though, so no complaints. Comfortable and well furnished - my only complaint is that the kitchen wasn't terribly well equipped in terms of glasses, cups and cookware. I would definitely recommend and would stay again

Excellent stay . Appartement has amazing design same as pictures. SPA and breakfast on the wonderful rooftop terrace with view on the city. The place has reception which very welcoming and kind. The apartment was cleaned every single day and the location is amazing (CENTER OF ISTANBUL). All restaurants, shops, touristic places are nearby. The host was very responsive. I HAVE NEVER SAW THIS QUICK SERVICE in my life. He replied almost straightaway and exceeded my expectations. Will definitely come back ! Truly recommend

Great location and very clean when we arrived. The gym is subpar but better than nothing. Emir down in the lobby was incredibly helpful and kind to us. There is partying late every night outside the apartment but the windows are pretty soundproof, so we weren’t much bothered. Host was helpful and responsive. Overall a nice place in an awesome location.

description: Our hotel is located in Pera district where you can feel the history intensely. It is 25 m from Şişhane metro station and 5 minutes walk to Galata tower, 3 minutes to İstiklal Street and the historical tunnel. Our 35 m2 large rooms are designed to provide all your needs.

reviews.text: This apartment was exactly what we needed for our stay in Istanbul. It was small, but clean and our host was responsive and made check in and check out easy. We had a slight problem with the shower getting clogged - but other than that, this was a great value.

Rezervasyonumuz teraslıydı ancak oda küçük olması nedeniyle başka bir oda vermek istemişler. Zaten sabah erkenden çıkacağımız için sorun etmedik ama sonuçta teraslı oda fiyatı ödemiştim.
Ayrıca banyoda saç vardı pek temiz değildi
Konum olarak harika bir yerdi ve Volkan Beyle iletişimde hiç sorun yaşamadık.
Ve odada fazla eşya olmadığı için biraz soğuktu klimayı çalıştırdık ancak oda büyük ve eşyaları az olduğu için zor ısındı. Bir dahakine gene konaklarız ancak daha dikkat edilmeli

İstanbulda temiz, rahat bir konaklama ve gezilecek her yere yakın bir yer mi arıyorsunuz? Hiç macera aramayın burayı tercih edin. Volkan beyin nezaketi, size hızlı dönüş yapması, pırıl pırıl bir konaklama sunması gerçekten takdire değer. Fiyatı da sunduğu imkanlara göre çok makul. Emin olun boş bulabilirsem İstanbula geldiğimde tereddütsüz seçeceğim bir yer.

Perfect as a base for visiting the city. Great location, nice building, very clean.
Room was smaller than expected, and at the 5th floor (with no elevator). It was perfect for what we needed.
Careful cause there’s often dogshit right outside the entrance (nobody’s fault, but probably a local dog that likes the spot ;)

I recently had the pleasure of staying in Volkan's unit in Istanbul, and it was nothing short of perfect. From the moment I arrived until the day I left, I was thoroughly impressed with the accommodations and the overall experience.
The standout feature of Volkan's unit has to be the beautiful balcony.
The unit itself was cozy and impeccably clean. It had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay, a comfortable bed, and a spotless bathroom.
The location of the unit is another highlight. It's centrally situated, which allowed me to easily explore the vibrant streets of Istanbul. I was able to walk to many of the city's famous landmarks and sample some of the delicious local cuisine at nearby restaurants.

description: Our apt stay in the kadıköy/ hasanpasa aria 5 min far from metro 10 min from metrobus and marmaray

reviews.text:
It's a good location close to pretty much everything you would need to get around and many shops close by.
The apartment itself is very clean and nice and was as described.
Erol is a very helpful and kind host, I had a great time on my vacation while staying here and would recommend to anybody looking for a room in Istanbul/Kadıköy

the room was not the same as in the photos, dirty bathroom, i slept only on a mattress without bed and the door was broken you can't even close it and the heating system was in the room making noise the whole time.

The room exactly looks like pics and spacious and clean and comfy bed. The location is convenient and cafe and supermarkets nearby. Erol is friendly and we communicate with no issues. It was very nice to stay.

My stay at his house was very comfortable. The host is kind and friendly, so you won't have any problems during your stay. There is also a bus stop and subway station nearby, so access to the surrounding area is also good.

The owner was the kind person, so very lovely, and talkative. Every-single-thing what you need just tell him and you will be very helped about it. Even the location was a little bit boring, but you can get your privacy and rest well. The facilities are complete even the kitcen. If you look for cheap and comfort place to stay, this house is in your option. But if you choose to getting more fancy and looks-goody house, you can rent another place that more expensive and pricely. All choice is yours. Thanks!!

description:
Wifi internet. Located in the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museum, theater, concert halls and movie theaters located at Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul, awaits to welcome its new residents. Walking distance to places such as Nisantaşı, Taksim and Cihangir.

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Has a city view, please check photos for details.

reviews.text:
I had a great stay at this apartment. It was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very friendly, responsive, and always quick to help with anything I needed.
The location was excellent, and I highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality

The apartment is as it was described, it was clean and spotless and had everything we needed, although we didnt cook so I cannot comment on the kithen utensils. The host was quick to respond and offered a great ans welcoming experience. We also managed to use the pool and gym once, which was clean and quiet.
We were able to walk back from Taksim Square, which is about 20 minutes away, we travelled by taxi and didn't use the public transport so cannot comment on the ease of getting the public transport from there.
Thank you for the lovely stay.

Overall, we had a good stay and the apartment offered very good value for money. The listing was mostly accurate, and the sauna, pool, and gym facilities were all very nice and well maintained.
However, there were a few issues that affected our stay. The apartment is advertised for three or four guests, but the extra bed was extremely uncomfortable and not really suitable for a proper night’s sleep. The Wi-Fi was also a little frustrating, as we regularly had to log in again after being disconnected. Additionally, the listing mentioned a shared hot tub, but there was no hot tub available during our stay.
Apart from these points, we really enjoyed our time in Istanbul. Considering the price, the apartment offers excellent value for money, and I would definitely recommend it.

The building is very clean, and the apartment itself was spotless and comfortable. The location is excellent, close to many areas and very convenient for getting around. Everything was good for a decent and enjoyable stay, and I felt very comfortable throughout my time there.
The only downside was that the coffee shops located in the building are extremely overpriced (I was charged 900 lira for just 2 croissants), which felt like a scam, but this has nothing to do with the apartment itself.
Overall, I had a great stay and will definitely come back and stay here again

The stay was amazing, very professional team always responsive to any request.
Ad for the apartment it looks exactly like the picture with all the amenities listed available and more, the area is clean, walking distance to taksim and istiklal.
All in all it’s a 10/10 and recommend you to come stay here. Will definitely book here again on our next trip to Istanbul.
Çok Güzel

description:
This is a 32-square-meter, fully- furnished, serviced apartment on the ground floor of the building, with full-size windows. It is only 5-minute walk to Istiklal Street and 15-minute to Taksim Square.
It is brand new and very clean.

reviews.text: After a one week stay, I must say that I cannot recommend this place. One of the previous reviews said that this place is an authentic experience. No, it’s not. If you want an authentic experience you need to stay somewhere in the middle of the spectrum, not in a neighborhood that looks like post-war syria. This is like staying in the slums. It's near istikal street but I don't think that's a big deal and taksim square has nothing interesting. Fatih would've been a better choice but that was purely my fault. The check-in was awful. I had to call the host when I arrived because I couldn’t find the place based on pictures. It isn’t visible from the street and is sandwiched between dilapidated buildings with broken and missing windows. In addition, the host didn’t remember I was arriving that day. Then, the people who were checking me in, wanted my passport to photocopy. I’ve never had to give my passport to any places I’ve stayed, all the way from Scandinavia to Jordan and Egypt. I wouldn’t have had a problem if they’d told me beforehand. I never met Nida during my whole stay and she doesn’t live in the building. It’s a apartment building furnished for rental and also serves as a makeshift hotel. The wifi is slow and goes in and out. Nighttime noises included helicopters, street cats fighting, street dogs howling, and this weird loud gurgling noise that comes from the kitchen sink. There were occasional brown-outs, in which the power went off for a few minutes. The road payment outside is crumbling and the streets smell like cat piss. The one good thing about this place is that the interior looks like the pictures.

It was a great place. Well located and everybody were very helpful all the time.
The flat was very clean and it looks the same as in the photos. Very close to Taksim area. In case you bring heavy luggage, keep in mind there are a lot of stairs in the building.
Thanks for your hospitality!!

This is a great place to stay. The location is walking distance to Galata tower. We were met by staff at check. You get the code for the gate in advance. The apartment looks exactly like the listing. We only stayed two nights and didn’t use the kitchen but the kitchen has a ceramic stove with glass top and a couple of pans and cutlery is provided. The ac unit is located near the kitchen area and can cool the room even on a hot day. The bed is very comfortable. The bathroom is spotless. The hosts are very helpful and responsive. Unfortunately we didn’t meet them in person but you can ask them anything by message/phone. Overall a great experience!

Nida and her husband were very welcoming, helpful with instructions, and suggestions for visiting the city. She gave us her WhatsApp number on arrival and told us we could contact her at any time if we needed help. She was quick to respond the few times we contacted her. The apartment is small, but very modern, clean and well equipped. There is plenty of room to sleep for 3, and the pull out bed is surprisingly very comfortable. There is small courtyard with table and umbrella which is lovely for morning breakfast, and a small lounge area that is indoors. It is gated and secure. It is centrally located and very easily accessible from the metro. Located on the pedestrian street off Taxim, it is an interesting walk to and from the apartment. We we were 3 women traveling alone, and felt comfortable and safe staying here and traveling into the city. We used public transportation for our entire stay. I would recommend this apartment without reservation.

is apartment was everything we wished for and more! located just 2 minutes walk of Omar Hayam bus station, 5 minutes Taksim Square, potless modern apartment with coffee and tea available, Nida the host, could not have been nicer!responding very fast and very helpful, Places the same as picture, very clean, cozy , comfortable.. I would strongly recommend his place.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
We loved our stay in Taksim! Great location (you are right in the heart of it) and very clean! We were a group of 4 in total - one couple and 2 friends - and the place suited us perfectly. We didn’t use the kitchen at all as there is so much good food nearby, but it was nice to have a fridge for bottled water. The shower was great - nice water pressure and stayed hot even with 4 of us. The host was incredible and very responsive! My partner and I got in very late on a Saturday night, and they stayed up to meet us/ let us in.
The neighborhood is lively and has tons of nightlife, but the apartment stayed rather quiet (maybe because you are up on the 2nd floor)! We also appreciated that there’s a door in between the double bed room (where me and my partner slept) and the other room where our friends were sleeping, so you have a bit of privacy between the two. (Also good to keep out the snoring noises if one of you is a loud sleeper! 😂)
There’s also a lift if you need it, but it’s not a huge walk up the stairs, so we only used the lift when we checked in with our big bags. It worked great, though!
This is not a luxury apartment so don’t expect lots of frills or fancy design, but it’s got the best location, very clean, fairly quiet, and has everything you need, and the host makes it a fantastic and easy experience. All in all, a great value and I would definitely come back to stay here again!

This is not a personal attack on the host, so please read this review for what it is.
The property is located in a central location and other than that it is to be avoided at all costs if you value your health.
-Black mold throughout the property
-Black mold in the bathroom
-Black mold behind the dresser
-Black mold behind the print in the main area.
-Black mold behind the curtains near the windows.
-Black mold on the ceiling above the bed in the inner room.
-The tv is not a 72-inch, it's a 32 inch
-Wi-fi is unstable and not suitable for work. It is broadcasted via a repeater.
-Bathroom blow dryer is dangerous and the wires are not safe
-The area at the rear of the inner bedroom looks like a garbage dump
-Mold by the kitchen sink, bathroom sink, and shower stall.
-Paint is peeling in several locations.
This property is infested with mold. This property needs to be treated for mold by a professional. I do not appreciate the fact my family's health was compromised because of negligence by the host.

Serdar was a great host - friendly and helpful. The location of the accommodation was good, decent number of restaurants at walkable distance and a lovely breakfast place just around the corner, a few feet away. The living room (where there were 2 cots) was a bit noisy at night even with all the windows closed, but the bedroom was rather quiet and peaceful. The kitchen area was very cramped and the dishes were not very clean, unfortunately. We scrubbed them real hard before use and even then we weren't very happy with them! The flat felt fairly warm one afternoon in the second week of may when we were there and we couldn't turn on the air conditioning. When we checked with Serdar, he simply said the airconditioner would be available only from the third week of May! This was not mentioned in the listing (which listed airconditioner as an amenity), which we were not thrilled about. Otherwise, Serdar was kind enough to give us a slightly late checkout and the other utilities were fine.

It is a small one bedroom apartment with two single beds in the entrance. Washroom is neat and clean. A tiny area is dedicated for the kitchen. A little noisy at times. Overall my trip was smooth. Serder was very good in communication and co operative as well. I booked this apartment twice in my trip. Location is good. Good restaurants and shops around. Bus station Omar Hayyam is very very close. A lively place overall.

Great Host
Rooms are very clean and as in pictures
Location of the apartment is great
But dont rent a car if your staying, its all walking distance and its hard to find a parking.

description: You will be staying in the most active and lively environment by staying in this one-of-a-kind place.

reviews.text: The location is very noisy, cause it’s in the middle of the clubs and bars. But the place itself nice as described, communication is very good 👍 you can check in any time

Very good value for the money I paid. The room was very clean, located in a central and safe area. The staff at the reception were very kind and helpful. They allowed us to check in one hour earlier and even let us leave our luggage for the day after check-out.

The apartment was clean, the beds were comfortable. The building is in a great neighborhood - near to anything you might need - shops, cafés, restaurants, bars and discos. There was also a bar at the top of the building from which you could see a great part of the city. Definitely recommend the place.
Harika konum güler yüzlü işletme sahipleri oda çok büyük temiz ve huzurluydu herşey fotoğraflarda ve verilen bilgilerdeki eksiksiz ve güzeldi. Gidecek olan herkese tavsiye ederim.

this place was amazing, excellent location and above all the entire team was very helpful, respectful and caring. the entire was very friendly. I felt living at a friends place. Will visit again definitely.

description: Located 1 minute walking distance from Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, the room has been designed to accommodate 3 people in total. The room has a balcony and a Bosphorus view and a kitchen where you can cook..

reviews.text:
Pros:
• Location: just a minute away from Taxim Square
• Nice view from the balcony
• The flat is modern
Cons:
• The water going to the toilet was blocked, so the toilet was not working for the first 3 hours before a plumber came.
• In the meantime we were offered to go to a different flat if we needed a bathroom. I was very surprised when I saw an undone bed and bottles of alcohol. Someone probably just checked out and the room has not been cleaned yet...
• The kitchen was very basic with a small knife that can't cut anything.
• The bathroom is cramped. The water from the shower escapes and forms a puddle under the toilet.
• The lift was working the first day, but then it started skipping our floor and painfully slowly going to the next one.

Wonderful host really generous, welcoming and helpful people who are 24/7 reachable. The location is perfect. Our room was cozy but some days the water stopped and we had some issues with the toilet which was not their fault.

Great location, in the middle of Taksim square. The employees are so friendly the room is same as the pictures. My room didn't have a fridge but i didnt need one. The room wasn't extremely clean but it was okay. The overall experience was really nice as the staff are so friendly.

What a lovely stay, we really enjoyed our stay and wish we stayed more. Been to Istanbul before but this time was different. Really amazing room with stunning sea view in a very nice neighborhood. Best stay i had in turkey.
The Room was so clean and everything functional. From lightning to comfort to the smell. Just cant say enough. If you came across this place just book it without thinking and the owner Ali will make your stay more than enjoyable.

A really good place to stay. The location is very central and close to the metro and taksim square.
The room itself was spacious and clean, the view from the balcony is amazing. The staff were very communicative as well and always checked to make sure I was enjoying my stay.
This place is definitely recommended!

description:
Our brand new flat is suitable for large groups. You will have a unique accommodation experience with its central location, proximity to transportation vehicles and modern design.

No elevator in the building.

5 minutes walking distance to Taksim Square, metro station and tram station. 10 minutes away from the beach and the ferry port. Sultanahmet and the historical peninsula are 15-20 minutes away.

Beds, towels and linens are provided from a supplier of luxury hotels.

reviews.text:
Leo was super underrating on letting us check in early since the previous resv. at other location didn’t work out.
The Good: The apt has plenty of space and very big. Close to shopping and tourist areas. There is a small convenience store just outside the building. We visited several times to get water, beer, and snacks. Apt. located in the 1st floor. Having a washing machine traveling with kids was fantastic!
The Bad: The beds are SUPER hard. The bathroom needs a good deep cleaning. Not the cleanest (this is big for us). The smell of cat when you come in the building is awful (once you are inside the apt. you can’t smell it anymore). Better lighting in the bathroom would be great. A long mirror would be great to get ready since the bathroom mirror is the only one available.

This apartment was a terrible and unsafe experience. The place is extremely dirty: cockroaches inside, flying insects in the kitchen, and a constant unpleasant smell. The furniture is broken and filthy; the bed and headboard are stained, and the walls are full of marks and damage. The bathroom has a sharp glass shelf at head level that is very dangerous and could easily injure someone. The infrastructure is poor: cracked floor tiles, exposed and broken electrical boxes, and unprofessional repairs around doors and walls. Electricity went off 3 times every day, and before checkout the power was cut at 11:40 AM, whether deliberately or not. The air conditioning was installed badly, and overall maintenance is completely neglected. This apartment does not reflect the listing at all – in fact, the photos are very misleading. The place is not suitable for living, and the fair value should not exceed 50 USD per night. Strongly advise not to book this property.

Great host always responsive and friendly! Place was great and as described I'd recommend. Only problem was there was a rude neighbour however other than that the actual property was really good and great location walking distance to Taksim Square. Spacious for 10 people and everyone felt comfortable.
