The stay was absolutely perfectoo!!
Location is very central and close to public transportation, making it easy to get around.
The apartment was well-maintained.

The host "Mr. Mami" was very responsive and helpful, always quick to assist with any questions.
Professional communication...

Check-in was smooth. The space was quiet and comfortabe. İ've got a grest rest.
The design and atmosphere of the place were also quite pleasant.

Highly recommended for anyone guys🙌🫶

description: My house is located in heart of istanbul Taksim, the distance to the famous taksim square, istiklal street, public transport points, metro etc only 500 meters a way. Our full furnished apartment is at the entrance floor, you can find all equipments like hair dryer, tv, heater, A/C, internet, youtube, netflix, dishwasher, washing machine, iron, wicrowave, kitchenware, cooking, pan, pot, blender, kettle, cup, sugar, tea, coffe etc.

reviews.text:
We had a fantastic stay! The host was truly exceptional — very kind, helpful, and always quick to respond. You can really feel that he cares about his guests. He made everything easy and comfortable for us, and we are very grateful.
The apartment was clean, cozy, and exactly as shown in the photos. The kids loved it, especially because it was a duplex! The location was perfect — only 7 minutes walking to Taksim Square, very easy to find, and surrounded by supermarkets, cafes, and other shops.
The neighborhood felt safe, and the house itself was beautiful. We had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Overall, 10/10 experience. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you for being such an amazing host!

Firstly, when I arrived, we hadn’t slept in 24+ hours, We were exhausted from a long flight, sweaty, felt overall just uncomfortable so we all needed showers and water to freshen up. We took a taxi to his place and turns out there’s no water and no heating on a 9-10 Celsius day (48F). He didn’t mention anything about water being off, He knew about it since it was scheduled. I figured it out myself when I arrived. I took a one hour uber but still no mention of water. Heating wasn’t working too. Water was off for around 3-4 hours but in our circumstance, it feels miserable.
Secondly, I asked the host for a small compensation maybe $30 40 out of the $160 I payed for the water being off, he called me a liar, told me “I would prefer if you leave”, and called me a blackmailer. Very very unprofessional.
Falsely advertised, extremely tiny and not maintained. Paint is coming off the walls, it is not 7 beds only 5. Not 2 bedrooms either. Pictures look MUCH better condition than it is.

We would like to express our sincere thanks to the host for their wonderful hospitality. The apartment was excellent, and its exceptional location near Istanbul's main attractions made getting around very easy, saving us a lot of time and effort.
The host was extremely helpful and polite, and the house was clean and comfortable. We highly recommend staying here, and we will definitely repeat the experience on our next visit!"

Good sized room with lots of sleeping area. Good location and walkable to many shops and restaurants as well as public transport by Taksim square. Beds were not comfortable and kitchen was not well equipped and not very clean. It would be fine for a short stay but I wouldn’t stay more than a night or two.

Don't recommend!
The place was smaller that we thought, basically a small area, a tiny kitchen, and a narrow hallway which lead to one bedroom.
The patio outside was full of bird feces and they would always poop right above the patio where we wanted to hang out. My dad would clean the patio everyday before we went out to have some breakfast there because there wasn't enough room inside for 6 people to eat.
The bathroom was unclean and the toilet bowl brush was literally covered in feces. The shower was very small and the bathroom sink was far in. We basically had to bend over to reach the sink.
They cleaned the house twice, it didn't look like they ever really cleaned the bathroom or the kitchen.
There was no detergent left and when we asked they told us that we just had to buy it ourselves. They had put water in the dish soap so it'd last longer.
Finally, the whole house was humid and we couldn't dry our clothes inside and couldn't put them outside because of the birds.

description: The apartment is located in the heart of Istanbul. It is located at one of the most famous district named "Halaskargazi". The metro station is literally in downstairs. It takes 1 minute to reach Osmanbey Metro Station, 5 minutes to Cevahir Shopping Mall, 5 Minutes to Nişantaşı and 10 minutes to Taksim. The apartment is fully renovated and it is 35 square meters net. It has 2 air conditions, big screen TV, fast wifi and all other equipments you may need.

reviews.text: This is my second time renting this apartment, so it’s obvious how comfortable I feel , it’s right exactly at the center of Istanbul, Nişantaşı is 5 minutes away by walking, mehmet is so friendly and helpful the place is clean and feels like home , definitely Kareem’s apartments will always be my first choice 🙏🏼

Its very good location to start. The couch was different than on the pictures and had a cigarette mark on it which was a bit disappointing. The apartment was clean and having and AC was a bonus aswellz
What is very confusing is the correspondence since there is a house manager whom you communicate with, different than the host himself. It was all managable but it wasnt a frictionless and contactless experience I am used to from renting airbnb in other countries. Just something to keep in mind. I would recommend staying in the a place otherwise. I was treated respectfully.

the flat is nice and the neighborhood is very nice and safe, however the price is definetely too high if you do long term rent (the bed is not so good, neither the sofa, no cleaning during the stay). apart from that, good place after all and host was nice!

Great location on a busy street, great stay. Apartment is on the smaller side, esp. the bedroom, literally only the bed fits in there, nothing else. but it's a big enough space for 1-2 people I'd say.
Sisli is a great neighborhood to stay in, and i would def stay in this apt and area again. It was the end of a one month stay in Turkey for me so I had a rental car for one last day. You'll definitely not find street parking but there's a mall down the street that has an otopark (parking garage). The metro station is 50m or less away down the block, perfect. Took less than 30 mins to get to the main tourist areas like Sultanahmet Square.

I had a great stay here. The apartment was exactly what I needed for a quick 3-day stay in Istanbul. It’s close to the metro, countless restaurants, and grocery stores. The host was flexible with check-in and the process of getting in was very easy. The facilities made the stay very comfortable. Would recommend!

description: The last thing you should worry about is your comfort on a holiday. Rappel Bosphorus Suite has anything you need for a pleasant stay even a spectacular view. Located in the center of the beautiful city Istanbul. 5min funicular to Taksim Square, 1min walk to Kabataş Boat and Tram Stations, which takes just 10mins to the old city Sultanahmet or the Islands. But the real city feeling to experience is right at the corner or 5 min walk to Cihangir to discover cool bars and restaurants.

reviews.text:
The apartment and the host - Ali Sina were awesome !! Ali’s communication pre and during our stay was amazing ! He was very responsive and helped us arrange our airport transfers, restaurant reservations and was available for any questions we had!
The apartment was perfect for our family of four. The two bedrooms are spacious with very comfortable beds and beddings!! The apartment was very clean and as shown in the pictures!!
The air conditioner in all the rooms was a very big plus and we were very comfortable in the apartment. The Bosporus view from the lobby and the balcony was never tiring! The bldg and the surrounding area is quiet and daily need stuff and groceries is available just outside the apt!!
Apartment location is also ideal for metro and has many attractions in walking distance !! Will highly recommend the space and the host !!

Well words won’t do justice to the place-
Excellent Location- close to literally everything. Right next to train station
Breathtaking View- You can’t ask for something better when you wake up.
Comfy beds/ good wifi/ Neat an clean apartment.
Excellent communication by Ali Sina who was really helpful and highly responsive.
Also don’t forget to visit Rapples as we had one of the best breakfast ever.
Highly highly recommended

I stayed 6 nights at Sina’s place. I couldn’t find a word to describe the overall experience rather than PERFECT!
Location: GREAT
Neighborhood full of mini markets, cafes, bars, food places…etc
Tram/Metro/Ferry stations are 2-3 mins away walking.
The apartment is on the first floor, a couple of steps to climb only.
The building is on a flat street; so you don’t have to hustle Istanbul’s steep hills to reach the place.
The view is BREATHTAKING!
Check-in: SUPER EASY
Couldn’t get easier and smoother!
Apartment: EXCELLENT
Everything was clean & tidy. Rooms & bathrooms were clean. ACs worked perfectly. WiFi was very good.
Host: AMAZING!
This was my 4th time visiting Istanbul. And I can surely say, by far; Sina is the best host I’ve ever had on Airbnb.
She was VERY friendly, responsive, easy going, understanding, helpful, kind…you name it!
Honestly; it was an unforgettable experience.
All in all, this place is the best option to stay at in Istanbul.
Thank you for everything Sina 🙏🏻

Our host Ali Sina was very accommodating to our requests with our 1 year old infant, with providing everything we needed for the baby's needs. Due to the booking schedule for his lovely apartment, he was also flexible with earlier check in (as our flight came in early and the baby needed a place to take her nap), and late checkout on the day we departed due to a night flight and luckily he had the place free for that day. His communication is immediate and concise as well as precise. He is able to really help make his home a home away from home for you.
The apartment : large 2 bedroom in an older building, somewhat recently renovated with modern fittings and appliances. Location is stellar, right across from the Kabatas ferry terminal/tram with an unobstructed 180 degree water view. Super convenient to move and see all the sights of Istanbul, single stop tram to Taksim Square/Istiklal. Some great restaurants and provisions nearby, coffee shops, supermarkets, etc. 5 mins walk to Dolmabache, 15mins walk to Galataport Shops/Restaurants. Istanbul is very hilly so if you enjoy good exercise like we do, you'll love it. If you prefer to move with public transit, this is perfectly located as well.
We would definitely stay with Sina on our next visit to Istanbul and will also recommend his places to fellow friends and family. Thanks again for everything!

We had a brilliant stay in Ali Sina’s Bosphorus apartment. It was even better than the photos, the view is incredible, the apartment was clean and spacious with everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
It’s a very well connected location with tram, funicular and ferry a few minutes walk away.
Thank you so much for a great holiday!

description:
Fully furnished flat in the heart of Moda/Kadikoy. Perfect location, close to all leisure places, easy access to the ferry, metrobus, subway.

Spacious, safe, 2+1 fully furnished apartment close to all means of transportation in the heart of Moda. My home is in an exquisite area where you can easily access all transportation vehicles, shop in the heart of entertainment and attraction centers, and eat beautiful and different dishes.

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic stay at this Kadikoy Airbnb. Located on bustling Bahariye St., it's surrounded by shops, bars, and cafes, with a tram stop nearby. Public transport options like Marmaray, Metro, Metrobus, and Ferry boats are within a 20-minute walk.
The cleanliness was exceptional, with extra sheets and towels provided. The host, despite being out of town, was incredibly responsive and accommodating, making us feel welcome.
The accommodation matched the listing description perfectly. Amenities were great, though it's worth noting the shower is in a bathtub, potentially challenging for elderly guests.
Check-in/out instructions were clear, ensuring a smooth process. The value for money is excellent, considering the vibrant Kadikoy atmosphere.
Kadikoy is one of Istanbul's safest neighborhoods, with lively bars and cafes even after midnight. Overall, a memorable stay - highly recommended for those exploring Istanbul.

Konum çok merkezi, sessiz ve sakin bir apartman. Bütün toplu taşıma seçeneklerine yakın, etrafta bol miktarda yemek mekanı mevcut. Ev güzel ve temiz. Fiyat da çok uygun. Check-in kolay, ev sahibinin iletişimi başarılı. Tavsiye ederim,teşekkür ederiz.

Beril Hanıma herşey için çok teşekkür ederiz. Eve kabul aşamasında bizi kapıda karşıladılar, herşey yolunda seyretti. Evin konumu çok iyiydi, temiz ve düzenliydi. Mutfağı aktif kullanma ihtiyacı duymadık ama gereken herşey vardı. 24 saat sıcak su olması harikaydı. İstediğimiz zaman iletişime geçebildik, herşey için tekrar teşekkürler. Tekrar görüşmek dileğiyle.

beril hanım gayet kibardı, evin konumu çok iyi boğa heykeline 10 15 dk uzaklıkta ana caddelerden birinde. eve girdiğimizde yerlerde kedi kumu vardı ve kedi kokusu duyuluyordu süpürdük havalandırdık sonrasında rahat ettik. mutfağı kullanmayı tercih etmedik ancak mutfakta yeterli imkan vardı.
Konumu mukemmel bir ev. Ev sahibi cok ilgiliydi. 2 3 4 eylul tarihlerinde ev serindi

description:
🌸 The building and apartment are brand new and extremely clean. Simple and modern decoration, spacious and bright, fully equipped with facilities and items, just bring your luggage.
🌸The apartment is equipped with WiFi and a large screen high-speed Internet TV (Netflix, YouTube... Ultra HD, Smart TV features) for your use.
🌸 The first floor of the apartment is a commercial street with Migros Supermarket, Starbucks, KFC, Burger King, Watsons, Pharmacy, Yusuf Restaurant, Cinema and other complete commercial facilities.
🌸 24-hour security, a complete security system to keep you safe.

reviews.text:
The apartment is Nice and has good space.The kitchen is well equipped and the apartment is clean.you can ask for sheet if you want to. There iron and hair dryer are available in the closet.There is restaurants and ships nearby. The building is C2 so it doesn't not have access to the street
The downside:
1-There is no parking permit so you have to walk 5 minutes to get to the nearest street where migros is( the cars park there) .This is big downside to drag all of your stuff 5 minutes to get to the apartment.
2-There is no air condition in the bedroom.
I would recommend this property IF there is parking permit!!...but till there is parking permit, I will not book this property
Good location and nice and cozy apartment. Located in a nice park. Qing is a very helpful host.

They were very responsive and flexible on check-in and check-out. The place was clean and had everything we needed for the stay. Perfect place for kids with play equipment right outside the apartment.
Temizlik konusunda iyiler giriş çıkış süreci boyunca her zaman yardımcı oluyorlar yer fotoğraftakiyle birebir hiç şüpheniz olmasın

Qing was very kind and helped with a lot of communication for my family to stay there, although I didn't stay there, I appreciated the communication, flexibility, and understanding throughout these more difficult times in turkey. thank you!

description: the flat is comfartable and modern with a 15 mininutes walk to the of Istanbul, taxim square where you can find restaurants and bars. also a 10 min . walk to the metro and the funicular train station which brings you to the old city and grand bazaar.

reviews.text: Fevziye and her husband Ferhat were both friendly hosts who always responded quickly to anything. They sent a how to check in video which was very useful. There was a slight issue with the hot water during the stay and when we contacted Ferhat, he got handymen who fixed issue quickly the next working day which was great. They were very professional and friendly, responsive hosts all the way through the process. The apartment itself looks exactly like how it does on the photos. Clean, modern and has all the necssary amenities that one would require during a stay. Location was very good as well. Good transport links and close to the majority of tourist attractions. Overall i would definitely recommend Fevziye and Ferhat's place if you are looking for a great apartment for a reasonable price with consistent hosts!

I recommend both hosts and this place. Everything was as described and totally worth its price. Owners were very friendly, responsive and clear.
Concerning the location, there is a metro station nearby and plenty of food stores, restaurants and bistros. Just keep in mind that a neighborhood of the place lays on a very steep slope. So if there is a low-mobility people in your group it could be a problem but for young and healthy it should be fine.

Fevziye and Ferhat are wonderful hosts! They set up a self check in system to get into the building and apartment since our flight got in super late. Sent me videos explaining everything including how to use the internet (which was good) and other items in the place. They even let us check out late 6 days later since we had a night train to Bulgaria and they didn't have another guest checking in. We dealt with Ferhat mostly and he was very kind and responsive. The apartment was clean, cosy and comfortable. My daughter slept on the sofa bed which wasn't super comfortable but it was good enough. Great to have a washer there and the kitchen was stocked with the basics. We enjoyed our stay in this apartment and Istanbul. Just wish the taxi drivers in this town weren't such scammers. Or that the taxi apps actually worked. But at least we had wonderful airbnb hosts!

I stayed in this place for two weeks and loved everything about it and here is why:
Fevzyeh and her son Gem are two classy and nice people. They picked me up at the bus station and were very welcoming and helpful.

The Location is the prime. Ten minutes walk to Taksim Square which from there you have access to everywhere and everything easily. Regarding the uphill I would like to remind you that Istanbul has lots of them. However if you take the Babile alley you will walk on a sharp uphill for one minute, then a flat and then again another slope not very sharp. My mother walks with a cane and had no problem.

The place is not big but not small either. Well planed and design. It accommodated five people for five weeks with no problem. It is clean, new, air conditioned with fridge, stove and washing machine and of course wifi.

I could not be happier with this place. If going to Istanbul again this will be my place with no second thought.

Thank you Fevzyeh for helping me to have a perfect trip.

Comfortable apartment in a good location. Only 10-15 min walking to taksim also a lot of grocery stores near the apartment. The host is always available (responds super quick) which is awesome. Altogether a cool apartment with a cool host as well. Only suggestion for improvement is to focus more on little details like enough toilet paper , towels (only got 2 for 2 weeks etc. and providing more kitchen equipment. So in conclusion a 4,5/5 recommendation!:)

description: A modernly designed comfortable garden apartment in a historical building in the very center of Beyoglu.

reviews.text:
This unit was suited in a spectacular location, just 10-15minutes walk to the nearest metro station, 20 minutes to the next tram station, and at most 20 minutes walk to many Istanbul tourist destinations, i.e. Taksim square, Istiklal street, Galata tower, galataport, Besiktas bridge, and many more.
It was also near the main street, just a 20-second walk, so we felt very safe. Taxis and buses were readily available.
Although situated in the old town, the unit was newly refurbished inside and out. Everything was new, the furniture, bathroom, bedroom, kitchen, etc. and having such a newly refurbished unit in the heart of beyoglu was amazing.
A 24/7 security guard was on the premises, and check-in was face-to-face, which was great as well. We felt a great sense of hospitality.
All in all, this is a very very great value for the price, especially for two guests (the addon charge for the 3rd guest is excessive though, especially for a sofa bed.)
Definitely recommended.

It was an OK stay but there were some problems.
Firstly, the living room had a window on ceiling which was at the same level with the road. The window also has an open part for gas burner (legal reasons) which made it quite noisy. If someone is going to sleep there, they won't enjoy the garbage trucks on Sunday morning or cars, motorcycles etc which feel like they are passing through the room - all night long.
Second problem was the parking garage. It has a such tight entrance that it becomes a pain to enter/exit. Then you don't get a garage key. You have to call reception to get it opened but they don't have a designated phone at reception, so you have know who will be working when you come back, and call their personal number.
I would not suggest here if you are driving a car.
Apart from these issues, it was a nice place. Spotless clean, staff was very polite and helpful, and location is walking distance to Istiklal street.
Very nice and clean apartment with a big bedroom and great location to reach everything in the city by foot. Communication was really quick and conditions were very nice!

I stayed in the garden suite. The apartment opens directly to the garden and you can use the garden. It had a very sweet garden. The interior design and concept is very nice. The location of the building was very good. Close to public transport. Istiklal Street and Taksim Square are within walking distance. There is always staff in the building. Having security personnel at night is a great feature for us to feel safe. The staff was caring and helpful. They treated us very well. The apartment was very clean. I would definitely recommend it.
Very nice and clean apartment. Great location. Very responsive host. There's also a concierge who can help. Definitely recommend

description:
If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. A house under the sloping ramp.
Air conditioning available

reviews.text:
Honestly, I’ve never written a bad review before but I wouldn’t advise anyone to stay here.
First impressions of the area, it was a little sketchy, far out and difficult to walk to but we tried to remain positive.
The apartment smelt musty and polluted, and just unclean.
The shower was either boiling or freezing, with smashed door that let water out, no toilet roll and mouldy ceiling.
Don’t stay here if you plan to cook, the kitchen was filthy and no basic utilities (knives , large plates, kitchen roll) and there was gone out of date meat and food in the fridge.
We tried to clean (no cleaning supplies either) but we decided to relocate airbnbs.
The host throughout the whole process was extremely rude and uncooperative, we had asked for hangers/ cutlery and he still hadn’t dropped any off, 2 days after we’d asked.
To make matters worse, the balcony was filthy and full of cigarettes. We have photographic evidence of all this. Stop reading & Don’t stay here.

The apartment is exactly as described and looks exactly like the photos. It has everything one might want or need. I think anyone should feel at home right away. I would definitely rent from Muhammed , who's a very helpful and friendly person, again and would recommend this place to anyone looking for a great place near the center of İstanbul.

We were the very first visitors in this beautiful place. Everything was new and very clean. It was exactly like on photos. Muhammed helped us with our luggages and gave some advices about groceries around the house. We were there almost for a month and it was a really great time. Thank you!

5 stars value its not enough for this amazing place and am sure it deserves more than this because of the calm and the clean plus the simple and nice furniture and the wonderful Mohamed he is very cooperation.
I recommended this apartment for everyone looking for the comfortable.

Great host. The place has everything needed for a long stay. Wifi is suitable for remote work. The area is convenient. On a less positive note, the bathroom is far from new and honestly feels a little yucky (perma-dirty like). If you’re a light sleeper you may want to use ear plugs because the street is extremely noisy 24/7.

description:
Available for stays over 100 days.

This bright and spacious 2-bedroom apartment is located in Fulya, Şişli and is ideal for comfortable long-term stays. It features a cozy living room, fully equipped kitchen, comfortable bedrooms, and an enclosed balcony. Cevahir Mall is about a 15-minute walk away, and Acıbadem Fulya Hospital is very close. The apartment is on a quiet street and suitable for remote work. Daily amenities and local shops are within easy reach.

reviews.text: Fantastic, modern, clean flat, matches what we expected and illustrates in the pictures. The air is clear, and the place is comfortable and quiet. It is near the hospitals and health centres such as Acibadem Hospital, the International Liver Centre and Fulya Goruntuleme. I think having the lift is very helpful for the people who come to Istanbul for health reasons. Also, the biggest Carrefour supermarket is just a few minutes from there. If Enis enhance his communication skill and more understanding of people’s request, it would be great (maybe language caused misunderstanding, and he is hosting many flats that are affected). Overall, I like the flat, recommended.

The hosts are a great team and were always happy to help with whatever we needed. The house was clean, practical, and comfortable for our stay. The location is good and convenient overall, though it’s worth noting that there are quite a lot of stairs to reach the nearest metro station.

Honestly I don’t think that this place worth this money. Good if you are not planning to stay long. Apartment is quite old and narrow. You have to keep curtains always closed because other apartments can see inside. Too many hills and up and downs in this area of Istanbul. Balcony door lock was broken. Kitchen was not clean as I would expect. Good things: it is walking distance to Cehavir Shopping Center, heating and hot water was working fine. Has a small balcony for tea or smoke. It has a lift and working fine.

we enjoyed our stay very much.
the house is very clean and complete with amenities.
the hosts are very responsive and helpful. we texted back and forth in english and I always felt I had support.
very nice kitchen.
very nice bathroom
very nice bed with clean sheets and towels
nice living room comfy to chill.
nothing but nice things to stay.
just keep in mind there are unavoidable stairs to the ground floor where there is an elevator available.

Overall, I had a pleasant stay. The apartment was clean, and check-in was easy and convenient.
There were some issues with the Wi-Fi during my stay. The network name provided was incorrect at first, but the host quickly asked me to check the router and I found out the correct details. Unfortunately, the internet connection was unstable afterward and was unavailable for almost a full day, with a few additional interruptions during the stay. Hanemo was responsive and contacted the service provider to help resolve the issue.
I would also recommend some renovation and maintenance work in the apartment, as several items seemed worn or broken despite the apartment looking better in the photos. With a few improvements, the stay experience could be even better.
Thanks Hanemo!

description: Mangana Konak is an Ottoman House in the residential area of the Old City Istanbul, its quite and peaceful location close to the major sights will make your stay memorable.

reviews.text: Luxury is a pretty big stretch here. The staff was friendly and helpful. The location wasn't bad. The room looked like it had been cheaply and poorly remodeled with plenty of things that could have been fixed. With that being said I usually stay in hostels so a quiet room to myself with a comfy bed at this price and location was good for me.

Location at dead end only good view of Sea is from the Dining room on 4th floor.
The balcony is cramped and only meter in width.
Staff needs Training in handling Guests and resolving queries.
Staff is weak in English hence Communication issues.
WIFI fluctuates mostly weak signal n slow browsing. Staff blames service provider.
Had to use my Turk Com SIM wifi most.
Electricity Failure took place and No Fuel in Generators and NO Emergency Lights in Rooms had to be in Dark for hours.
Washrooms do not have exhausts as such the Toilet smell is in rooms.
Breakfast is satisfactory n *will be better if every Dish Displays NAME of What it is*
*The good thing* was Lemon Cologne bottle at Reception for use by guests when going out.

This hotel's location places it wonderfully within walking distance of much of the European side of Istanbul. The room itself was clean and enjoyable, with a nice view and nice amenities. The balcony where breakfast is served helped create a memorable experience for us as we began our days!
Stating at Mangana Konak hotel was comfortable. The space was clean and the staff very helpful. The breakfast was great too!

The room had an excellent view, breakfast was amazing with just a little additional price but totally worth it. They were very kind and humble and also helped us with everything we needed and much more. The place was cent percent clean and I would definitely recommend people to stay here cos of the amenities and the location.

description:
Enjoy your stay in Istanbul at the heart of the city; in the most central district Taksim while not compromising from your peaceful night's sleep, in our quiet and safe neighborhood where you can enjoy and emmerse yourself in local culture.

Our lovely apartment located only 5 mins away walking distance from Istiklal street where's the most alive street of the city with lots of cafes, restaurants, bars, shops and the events.

Paid parking slot available, 10 mins walk away from the apartment.

reviews.text:
Greg stay. Everything went smoothly from check in to check out, even we never spoke or see Amr.
Place is spacious, clean and comfortable. Walking distance from everything you need, even though the immediate surroundings around the apartment seems a bit dilapidated. I can fully recommend this place.

Ozgur is a really friendly and response host, he was fully prepared for tourists and was really helpful
The appartment is very cozy and warm
Location is really close to Taksim but away from the noise
Listing is exactly as described

This was a very comfortable place to stay in. The beds were comfortable and clean. Easy to get to the bus or train. Our taxi did have a hard time finding it. So When your taxi gets close to the accommodation just get out and walk. Use your google maps to find your way.
There is a little store just a minutes walk away that is open till late. Great place to get milk and bread etc:
great location, nice flat, very communicative host!

Place was just what we needed . A base for us to attend the champions league final
Right in the lively Beyoglu area of the city
Walking distance from restaurants, bars and landmarks
No complaints
Thanks Chris

description: Hello everyone, our room is in Kadıköy, 1 one minute walk from the port. Please feel free to ask all your questions and requests. I will be happy to answer

reviews.text: As other guest wrote, I'll repeat the highlights of this listing: exactly as described, simple and clean, and in an excellent location for Kadikoy in Istanbul. Great option and value for a short stay. The pier for the ferry to Karakoy and Eminönü is a 5-minute walk away. Local bars nearby, so if you're looking for that it's a great option; and if not, mind the nearby noise. Serhat is very responsive and clear in communications, and the check in and out were flexible and easy.

I had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and the host was friendly, helpful, and easy to communicate with. Everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend this place to others!

Evin konumu çok iyi bir yerde, odanın içi de düzenli. Banyo ve oda temiz, bu lokasyon için fiyat/performansı iyi. Kaldığım odanın görseldeki oda ile tek farkı yatak. Beklentimin bir tık altı ama rahatsız etmedi. Yastık kalitesi artırılır ve yatak örtüleri görseldeki gibi olursa bölgedeki en iyi fiyat/performans veren oda olur.

Great area to stay if you want to explore Kadiköy or also Istanbul itself. Everything is in walking distance. Be aware that there is a night club nearby with loud music until 3-4am. If you need a place to sleep and a good shower your good to go. If you have an early flight to catch bring some earplugs. When I arrived the place was absolutely clean and everything available that you need. However, on my second day the bed and shower was full of ants.
Overall okayish stay for the money.

The rental was as described and met all of our needs. Location / neighborhood was especially fantastic, with easy walking access to ferry, attractions, places to relax, walk, & people watch, and many great restaurants! A little more than we hoped to pay, but was fair price & would book again!

description: Located 500 meters from Taksim Square in Cihangir, 900 meters from Galata Port Shopping Center, 300 meters from Kabataş Findikli Tram line, in a brand new building with underfloor heating, all the kitchen equipment, washing machine, dryer, refrigerator, etc. you need are available in the apartment.

reviews.text: I stayed for 5 nights , it was flawless , the host (esra) was friendly and responsive and very nice , the location is close to Taksim Square , 12 mins walk , the building has a password lock outside , the apartment was just like the photos and even better , great airbnb experience , in few words : nice host , clean apartment , good location , great price for the value you're getting , highly recommend

Overall, Esra's place is good - big & bright living room, complete amenities, and comfortable.
The kitchen is great, equipped with everything (including oven & dishwasher) except scissors. Cook wares are non-stick material, not the best if you're a very particular mom like me.
There is only one AC unit in the living room, it works well as we visited in early June but I can see it being quite warm during peak summer months (there are standing fans in each room but it will be quite hot). Opening the windows can work but you'll invite mosquitoes & other insects (and construction debris & sounds as of when we visited). The windows are quite sound proof though!
Building has a lift, very convenient. It is perched on a hilly part of town after a tight turn, not the best place for elderlies to do walking things (ok for Uber/ taxi-ing around). It is also very close to other buildings so there is the perception of lack of privacy, we drew the curtains for majority of the day.

Definitely a clean apartment, close to public transportation and the city center. I used to walk every day to Galata Port and Taksim. I would say the price I paid for eight nights was acceptable.
The only significant issue with the whole apartment is that the walls are too slim, and you can hear everything from other flats, when someone is cleaning, and when a kid is crying at night.
PS: don't forget that you have to take stairs or uphills to reach the flat, and that's the beauty of Istanbul ;)

I really loved the place! I was very picky when choosing the location, and finding Esra’s listing was a great decision.
The apartment, location, and host were all excellent.
A few things future guests might find helpful:
-The apartment is very bright, but since it’s close to other buildings, we kept the curtains down most of the time.
-Bring your own shampoo and cooking basics (like olive oil).
-There was some construction noise in the mornings during our mid-August stay.
We had a small issue, but the host was very responsive and assisted us quickly.
Overall, our stay was wonderful, and we’ll definitely choose this apartment again when we return to Istanbul:)

The apartment is really beautiful and is very well thought through. Everything was clean and meticulous. The location is close to public transportation and the Taksim square / Istiklal street. Esra is such a wonderful and responsive host. She was very accommodating to all our needs and very supportive. I will live again at Esra’a place again without a doubt.
… and no, this is not a paid review, lol. Esra is genuinely a nice host :)

description: Discover Istanbul from our bright, family-friendly retreat in the historic Old City! This modern apartment comfortably sleeps 4 and is a true walker's paradise, placing you steps from iconic attractions. Features a private bedroom, workspace, and kitchenette. Ideal for families or small groups seeking a peaceful base to explore the city's rich history.

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic stay at this apartment! The location couldn't be better, just a short walk to the Grand Bazaar. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing.
Bulent, the host, was exceptionally helpful throughout my stay. He provided great recommendations for closeby car park(very cheap) and was always available if I had any questions. His warm hospitality truly made the experience even better.
I highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking to stay in the heart of Istanbul with a reliable and friendly host.
Thanks again, Bulent, for a memorable stay

We went on a road trip and booked this place on the way to Istanbul. Bülent and Şeyhmus were very responsive and reasonable. The place is actually smaller than what it feels in the pictures but did the trick for us as a family of four. The house is located right in the middle of old town and all the must visit places such as Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace were in walking distance. The quality of the beds and the linens were super high and comparable to our Airbnb in Sedona/Arizona where we rent around $500 a night. They provide almost everything but washer which might help us go home with clean clothes but nothing to complain. Please be aware that there is no designated parking spot for this house so you have to arrange it privately. Overall it was a great stay and we were pretty satisfied.

We had a great stay. The room was centrally located and close to the grand bazaar, Hafia Sophie, Blue Mosque and the Basilica Cistern. The house was clean and quiet even during prayer times. Even though the room size was smaller than we expected but it was comfortable for a family of 4 with 2 adult kids. The kitchen was fully stocked and they even offered to bring us fresh towels. Bülent was prompt and a great host.

I had an amazing stay at this apartment! The place was absolutely spotless — clean, fresh, and very well-maintained. It had everything I needed, from kitchen essentials to comfortable bedding and reliable Wi-Fi. The location couldn’t be better — all the main attractions, restaurants, and shops were just a short walk away, making it super convenient to explore the city.
The host was incredibly responsive, friendly, and helpful throughout my stay, always quick to answer any questions and make sure everything was perfect. I truly felt at home here.
I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul — I’d definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable and exactly as described. Check-in was easy and communication with the host was smooth and friendly. The location is convenient and quiet, perfect for exploring the area. Everything worked well and we would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!

description:
Stay in a comfortable private room just 3 minutes walking distance to Acıbadem Metro.
Quick and easy access to all parts of Istanbul.
Reach Sabiha Gökçen Airport (SAW) in 45–55 minutes via metro, no taxis needed.

Küçük Çamlıca Park, a peaceful forested area perfect for walking and running, is just 3.5 km away. You can also find photos of the park in the listing.

✅ Comfortable bed
✅ Fast Wi-Fi (ideal for remote work)
✅ Clean environment
✅ Fully equipped kitchen
✅ Easy transportation

reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience staying at this property! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully arranged. The host was incredibly responsive, friendly, and helpful throughout the entire stay, making check-in and check-out a breeze. The neighborhood was quiet and safe, with plenty of great restaurants and shops nearby. I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area and would happily stay here again. Thank you for a great stay!

Sinem was such a great host! Kind, clean, quiet, friendly, easy to communicate and very helpful! Room had everything i needed, a large tv, a desk for work, comfty chair and a comfty bed and so much more! It can get a bit noisy because the windows facing relatively a semi active street with traffic running every now and then but not a big issue. Location is 5 min walking to the nearest metro station. Good sushi restaurant around and supermarkets for everyday needs. Definetely worth the money spent thanks to Sinem. Definately recommend it!

Sinem is a wonderful, discreet and very caring host. Her appartment was as seen in pictures, tidy and clean, and the neighborhood really convenient to either explore Kadikoy or reach the ferries to the European side. For solo travellers staying at Sinem's is totally worthing it.

Truly a SUPERHOST!! I spent about a week in Sinelm’s lovely, cozy apartment, and it was simply great. As other guests have noted, it looks exactly like the photos, the bed is comfortable, and the place is perfect for travelers looking for a home away from home where they can work or be productive. The apartment is spotless, everything is well-organized, and it is indeed within walking distance of Kadıköy; public transport is right around the corner.
Thanks again for sharing your home with me— HUGS!

I had a good monthlong stay in the apartment. No problems cooking meals at home, laundry, working remotely and shower was good. Neighborhood is close to metro and with some good restaurants and supermarkets walking distance. Only thing is upstairs neighbors are quiet loud at night so sensitive sleepers will need earplugs. Overall was a good stay.

description: Have good time with your family at this stylish place.

reviews.text:
Very nice helpful hosts. We were given clear instructions about check in. The apartment is in a very nice location and easy to get to from Istanbul airport. The apartment itself is pristine clean and comfortable to stay.
The hosts were helpful and always available to help. Would definitely recommend this property as we will be using again for our future trips.
See you soon.

By far our best stay in the Basaksehir area.
Everything was perfect (Check-in, communication, ease-of-access, parking, cleanliness, etc..)
Host is extremely welcoming and responsive. Would stay there every time.

We had a fantastic experience staying here for three months. The apartment and residential complex were even better than expected — modern, upscale, secure, and very family-friendly, with excellent facilities including pools gyms (for men and women) children’s areas, a huge playground and more.
The gated community is superb and the staff are always friendly and helpful.
A special feature is the newly built bridge which practically connects the community with the huge public Park (Millet Bahcesi) with lots of cafes, Restaurants and facilities for families.
A special thank you goes to Dr. Adam and his family, who went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable and enjoyable. Whenever we had a request or issue, he was always quick to respond and help.
We would happily come back again. This was genuinely one of the best Airbnbs we have ever stayed in, if not the best. Highly recommended.

Thank you, such a great host.
The host was there when we checked in and briefed us with everything needed to feel like home, delivery apps, addresses, etc..
The host even went extra miles helping me get my lost phone back, and keeping my luggage after checkout.
The place was super clean with amazing furniture and details, felt like home.
Beautiful place and beautiful house. Felt right at home. Very clean and well maintained. Dr. Adam is an amazing host. Don’t think twice before booking this place. 🙂

description:
Our building has 5 floors and all areas have been restored. It is an apartment where you will feel at home. My apartment has 1 bedroom, 1 living room, 1 bathroom. There is no elevator. The apartment is accessed by stairs, ID or passport must be presented.

Our apartment is a 5-minute walk from the famous Istiklal Avenue and the main street. Taksim metro station is 15 minutes away on foot.

reviews.text:
We had a pleasant stay at the apartment. The property looks just like it does in the pictures and is well-equipped. Our host, Isaac, was very responsive and helpful. The AC and water heater worked great, which made our stay comfortable.
The area itself seemed a bit shady at first, but we felt safe once we settled in.
Just a heads-up: it can get somewhat noisy at night and sometimes early in the morning.

The apartment is exactly like in the photographs. Everything is clean inside.
The location is quite convenient, 20 minutes walk to the Airport shuttle bus stop Taksim, close to grocery stores, bakeries and cafes.
The area is very hilly, you often need to walk uphill or downhill, which can be difficult with luggage.
Abdullah and Isa respond very quickly and are always ready to help.
Nice apartment and easy to communicate with the host. The area outside is not very clean and not super appealing, but overall the place is good. Comfortable bed, fairly clean.

Konum olarak istiklal caddesine yürüme ile 10 dakikaydi. Ev tertemizdi, Saygi bey çok ilgiliydi gece geldiğimiz saatte bizimle iletişime geçti. İletişimde bir sorun yaşamadık. Konumu çok tekin bir sokak değil ama konaklamak için yeterince iyi.
Dünde kalmıştım uzatma yaptım rahatlık 10 numara, o civarda böyle fiyat böyle rahatlık ve merkeze yakın olan ikinci bi yer yok

description:
Antoine Galata is located in the 160 year old Grade II Listed Urgliavich Building next to the Galata Tower.
The building was fully renovated in 2012. All apartments are luxuriously refurbished with top-of-the-line amenities.
Galata Neighbourhood is where the heart of the City beats with some of the best restaurants and cafés in town very conveniently located.
Shopping for daily amenities, souvenirs and other needs is very easy and safe in the neighbourhood.
Location is extremely central.

reviews.text:
Located just across the Galata Tower. With splendid views from the room and the terrace. Multitude of restaurants and shops around. The tram, metro and bus 5 to 10 minutes walking.
The apartment is Ina historical building, is tastefully done up and comfortable, exactly as the listing says. Elevator to access the floor. Hot water in the bathroom. All the necessary kitchen and home gadgets. While the area gets very busy in the evening / night, there is absolutely no noise in the apartment when you shut the windows and we slept peacefully every night.
Naz is an amazing host and very attentive and responsive. She gave lots of great suggestions on food and wine places that were spot on. Was at the door to receive us and helped us with our taxi booking at checkout.
On the whole a truly delightful experience and highly recommended

The apartment looks onto the Galata Tower and there a many good restaurants within walking distance. The windows and apartment are well-insulated against noise and, although one may hear some muted sounds from the restaurants and cafes outside, it is not loud and did not disturb our sleep or rest. The apartment is as described and clean, and the photos are an accurate representation of the apartment. Naz is a great host and provided us with recommendations when we arrived. She would also respond reasonably quickly to any questions we asked during our stay. We enjoyed our stay and would stay at the apartment again when we return to Istanbul.

This was my fourth time staying at Naz's place. We love it. It's impeccable. Beautifully designed. Clean. Charming. User friendly. This is the third apartment we tried with a washer dryer and it was delightful. Every window has a view. You can see the sunset. The design is comfortable and chic and modern and arty. I have actually asked our host where to purchase some of the items so I could use them in my home. It's a lovely modern one bedroom home with kitchen/dining room/large bathroom/ separate living room and bedroom all with windows. I am so thrilled to have found this amazing place to call home when we are in Istanbul. I look forward to many more visits. Naz was so helpful and was able to arrange taxis, a delivery of fruit and yogurt, suggested some restaurants we enjoyed. She is available and helpful and polite with excellent English and a kind attitude. Can't recommend it enough

Naz helped make our stay in Istanbul so enjoyable with fantastic recommendations and help setting up appointments and transfers. She was always responsive to our questions and anything we needed. The 4th floor apartment (with elevator!) is in an extremely busy area directly in front of the beautiful Galata Tower with views from all windows of the Bosporous. Amenities inside were beautiful and comfortable. Windows on three sides created a lovely sound proof environment. Nice to have easy, quick access to the Tram or Metro for getting to the Old Town side of Istanbul. We Loved our stay here.

Most probably the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at. Top tourist location yet soundproof windows so we slept like babies while the bustling outside was full on every evening! The photos and description do not do this place justice. Extremely clean, new, unique design objects, full amenities for a comfortable stay. I highly recommend!

description: We’ve just reopened our Airbnb villa after 4 months of renovation. The pool area has been upgraded, flooring in two en-suite bedrooms has been renewed, and both bathrooms have been fully refreshed. The garden landscaping has been improved and new outdoor seating areas have been added. General maintenance has been completed to ensure a more enjoyable stay for our guests. Updated photos will be available soon.

reviews.text:
1.Overall Experience: My stay at this Airbnb was mixed, with both positive and negative aspects.
2.Host Interaction: The host was helpful and responsive, making communication smooth and easy.
3.Accuracy of Listing: Unfortunately, the listing was not as beautiful as the pictures suggested. For the money we paid, we felt we could have found a better listing at the same price.
3.Cleanliness: The house was very dirty, with insects and spiders all over the roofs. This significantly impacted our comfort and overall experience.
4.Location: The location and view were good, offering convenient access to nearby attractions.
5.Amenities: The Wi-Fi was not working properly, and the garden's automatic lighting system turned off too early for our liking.
6.Comfort: The beds were not comfortable at all, which made it difficult to get a good night's sleep.
7.Value for Money: All in all, for the same price, this property needs a lot of improvements to meet expectations.
8.Suggestions for Improv

We stayed at this house for a 3-day family vacation. While the location and space were okay, the overall condition of the house was quite poor and in need of serious maintenance. It definitely didn’t match the standard we expected for the price paid.
On the positive side, Duygu, who manages the rental, was very kind, understanding, and quick to respond when I shared photos and feedback. She took my feedbacks and concerns seriously and assured me that steps were being taken to improve the property.
Overall, the stay was not ideal, but I appreciate the manager’s effort and responsiveness.

Our stay at this villa was absolutely perfect! The location up on the hill is incredible, and the weather and breeze were just wonderful. The villa itself, the pool, and all the rooms were spotlessly clean and number one in quality.
Everything you could possibly need was provided.
As for our host, Duygu, she is a true lady and an amazing person! She took complete care of us from day one. When the weather got a bit too warm, she immediately went out of her way to send us fans right away to ensure we were completely comfortable. Her hospitality and care were unmatched. We couldn't have asked for a better experience. Highly recommended, and we will definitely be back!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay! The villa was beautiful, clean, and perfectly equipped with all the necessary amenities we needed for a comfortable family vacation. The location is great and very close to the sea, which was a huge plus for us. Duygu was an amazing host—incredibly warm, welcoming, and always ready to help. She answered all our questions instantly, helped us with everything, and made sure our stay was perfect. Highly recommend this place to everyone! Thank you so much for your wonderful hospitality!

The villa was charming, with a nice view from a hilltop. We had an ok time which was made special by 5 cats who live nearby. The villa is more suited for winter holidays because of the lack of air-conditioning or fans. It was very hot inside and very difficult to sleep.
We noticed radiators and a fire place.
Duygu was helpful in organising taxis everywhere, shops , beach cost around $7/ trip, Istanbul airport $100
SAW Airport $60
Hiring a car would have given us more freedom to do more, taxi takes 4 passengers, so for a large group we need several taxis, large ones are few .
Uber doesn't work in Sile.

description: A suite room with balcony can accommodate 5 guests.

reviews.text:
Taner made my vacation in Istanbul a lot more enjoyable.
He was very friendly and knowledgeable, and gave me some great tips on what to see and do in the city. He also arranged a taxi from airport to house. The taxi was clean and spacious, and the price was reasonable.
Elevator is a big bonus because my room located at 5th floor with nice park view.
I would definitely use Taner's home again if I ever come back to Istanbul.

This way an amazing choice. It is in local area of old Istanbul instead of the high tourist area. Which is a 10 minute walk. Prices of food etc were much more reasonable in this area. I would always stay here due to its perfect location across the street from Cafe with lots of seating area and opened late. Give you a place to hangout at the end of the day. The unit was super clean, they changed sheets everyday. Best Airbnb experience
Nice and comfortable apartment ideall for up to 5 persons very close to tram, Aya Sofia and local restaurants.
Great place at reasonable price

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour.
Un personnel accueillant, gentils et à l’écoute de ce qu’on demander.
Un endroit où on se sent en sécurité.
Je vous le recommande.

description:
My 1-bedroom luxury apartment, where you will enjoy your vacation, is located in the same facility as the 5-Star Radisson Blu Hotel in Ottomare Istanbul and is decorated with luxury items to make you feel at home.

You can easily use the hotel's facilities such as restaurant, pool, gym, sauna (all subject to an additional fee per person).

You will be able to see the magnificent sea view from all rooms.

-The apartment has 24/7 security.

-Fast Wi-Fi

-You will have a peaceful time with your family.

reviews.text: Excellent host and stay. The room was spacious, clean and comfortable and nothing was too much trouble. Great value, security and prompt, friendly and proactive communication. Highly rated.

We came from San Francisco, California. And this place is most suitable for our needs. Laundry and Dryer, stove, fridge and extra beds. Close to all the really delicious and quality shopping stores for very cheap prices. No tourist traps here. ZeytinBurnu is filled with great food and stores to experience a real taste of istanbul. taxis are right out the door so they will take u anywhere which is all close distance away from Grand Bazaar to Hagia sophia among many other malls. really enjoyed the TV having YouTube as well. loved this place and will definitely coming back as an international traveler. The host speaks perfect English and is very responsive.

Fatih was a great host. He took care of everything, always available in communication.
The appartment is in a nice location with amazing view and easy transportation. If Fatih take care of a couple of minor things (like some maintenance in the bathroom and an adult bed in the second bedroom) , it would be upgraded to a premium appartment, easyly competing to the nearby hotels.

The apartment I stayed in was clean and spacious with a wonderful view of Marina. All amenities are provided. Fatih the host was very friendly and helpful with knowledgable surroundings. His instruction for checking was very clear, with video instruction and any query I asked was answered in a timely manner. He was so kind enough to take me on his motorcycle ride to see Istanbul and to get me a good price for Bosphorus Dinner. He becomes a dear friend to me, and his property is highly recommended to stay in Istanbul. Thank you for looking after me while I am solo travel in Istanbul, Fatih. He even stayed and waited for me late to get an Uber to the airport and gave me souvenirs of Istanbul for me to remember my time there. Top Notch Host👌

I wanted to share my wonderful experience staying at Mr. Fatih's apartment in Istanbul at the Radisson Blu Hotel. The apartment was immaculately clean, offering stunning views of the city and sea. The furniture was beautiful and in great condition. Additionally, Mr. Fatih was incredibly kind, helpful, and promptly answered all my questions. I highly recommend this accommodation to anyone visiting Istanbul.

description: Located just a 2-minute walk from Taksim Sqaure, this stylish design flat offers a cozy and elegant stay in the heart of Istanbul. Our prime location provides easy access to all major historical and touristic sites like Hagia Sophia,Sultanahmet and Topkapı Palace. Enjoy a 10min. stroll to the Galataport on the Bosphorus. The neighborhood is buzzing with Istanbul's best restaurants and cultural spots. All public transport options are within a 5-minute walk, making city exploration effortless.

reviews.text:
My friend and I stayed here for two months and we really enjoyed it. The apartment is comfortable. There are a bunch of cats that live outside that were so friendly and made our day whenever we saw them. The kitchen is very well stocked, the beds were comfortable, and it was really nice to have AC during the end of summer heat. The apartment gets a lot of natural light and the wifi worked well enough to work remotely. Can was very kind and always very responsive whenever we needed anything.
A few things to note - one of the bedrooms doesn't have anywhere to hang clothes. The shower is pretty small, so if you're tall, that could be troublesome. The trash gets collected every day at 6:30am and is very loud, which often woke up my friend. There's currently construction going on nearby that you can hear throughout the day. As others mentioned, the stairs going to the second floor are very steep so be careful, especially when carrying things. All in all, I'd recommend the apartment!

They were super helpful and the place was clean, it was super close to taksim square and istiklal st. Just a headsup: generally street around taksim square has sharp steep and very old structure so consider that plus the place has stairs to climb up, for me (30yrs old) it was fine, ac was awesome, internet: awesome, kitchen and other amenities: awesome. Regarding the money: it’s almost what you can get as a tourist for long stay, so fair for tourist but as a local for sure it’s expensive, overall I recommend the place for long stay

I had an fantastic stay at Can's apartment! The location was absolutely perfect, making it easy to explore the city and enjoy everything the area has to offer. The apartment was sparkling clean, cozy, and well-maintained, which made my stay even more enjoyable. Can was a wonderful host—friendly, responsive, and ensures that guests feel comfortable and welcome. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay. I would definitely come back!

I had an amazing stay at Can’s place! The apartment was spotless, and the bed was incredibly comfortable. I felt right at home and enjoyed every moment. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a cozy and clean place to stay!
Fantastic location! Can’s apartment is in the heart of the city, close to all the major attractions and public transportation. It made exploring the city so convenient. I’ll definitely be back!
I was blown away by the beautiful decor and thoughtful amenities at Can’s home. Every detail was perfect, from the stylish furnishings to the fully equipped kitchen. It was a true home away from home

The apartment is beautiful and well located, near Taksim. It was very clean and quiet. There’s only one AC, and it’s in the living room. However, I slept with bedroom door open and with the AC on at night and felt comfortable. I would definitely stay here again!

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: We had a great stay in Fatih! The place is really easy to find, and the front desk at the hotel (where we got the key) were so friendly and helpful. The room was clean, spacious and comfortable, and within walking distance to the tourist centre of Istanbul. It was also very easy to find food (restaurant or supermarket) in the area and jump on and off buses to further out. Would really recommend staying here.

The location was close to public transport. Several must see sites were all in walking distance. The Grand Bazaar, the Blue Mosque, Hagia-Sofia mosque, to name a few.
Vedat and his staff were very helpful and available 24/7 to assist with anything. Great restaurants just a few minutes walk. All in all a comfortable and pleasant stay. Thank you.

Girerken ufak bir sıkıntı yaşadık. Bu sıkıntı anahtarlarla alakalıydı. Biz gittiğimizde Pakistanlı bir beyefendi vardı işe yeni başlamış ve tam olarak hangi kat olduğunu vesayre doğal olarak tam kavrayamamıştı. Tamamiyle güzel kaliteli balkonu olan fotoğrafta ne gördüysek o. Ev sahibi herhangi bir sorun da direk yardımcı oluyor. Çözüm odaklı yaklaşıyor. Deneyimimiz güzeldi. Temel malzemeler (elektrikli ocak, tabak, bardak, sıcak su, içilmesi için 4 adet içecek mevcuttu. Havluların birisinde ufak sarımsı bir leke vardı Bir kaç tane havlu olduğu için dert etmedik. Temiz düzenli bir yer. Teşekkür ederim her şey için. Tavsiye ediyorum.
Very responsive and communicated extremely well, answered all queries and questions I had. Very helpful and nice and clean room and bathroom. No issues and was a smooth stay

Well. It's pretty disgusting. Working stuffs are warm. But the rooms are disgusting, i have to cancel it.
3 bottles of water in the refrigerator,one is already opened and been used. This morning found another empty bottle behind the curtain. Really disappointed

description: Welcome to this modern and inviting 2-bedroom home with a private patio, located in the lively Kurtuluş area of Şişli. Designed with comfort and functionality in mind, the apartment offers a calm and stylish atmosphere: perfect for relaxing after a day in the city. With bright living spaces, comfortable bedrooms, and a thoughtful layout, this home is ideal for families, couples, or friends seeking a cozy and well-connected stay in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Firstly, the hosts were responsive and helpful regarding personal queries regarding public transport etc.
The location is very lively with loads of bars/pubs/restaurants. 5 mins walk to Osmanbey metro station, 10/15 mins walk to Nişantaşi which is very helpful. However, expect some noise as the flat is between two pubs and they’re open to around 2am every day.
The flat itself if spacious and relatively modern. However, due to being basement it gets little to no light, but it’s nice and cool regardless of the heat outside and I hardly used the aircon. The flat was unfortunately not as clean as I expected it to be with loads of dust on skirting boards and crumbs in sofas. The kitchen is fully equipped, however the hob was dirty with oil stains.
Unfortunately, on my last day it rained and the flat flooded. Due to it being the basement floor and not being advertised as one be careful when booking, especially in autumn/winter.

This flat is located close to a metro station which makes it easy to move quickly around the city. The place is also well-equipped even though the kitchen is quite compact. The main drawback of the flat for me during my stay was the noise coming from the neighboring bar, which was intense on some nights, and the noise from the local traffic in the front part (street side) of the building, which is located down a slope. I was alone and opted to sleep in the second smaller room located in the middle of the apartment, but this may be something to consider if you plan to stay with other people. I did not meet the hosts but the communication with Şeyma and Demir was efficient, professional and welcoming. As noted in previous reviews, the lack of ventilation and light at the basement level could be something to consider for longer stays, but on the other hand, the place also stayed fresher during hot days in June and the patio was a welcome retreat from the hustle and bustle of the city.

My wife and I had an incredible stay at this apartment!
Although we never met the host, Seyma was always available to answer any questions we had about the apartment or Istanbul in general.
The space was impeccably clean, stylish, and equipped with all the amenities we needed.
The location was convenient; it is situated on a very active street full of cafes, bars, and other stores, yet it's very quiet at night. Plus, it's really close to the Metro Station.
I highly recommend this apartment for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
Thanks to the host for their hospitality!

We had a great time in this apartment. It has a very convenient location with plenty of cafes and shops around, and it's close to a metro station. Despite being here on the weekends with nearby bars open, it didn't disturb our relaxation. The apartment is very cozy and well-maintained. The hosts are pleasant and responsive people. If you want to find a quiet and cozy apartment, I recommend staying here.

very wonderful experience that i have ever had during my trips in istanbul. very grateful for host’s hospitality and great help and assistance they provided when ever i need. despite some circumstances happened during the stays, host always responds quickly and manage to solve them also quickly. it is my pleasure to stay in the apartment for 6months.

description:
Discover a unique historical apartment in the heart of Istanbul, adjacent to the Galata Tower! We offer you an unforgettable Istanbul experience with a breathtaking 360 degree view of the city. You will feel all the beauties of Istanbul closely in this special place, which perfectly combines modern comfort and historical texture.


Stylish and historical apartment with renewed furniture.

reviews.text:
There are two things I want to say:
1) As it’s right next to Galata Tower (literally 5 meters away from it) the entrance is always crowded and noisy. No way you’re going outside to grab something in your pyjamas.
2) Weirdly it was cold at night in the bedroom which is easily fixed by an AC. I just didn’t bother turning it on. And it was noisy created either by hvac or some another device.
All in all it was just my experience staying at the place. Nothing against the hosts, they were super friendly and responsive.

Odayı Galata’yı görüyor diye tutmuştuk açıkçası ama göremedik :) görselle alakası yoktu Galata’nın görüşünün. Onun haricinde önceki konaklayanların saçlarına çok denk geldik ve serilen yorganın temiz olmadığına çok emindik. İnanılmaz bir koku geliyordu sürekli mutfak lavabosunda. Lağam kokusu vardı. Heureusement, nous étions au 4ième étage et la chambre ne donne pas sur la rue donc nous avons pu dormir. Il est bien équipé, moderne et confortable comme sur les photos, bonne literie.

reviews.text:
Too Many Bugs & Unclean Conditions Had to Leave Early
We booked this place for a month but had to cut our stay short due to a serious bug issue. After the third day, we started noticing a lot of insects in the apartment—some dead, some alive. We informed the host, and to his credit, he responded quickly and arranged for the place to be cleaned and fumigated.
We decided to leave and stay with family for ten days to give time for the issue to be resolved. However, when we returned, the bugs were still there—again both dead and alive—in the bathroom, on the floors, the kitchen sink, and even once on the bed. It was really unsettling and made the space feel unclean and uncomfortable.
On top of that, the towels smelled strongly of cigarettes. When we brought it up to the host, he did wash them, but this is something that should have been done before our arrival. While the host was responsive and did make an effort to fix the problems, the issues were to severe for us to continue our stay

We stayed 2 nights and enjoyed the central adress - many good restaurants within walking distance and an amazing view on rhe bosborus bridge.
Note: there are many stairs to climb and no elevator and due to the front row location you can here the street life… but as you are on the top of the building it was still a very good option. We liked it and Fuehan was more than helpful with the checkin (we picked us up on the street and organized blankets in the middle of the night as the westher was changing and we felt a vit cold)

Ev sahibimiz yardımseverdi, tüm taleplerimize hızla dönüş yaptı. Ancak ev beklediğimizden çok daha küçük, çok daha az hijyenikti. Mutfakta var olduğunu fotoğraflarda gördüğümüz pek çok eşya yoktu. Banyonun kapanmayan bir camı, kötü bir kokusu vardı. Öte yandan evden terasa açılan bir bölme (kapanmayan) vardı ve hayvan seslerinden rahatsız olmamak/ ürkmemek mümkün değildi. Manzarası böyle güzel olan bir evden beklentimiz daha farklıydı. En problemli nokta temiz olmayışıydı. İki gün evde durmamak için çeşitli yollar aradık desem yeridir. Mutfakta rastladığımız böcekler bulaşıklarımızı yıkamak için bile mutfağa girmemize engel oldu. Yine de ev sahibimize hızlı iletişim kurulabilirliği ve yardımseverliği için teşekkür ederiz.
Great location, great views of the Bosphorus, helpful host. Everything was perfect!

Furkan was very helpful and even came to get us from the ferry for the check-in. Everything in the flat is as advertised, clean, and cozy. The area can be lively until late, which was not a problem for us.
